uz: GTCC (Gas Turbine Combined Cycle) stansiyasida bitta yoqilg'idan ikki bosqichda energiya olinadi: avval gaz turbinasi, keyin uning issiq chiqindi gazidan bug' hosil qilib bug' turbinasi.
en: In a GTCC (Gas Turbine Combined Cycle) plant, energy is extracted from one fuel in two stages: first the gas turbine, then a steam turbine driven by steam raised from the hot exhaust.
ru: На станции GTCC (Gas Turbine Combined Cycle) энергия из одного топлива получается в два этапа: сначала газовая турбина, затем из её горячих выхлопных газов образуется пар для паровой турбины.

uz: Combined cycle stansiyasining umumiy FIK (samaradorlik)i 60-64% ga yetadi, oddiy siklli gaz turbinasi esa faqat ~35-40% beradi.
en: A combined cycle plant reaches 60-64% overall efficiency, while a simple-cycle gas turbine alone yields only about 35-40%.
ru: Общий КПД станции комбинированного цикла достигает 60-64%, тогда как простая газовая турбина даёт лишь около 35-40%.

uz: Gaz turbinasi uch asosiy qismdan iborat: kompressor (havoni siqadi), yonish kamerasi (yoqilg'i yonadi) va turbina (issiq gaz energiyani aylanishga aylantiradi). Bu 'Brayton sikli' deb ataladi.
en: A gas turbine has three core parts: the compressor (compresses air), the combustor (burns fuel), and the turbine (converts hot gas energy into rotation). This is called the Brayton cycle.
ru: Газовая турбина состоит из трёх основных частей: компрессор (сжимает воздух), камера сгорания (сжигает топливо) и турбина (превращает энергию горячего газа во вращение). Это называется циклом Брайтона.

uz: Gaz turbinasi kompressori o'zi ishlab chiqargan quvvatning deyarli yarmini havoni siqishga sarflaydi — qolgani foydali quvvat bo'ladi.
en: A gas turbine's compressor consumes nearly half of the power the turbine produces just to compress incoming air; the rest is useful output.
ru: Компрессор газовой турбины тратит почти половину вырабатываемой мощности на сжатие воздуха — остальное составляет полезную мощность.

uz: HRSG (Heat Recovery Steam Generator) — gaz turbinasining ~600°C chiqindi gazidan issiqlikni 'ushlab', suvni bug'ga aylantiradigan katta issiqlik almashtirgich. U combined cycle'ning yuragi.
en: An HRSG (Heat Recovery Steam Generator) is a large heat exchanger that captures heat from the ~600°C gas turbine exhaust to turn water into steam. It is the heart of combined cycle.
ru: HRSG (Heat Recovery Steam Generator) — большой теплообменник, который улавливает тепло из выхлопных газов газовой турбины (~600°C) и превращает воду в пар. Это сердце комбинированного цикла.

uz: Generator elektr ishlab chiqarganda kuchli qiziydi, shuning uchun yirik generatorlar vodorod (H₂) gazi bilan sovutiladi — vodorod havodan ~7 barobar yaxshi issiqlik o'tkazadi.
en: A generator heats up strongly while producing electricity, so large generators are cooled with hydrogen (H₂) gas, which conducts heat about 7 times better than air.
ru: Генератор сильно нагревается при выработке электричества, поэтому крупные генераторы охлаждаются водородом (H₂) — водород проводит тепло примерно в 7 раз лучше воздуха.

uz: Ishga tushirish (startup) jarayonida turbina asta-sekin aylantiriladi va qizdiriladi. Tez isitish metallda kuchlanish va yoriqlar keltirib chiqarishi mumkin, shuning uchun bosqichma-bosqich boriladi.
en: During startup, the turbine is slowly rotated and warmed. Rapid heating can cause thermal stress and cracks in the metal, so it is done step by step.
ru: При запуске (startup) турбину постепенно раскручивают и прогревают. Быстрый нагрев может вызвать напряжения и трещины в металле, поэтому действуют поэтапно.

uz: Turbina to'xtatilgandan keyin ham 'turning gear' (aylantirish mexanizmi) rotorni sekin aylantirib turadi — aks holda og'irligidan rotor egilib qolishi mumkin.
en: Even after a turbine is shut down, a turning gear keeps the rotor slowly rotating; otherwise the rotor could bow (sag) under its own weight.
ru: Даже после остановки турбины валоповоротное устройство (turning gear) медленно вращает ротор — иначе ротор может прогнуться под собственным весом.

uz: Kompressor pichoqlariga vaqt o'tishi bilan chang va kir yopishadi, bu FIKni pasaytiradi. Shuning uchun davriy ravishda 'compressor blade washing' (pichoqlarni yuvish) o'tkaziladi.
en: Dirt and fouling build up on compressor blades over time, lowering efficiency. That is why periodic compressor blade washing is performed.
ru: Со временем на лопатки компрессора налипают пыль и грязь, что снижает КПД. Поэтому периодически проводят промывку лопаток компрессора (compressor blade washing).

uz: Kompressor yuvish ikki xil bo'ladi: 'online' (turbina ishlab turganda, yengil tozalash) va 'offline' (turbina to'xtatilib, chuqur tozalash). Offline yuvish ko'proq FIK tiklaydi.
en: Compressor washing comes in two types: online (while running, light cleaning) and offline (turbine stopped, deep cleaning). Offline washing restores more efficiency.
ru: Промывка компрессора бывает двух видов: online (при работающей турбине, лёгкая очистка) и offline (с остановкой турбины, глубокая очистка). Offline-промывка восстанавливает больше КПД.

uz: Gaz turbinasi yonish kamerasida harorat 1400-1600°C ga yetadi — bu ko'pchilik metallarning erish nuqtasidan yuqori. Pichoqlar maxsus sovutish va qoplamalar bilan himoyalanadi.
en: Temperatures in a gas turbine combustor reach 1400-1600°C, above the melting point of most metals. Blades are protected by special cooling and coatings.
ru: В камере сгорания газовой турбины температура достигает 1400-1600°C — это выше точки плавления большинства металлов. Лопатки защищены специальным охлаждением и покрытиями.

uz: Turbina pichoqlari ichida mayda kanallar bo'ladi — ular orqali sovuq havo o'tkaziladi. Bu 'film cooling' pichoq sirtida himoya havo qatlamini yaratadi.
en: Turbine blades contain tiny internal channels through which cool air flows. This 'film cooling' creates a protective air layer over the blade surface.
ru: Внутри лопаток турбины есть мелкие каналы, через которые проходит холодный воздух. Это плёночное охлаждение (film cooling) создаёт защитный слой воздуха на поверхности лопатки.

uz: Eng issiq turbina pichoqlari monokristall (single-crystal) qotishmalardan quyiladi — butun pichoq bitta metall kristali bo'lib, u yuqori haroratda mustahkamroq turadi.
en: The hottest turbine blades are cast as single crystals — the whole blade is one metal crystal, which resists high-temperature deformation better.
ru: Самые горячие лопатки турбины отливают из монокристаллических (single-crystal) сплавов — вся лопатка представляет собой один кристалл металла, который прочнее при высокой температуре.

uz: Bug' turbinasi pichog'ining uchi ba'zan tovush tezligidan tezroq — sekundiga 500+ metr harakatlanadi.
en: The tip of a steam turbine blade can move faster than the speed of sound — over 500 meters per second.
ru: Конец лопатки паровой турбины иногда движется быстрее скорости звука — более 500 метров в секунду.

uz: Bug' turbinasi bir necha bosqichdan iborat: yuqori bosim (HP), o'rta bosim (IP) va past bosim (LP). Bug' har bosqichda kengayib, energiyasini beradi va bosimi pasayadi.
en: A steam turbine has several stages: high-pressure (HP), intermediate-pressure (IP), and low-pressure (LP). Steam expands through each stage, giving up energy as its pressure drops.
ru: Паровая турбина состоит из нескольких ступеней: высокого давления (HP), среднего давления (IP) и низкого давления (LP). Пар на каждой ступени расширяется, отдаёт энергию и его давление падает.

uz: Bug' turbinasidan chiqqan bug' kondensatorda sovutilib qaytadan suvga aylantiriladi va sikl qayta boshlanadi — suv behuda ketmaydi, aylanib yuradi.
en: Steam leaving the turbine is cooled in a condenser back into water and reused, so the water is not wasted but circulates in a closed loop.
ru: Конденсатор превращает отработанный пар турбины обратно в воду, создавая вакуум. Низкое давление позволяет пару расширяться сильнее и отдавать больше энергии.

uz: Kondensatorda vakuum (past bosim) bo'ladi. Past bosim bug'ning ko'proq kengayishiga imkon beradi, bu esa turbinadan ko'proq energiya olishni bildiradi.
en: A condenser operates under vacuum (low pressure). Lower pressure lets the steam expand more, which means more energy is extracted from the turbine.
ru: Градирня охлаждает воду конденсатора с помощью воздуха. Горячая вода стекает тонкой плёнкой, часть испаряется и охлаждает остальную.

uz: Generator chiqishidagi kuchlanish transformator orqali oshiriladi (masalan 20 kV → 500 kV), chunki yuqori kuchlanishda energiya uzoq masofaga kam yo'qotish bilan uzatiladi.
en: The generator's output voltage is stepped up by a transformer (e.g. 20 kV to 500 kV), because at high voltage energy travels long distances with fewer losses.
ru: Белый 'дым' из градирни — это не дым, а сконденсировавшийся пар от испарившейся воды. Он безвреден.

uz: 'Single line diagram' — stansiyaning elektr tizimini bitta chiziq bilan soddalashtirib ko'rsatadigan sxema. U generator, transformator va shinalar orasidagi bog'lanishni tushunishga yordam beradi.
en: A single line diagram shows a plant's electrical system simplified to single lines. It helps engineers understand connections between generator, transformers and busbars.
ru: Подшипники несут вес ротора и позволяют ему вращаться. Тонкая плёнка масла между подшипником и валом почти устраняет трение — вал 'плавает' на масле.

uz: Generator to'rga (grid) ulanishidan oldin 'sinxronizatsiya' qilinadi: uning chastotasi, kuchlanishi va fazasi to'r bilan aniq mos kelishi kerak, aks holda kuchli zarba bo'ladi.
en: Before a generator connects to the grid it must be synchronized: its frequency, voltage and phase must exactly match the grid, or a damaging shock occurs.
ru: Масляная система выполняет две задачи: смазывает подшипники (уменьшает трение) и охлаждает их (отводит тепло). Без масла подшипники быстро выходят из строя.

uz: O'zbekiston to'ri 50 Hz chastotada ishlaydi, ya'ni generator rotori sekundiga 50 marta (yoki 3000 ayl/min) aylanadi (2 qutbli mashinada).
en: Uzbekistan's grid runs at 50 Hz, meaning a 2-pole generator rotor spins 50 times per second (3000 rpm) to match it.
ru: Если давление масла падает, турбина автоматически останавливается (trip). Это защищает дорогие подшипники и вал от повреждения.

uz: Gaz turbinasining yonilg'i tizimi yoqilg'i (tabiiy gaz yoki suyuq) miqdorini juda aniq boshqaradi. Yoqilg'i oqimi turbinaning quvvati va haroratini belgilaydi.
en: A gas turbine's fuel system controls the amount of fuel (natural gas or liquid) very precisely. Fuel flow determines the turbine's power and temperature.
ru: Генератор превращает механическое вращение в электричество. Вращающийся ротор создаёт магнитное поле, которое наводит ток в обмотках неподвижного статора.

uz: Ko'p gaz turbinalari 'dual fuel' — asosan tabiiy gazda, lekin zarurda suyuq yoqilg'ida ham ishlay oladi, bu ishonchlilikni oshiradi.
en: Many gas turbines are 'dual fuel' — running mainly on natural gas but able to switch to liquid fuel when needed, improving reliability.
ru: Прежде чем подключить генератор к сети, выполняют синхронизацию: частота, напряжение и фаза должны точно совпасть с сетью, иначе произойдёт сильный удар.

uz: 'Lube oil' (moylash tizimi) turbina podshipniklarini nafaqat moylaydi, balki sovutadi ham. Moy bosimi yo'qolsa, turbina darhol xavfsiz to'xtatiladi.
en: The lube oil system not only lubricates the turbine bearings but also cools them. If oil pressure is lost, the turbine is tripped (safely stopped) immediately.
ru: Трансформатор повышает или понижает напряжение. Генератор вырабатывает низкое напряжение, а трансформатор повышает его для передачи по сети.

uz: Turbina podshipniklari ko'pincha 'oq metall' (babbitt) bilan qoplanadi — bu yumshoq qotishma val bilan ishqalanishni kamaytiradi va uni himoya qiladi.
en: Turbine bearings are often lined with 'white metal' (babbitt), a soft alloy that reduces friction with the shaft and protects it.
ru: Почему для передачи используют высокое напряжение? При высоком напряжении ток меньше, а значит меньше потери тепла в проводах.

uz: Rotor mukammal balansda bo'lishi shart. 3000 ayl/min tezlikda hatto 1 gramm nomutanosiblik ham kuchli vibratsiya beradi, shuning uchun vibratsiya doimiy nazorat qilinadi.
en: A rotor must be perfectly balanced. At 3000 rpm even 1 gram of imbalance causes strong vibration, so vibration is monitored continuously.
ru: Релейная защита — это система, которая автоматически обнаруживает неисправность (короткое замыкание, перегрузку) и быстро отключает повреждённый участок. Это 'страж' электросети.

uz: Gaz turbinasi ishga tushishida 'starting device' (ishga tushirgich) rotorni yonish boshlanguncha aylantiradi — chunki turbina o'zi to'xtagan holatdan mustaqil boshlay olmaydi.
en: At startup a starting device spins the gas turbine rotor until combustion can sustain it, since the turbine cannot start itself from rest.
ru: Главная задача релейной защиты — как можно быстрее устранить неисправность, снижая повреждение оборудования и угрозу устойчивости энергосистемы.

uz: 'FSNL' (Full Speed No Load) — turbina to'liq tezlikda aylanayotgan, lekin hali to'rga quvvat bermayotgan holat. Bu sinxronizatsiyadan oldingi tayyorgarlik bosqichi.
en: FSNL (Full Speed No Load) is when the turbine spins at full speed but is not yet supplying power to the grid — a preparation stage before synchronization.
ru: У релейной защиты четыре ключевых требования: селективность, быстродействие, чувствительность и надёжность. Хорошая защита обеспечивает все четыре вместе.

uz: 'Spin cooling' — turbinani to'xtatgandan keyin uni bir muddat aylantirib, issiqlikni bir tekis tarqatib sovutish usuli. Bu notekis sovushdan kelib chiqadigan egilishning oldini oladi.
en: Spin cooling is rotating the turbine for a while after shutdown to distribute heat evenly as it cools, preventing bowing caused by uneven cooling.
ru: Селективность означает, что защита отключает только повреждённый участок, оставляя исправные в работе. Это не даёт потребителям отключиться без надобности.

uz: Turbina 'casing' (korpus) ichki qismlarini o'rab turadi va bug'/gaz bosimini ushlab turadi. Korpus notekis qizisa yoki sovusa, u ham deformatsiyalanishi mumkin.
en: The turbine casing surrounds the internal parts and contains the steam/gas pressure. If the casing heats or cools unevenly, it too can deform.
ru: Быстродействие — это то, насколько быстро защита устраняет неисправность. В высоковольтных сетях (330-500 кВ) короткое замыкание должно устраняться за 0,06-0,08 секунды.

uz: 'Blowout' yoki 'blow' operatsiyasi — quvurlardagi qoldiq va iflosliklarni yuqori tezlikdagi oqim bilan uchirib tozalash. Yangi tizimlar ishga tushishdan oldin shunday tozalanadi.
en: A 'blowout' or 'blow' operation cleans pipes by blasting out debris with high-velocity flow. New systems are cleaned this way before commissioning.
ru: Чувствительность — способность обнаружить даже самую малую неисправность. Она должна быть достаточной во всех режимах системы, даже в минимальном.

uz: Nazorat tizimi (control system) turbinaning 'miyasi' — u yuzlab datchiklardan ma'lumot olib, yoqilg'i, klapanlar va tezlikni real vaqtda boshqaradi.
en: The control system is the turbine's 'brain' — it reads hundreds of sensors and manages fuel, valves and speed in real time.
ru: Надёжность означает, что защита срабатывает, когда нужно, и не срабатывает ложно, когда не нужно. Простота схемы и качественные элементы повышают надёжность.

uz: Turbinada 'trip' — xavf paydo bo'lganda (masalan haddan tashqari tezlik yoki vibratsiya) turbinani zudlik bilan xavfsiz to'xtatuvchi himoya tizimi.
en: A 'trip' is a protection function that instantly and safely shuts down the turbine when a danger appears, such as overspeed or excessive vibration.
ru: Основная защита предназначена устранять неисправность первой. Если она не сработает, резервная защита берёт на себя её функцию и устраняет неисправность.

uz: HRSG'da suv bir necha bosim darajasida bug'ga aylantiriladi (HP, IP, LP) — bu chiqindi gaz issiqligidan imkon qadar ko'proq foydalanish imkonini beradi.
en: In an HRSG, water is turned to steam at several pressure levels (HP, IP, LP), which extracts as much heat as possible from the exhaust gas.
ru: Реле — это устройство, которое срабатывает, когда входная величина (ток, напряжение) превышает заданное значение. Оно замыкает контакты и подаёт команду отключения выключателю.

uz: 'Deaerator' — suvdan erigan kislorod va gazlarni chiqarib tashlaydigan qurilma. Kislorod metallni yemiradi (korroziya), shuning uchun bug' tizimidan oldin olib tashlanadi.
en: A deaerator removes dissolved oxygen and gases from water. Oxygen corrodes metal, so it is stripped out before the water enters the steam system.
ru: Токовая защита следит за током в сети. При коротком замыкании ток резко возрастает — защита это обнаруживает и отключает цепь.

uz: Bug' quvurlari juda issiq bo'lgani uchun kengayadi. Shuning uchun quvurlarda maxsus 'kengayish' bo'g'inlari va tayanchlar bo'lib, ular harakatga imkon beradi.
en: Steam pipes get very hot and expand. That is why piping has special expansion joints and supports that allow movement without breaking.
ru: Максимальная токовая защита (МТЗ) срабатывает, когда ток превышает заданный порог. Это самый простой и распространённый вид защиты.

uz: Stansiya 'baseload' (doimiy to'liq quvvat) yoki 'cycling' (kun davomida quvvatni o'zgartirib) rejimida ishlashi mumkin. Tez-tez ishga tushirish/to'xtatish jihozlarni ko'proq charchatadi.
en: A plant can run 'baseload' (constant full power) or 'cycling' (varying power through the day). Frequent starts and stops wear equipment more.
ru: Трансформатор тока (ТТ) преобразует большой ток сети в малый измеримый (например 5 А или 1 А). Реле работает с этим малым током.

uz: Gaz turbinasi tashqi havo haroratiga sezgir: issiq havoda havo zichligi kamayadi, shuning uchun yozda turbina quvvati biroz pasayadi.
en: A gas turbine is sensitive to ambient air temperature: hot air is less dense, so the turbine's power output drops slightly in summer.
ru: Дифференциальная защита сравнивает ток, входящий в защищаемый элемент, и выходящий из него. В норме они равны; разница означает внутреннюю неисправность.

uz: Ba'zi stansiyalarda 'inlet air cooling' bo'ladi — kirayotgan havoni sovutib, uni zichroq qiladi va issiq kunlarda quvvatni tiklaydi.
en: Some plants use inlet air cooling — chilling the incoming air to make it denser and recover power on hot days.
ru: Газовая защита (реле Бухгольца) реагирует на газ, образующийся при внутренней неисправности в масляном трансформаторе. При лёгкой неисправности подаёт сигнал, при тяжёлой — отключает.

uz: Combined cycle stansiyasi to'liq ishga tushishi (sovuq holatdan) bir necha soat davom etishi mumkin, chunki barcha qismlar bosqichma-bosqich qizdirilishi kerak.
en: Starting a combined cycle plant fully from cold can take several hours, because all components must be warmed up gradually.
ru: Дистанционная защита измеряет расстояние (сопротивление) до места неисправности. Ближнюю неисправность отключает быстро, дальнюю — медленнее, что обеспечивает селективность.

uz: 'Hot', 'warm' va 'cold' start farqlanadi: turbina qanchalik uzoq to'xtagan bo'lsa, u shunchalik sovigan va ishga tushirish shuncha uzoq davom etadi.
en: Starts are classed as hot, warm or cold: the longer a turbine has been stopped, the cooler it is and the longer startup takes.
ru: Различают hot, warm и cold start: чем дольше турбина простаивала, тем сильнее она остыла и тем дольше длится запуск.

uz: Xavfsizlik birinchi o'rinda: stansiyada gaz sizishi, yong'in va bosim uchun ko'plab datchiklar va avtomatik himoya tizimlari o'rnatilgan.
en: Safety comes first: a plant has many sensors and automatic protection systems for gas leaks, fire and pressure.
ru: Безопасность прежде всего: на станции установлено множество датчиков и автоматических систем защиты от утечки газа, пожара и давления.

uz: Gaz turbinasi bo'limida yong'in xavfi yuqori, shuning uchun ko'pincha CO₂ yoki maxsus gaz bilan avtomatik o't o'chirish tizimi bo'ladi, u kislorodni siqib chiqaradi.
en: The gas turbine compartment has high fire risk, so it often has an automatic CO₂ or special-gas fire suppression system that displaces oxygen.
ru: В отсеке газовой турбины высокая пожароопасность, поэтому часто устанавливается автоматическая система пожаротушения на CO₂ или специальном газе, вытесняющем кислород.

uz: Stansiyaning yuragi — nazorat xonasi (control room), u yerda operatorlar ekranlar orqali butun stansiyani kuzatadi va boshqaradi.
en: The heart of the plant is the control room, where operators monitor and control the entire station through screens.
ru: Сердце станции — щит управления (control room), где операторы через экраны наблюдают и управляют всей станцией.

uz: IGV (Inlet Guide Vanes) — kompressor kirishidagi burilib turadigan yo'naltiruvchi pichoqlar. Ular kirayotgan havo miqdorini rostlab, turbina quvvatini nozik boshqaradi.
en: IGVs (Inlet Guide Vanes) are adjustable vanes at the compressor inlet. They regulate the amount of incoming air, giving fine control over turbine power.
ru: IGV (Inlet Guide Vanes) — поворотные направляющие лопатки на входе компрессора. Регулируя количество поступающего воздуха, они тонко управляют мощностью турбины.

uz: IGV pichoqlari ishga tushirishda yopiq turadi (kam havo), turbina quvvati oshgani sari asta-sekin ochiladi — bu barqaror va samarali ishlashni ta'minlaydi.
en: IGVs stay nearly closed during startup (less air) and gradually open as power rises, ensuring stable and efficient operation.
ru: Лопатки IGV при запуске закрыты (мало воздуха) и постепенно открываются по мере роста мощности — это обеспечивает устойчивую и эффективную работу.

uz: VV (Variable Vanes) — kompressorning keyingi bosqichlaridagi o'zgaruvchan pichoqlar. Ular IGV bilan birga havo oqimini moslashtirib, kompressorni 'surge' (silkinish) dan saqlaydi.
en: VVs (Variable Vanes) are adjustable vanes in later compressor stages. Together with the IGVs they tune airflow and protect the compressor from surge.
ru: VV (Variable Vanes) — регулируемые лопатки на последующих ступенях компрессора. Вместе с IGV они подстраивают поток воздуха и защищают компрессор от помпажа (surge).

uz: IGV va VV burchagi LVDT deb ataladigan aniq datchik bilan o'lchanadi — u pichoqning holatini elektr signalga aylantiradi.
en: IGV and VV angles are measured by a precise sensor called an LVDT, which converts vane position into an electrical signal.
ru: Угол IGV и VV измеряется точным датчиком LVDT — он преобразует положение лопатки в электрический сигнал.

uz: Turbina rotori disklardan yig'iladi. Ular 'CURVIC coupling' — tishli yuzalar orqali bir-biriga aniq va mustahkam ulanadi, bu markazlashuvni saqlaydi.
en: The turbine rotor is assembled from discs joined by a 'CURVIC coupling' — precisely toothed faces that lock them together accurately and keep them centered.
ru: Ротор турбины собирается из дисков. Они точно и прочно соединяются через зубчатые поверхности CURVIC coupling, что сохраняет центровку.

uz: Rotor disklari ichidan uzun tortuvchi val (tie bolt/tie rod) o'tadi va ularni birga siqib ushlaydi — go'yo boncuklarni ipga terganday.
en: A long central tie bolt runs through the rotor discs and clamps them together, much like beads threaded on a string.
ru: Сквозь диски ротора проходит длинный стяжной вал (tie bolt/tie rod), сжимающий их вместе — словно бусины на нити.

uz: Gaz turbinasida ikki xil podshipnik bor: 'journal bearing' valni yon tomondan ushlaydi (aylanishga), 'thrust bearing' esa uni o'q bo'ylab siljishdan ushlab turadi.
en: A gas turbine has two bearing types: journal bearings support the shaft radially (for rotation), while the thrust bearing holds it against axial movement.
ru: В газовой турбине два типа подшипников: опорный (journal bearing) держит вал сбоку (для вращения), а упорный (thrust bearing) удерживает его от осевого смещения.

uz: Zamonaviy turbinalarda 'tilting-pad' (egiluvchi tagliksimon) podshipniklar ishlatiladi — ular yuqori tezlikda barqaror va vibratsiyaga chidamli.
en: Modern turbines use 'tilting-pad' bearings — their pads pivot to stay stable at high speed and resist vibration.
ru: В современных турбинах применяют сегментные подшипники (tilting-pad) — они устойчивы на высокой скорости и стойки к вибрации.

uz: Podshipnik va val orasida yupqa moy pardasi bo'ladi — metal metallga tegmaydi, faqat moy qatlamida 'suzadi'. Bu ishqalanishni deyarli yo'qqa chiqaradi.
en: A thin oil film sits between bearing and shaft — metal never touches metal, the shaft 'floats' on oil. This nearly eliminates friction.
ru: Между подшипником и валом есть тонкая плёнка масла — металл не касается металла, вал 'плавает' в слое масла. Это почти устраняет трение.

uz: 'Seal' (zichlagich) — gaz, bug' yoki moyning kerakmas joyga o'tib ketishining oldini oladi. Turbinalarda ko'pincha 'labirint zichlagich' — ko'p tishli tor yo'lak ishlatiladi.
en: A seal prevents gas, steam or oil from leaking where it shouldn't. Turbines often use a 'labyrinth seal' — a narrow, many-toothed path that restricts flow.
ru: Уплотнение (seal) предотвращает утечку газа, пара или масла в ненужное место. В турбинах часто применяют лабиринтное уплотнение — узкий канал с множеством зубьев.

uz: Labirint zichlagich oqimni to'liq to'smaydi, balki uni ko'p burilishlar orqali sekinlashtiradi — har burilishda bosim tushadi va sizish kamayadi.
en: A labyrinth seal doesn't fully block flow but slows it through many turns — pressure drops at each turn, reducing leakage.
ru: Лабиринтное уплотнение не перекрывает поток полностью, а замедляет его множеством поворотов — на каждом повороте давление падает и утечка уменьшается.

uz: M701JAC — Mitsubishi Power'ning yirik, yuqori haroratli gaz turbinasi. 'J-class' turbinalar dunyodagi eng samarali gaz turbinalari qatoriga kiradi.
en: The M701JAC is a large, high-temperature gas turbine from Mitsubishi Power. 'J-class' turbines are among the most efficient gas turbines in the world.
ru: M701JAC — крупная высокотемпературная газовая турбина Mitsubishi Power. Турбины J-class входят в число самых эффективных газовых турбин в мире.

uz: J-class gaz turbinalari ~1600°C harorat sinfida ishlaydi — harorat qancha yuqori bo'lsa, sikl shuncha samarali, lekin materiallar shuncha ko'proq sinovga tushadi.
en: J-class gas turbines operate at a ~1600°C temperature class — the higher the temperature, the more efficient the cycle, but the more the materials are tested.
ru: Газовые турбины J-class работают в температурном классе ~1600°C — чем выше температура, тем эффективнее цикл, но тем большему испытанию подвергаются материалы.

uz: Yonish kamerasi (combustor) yoqilg'i va havoni aralashtirib yoqadi. Zamonaviy 'quruq past-emissiya' (DLN) kameralar azot oksidi (NOx) chiqindisini kamaytiradi.
en: The combustor mixes and burns fuel with air. Modern 'dry low-emission' (DLN) combustors reduce nitrogen oxide (NOx) emissions.
ru: Камера сгорания (combustor) смешивает и сжигает топливо с воздухом. Современные камеры сухого низкоэмиссионного горения (DLN) снижают выброс оксида азота (NOx).

uz: DLN yonish kamerasi yoqilg'ini havo bilan oldindan yaxshi aralashtiradi — bu tekisroq, sovuqroq yonishni beradi va zararli NOx chiqindisini pasaytiradi.
en: A DLN combustor pre-mixes fuel thoroughly with air, giving a more even, cooler flame that lowers harmful NOx emissions.
ru: Камера DLN заранее хорошо смешивает топливо с воздухом — это даёт более равномерное, холодное горение и снижает вредный выброс NOx.

uz: 'Transition piece' — yonish kamerasi bilan turbinaning birinchi bosqichini bog'laydigan qism. U eng issiq gaz oqimiga bardosh berishi kerak.
en: A 'transition piece' connects the combustor to the turbine's first stage. It must withstand the hottest gas flow in the engine.
ru: Transition piece — деталь, соединяющая камеру сгорания с первой ступенью турбины. Она должна выдерживать самый горячий поток газа.

uz: Turbinaning eng issiq qismlariga 'termik bariyer qoplama' (TBC) — keramik qatlam suriladi. U metallni issiqdan izolatsiya qiladi, xuddi issiqqaytmas termos kabi.
en: The hottest turbine parts get a 'thermal barrier coating' (TBC) — a ceramic layer that insulates the metal from heat, like a heat-proof shield.
ru: На самые горячие части турбины наносят термобарьерное покрытие (TBC) — керамический слой. Оно изолирует металл от жара, как термос.

uz: Generator ikki asosiy qismdan iborat: 'rotor' (aylanuvchi, magnit maydon yaratadi) va 'stator' (qo'zg'almas, unda elektr toki hosil bo'ladi).
en: A generator has two main parts: the rotor (rotating, creates a magnetic field) and the stator (stationary, where electric current is induced).
ru: Генератор состоит из двух основных частей: ротор (вращающийся, создаёт магнитное поле) и статор (неподвижный, в нём образуется электрический ток).

uz: Generator rotori aslida katta aylanuvchi elektromagnit — u 'excitation' (qo'zg'atish) toki bilan magnitlanadi va statorda kuchlanish hosil qiladi.
en: A generator rotor is essentially a large spinning electromagnet — it is magnetized by an 'excitation' current and induces voltage in the stator.
ru: Ротор генератора — это по сути большой вращающийся электромагнит; он намагничивается током возбуждения (excitation) и создаёт напряжение в статоре.

uz: 'Exciter' (qo'zg'atgich) generator rotoriga magnitlash tokini beradi. Bu tokni o'zgartirib, generator chiqishidagi kuchlanish boshqariladi.
en: An 'exciter' supplies the magnetizing current to the generator rotor. Adjusting this current controls the generator's output voltage.
ru: Возбудитель (exciter) подаёт ток намагничивания на ротор генератора. Изменяя этот ток, управляют напряжением на выходе генератора.

uz: Vodorod bilan sovutiladigan generatorlarda vodorod sizib chiqmasligi uchun val atrofida 'moy zichlagich' (seal oil) tizimi bo'ladi.
en: In hydrogen-cooled generators, a 'seal oil' system around the shaft prevents hydrogen from leaking out.
ru: В генераторах с водородным охлаждением вокруг вала есть система уплотнительного масла (seal oil), чтобы водород не вытекал наружу.

uz: Generator ichidagi vodorod havo bilan aralashsa portlash xavfli, shuning uchun to'ldirish oldidan tizim inert gaz (CO₂) bilan tozalanadi.
en: Hydrogen inside a generator is explosive if mixed with air, so before filling, the system is purged with an inert gas (CO₂).
ru: Водород внутри генератора взрывоопасен при смешении с воздухом, поэтому перед заполнением систему продувают инертным газом (CO₂).

uz: Katta generatorlarda stator o'ramlari to'g'ridan-to'g'ri suv bilan ham sovutilishi mumkin — toza distillangan suv ichi bo'sh mis o'tkazgichlar orqali o'tadi.
en: In large generators the stator windings can be cooled directly by water — pure distilled water flows through hollow copper conductors.
ru: В больших генераторах обмотки статора могут охлаждаться напрямую водой — чистая дистиллированная вода проходит через полые медные проводники.

uz: Generatorni sovutish uchun ishlatiladigan suv juda toza (deionlangan) bo'lishi kerak — oddiy suv elektr tokini o'tkazib, qisqa tutashuvga olib kelardi.
en: Water used to cool a generator must be ultra-pure (deionized) — ordinary water would conduct electricity and cause a short circuit.
ru: Вода для охлаждения генератора должна быть очень чистой (деионизированной) — обычная вода проводила бы ток и вызвала короткое замыкание.

uz: HRSG ichida 'economizer', 'evaporator' va 'superheater' bo'limlari bor. Suv avval isitiladi, keyin bug'ga aylantiriladi, so'ng bug' yana qizdiriladi.
en: An HRSG contains economizer, evaporator and superheater sections. Water is first heated, then boiled to steam, then the steam is further heated.
ru: Внутри HRSG есть секции economizer, evaporator и superheater. Вода сначала нагревается, затем превращается в пар, после чего пар ещё раз перегревается.

uz: 'Superheater' bug'ni qaynash haroratidan yuqoriroq qizdiradi — quruq, yuqori energiyali bug' turbina pichoqlarini namlik shikastidan saqlaydi.
en: A superheater heats steam above its boiling point — dry, high-energy steam protects turbine blades from moisture damage.
ru: Пароперегреватель (superheater) нагревает пар выше температуры кипения — сухой, высокоэнергетический пар защищает лопатки турбины от повреждения влагой.

uz: 'Economizer' — HRSG'ning eng oxirgi (eng sovuq gaz) qismi. U qolgan issiqlikni suvni oldindan isitishga sarflab, samaradorlikni oshiradi.
en: An economizer is the last (coolest gas) section of the HRSG. It uses remaining heat to preheat water, boosting efficiency.
ru: Economizer — самая последняя (с самым холодным газом) секция HRSG. Расходуя остаточное тепло на подогрев воды, он повышает КПД.

uz: 'Steam drum' (bug' baraboni) — HRSG'da suv va bug'ni ajratadigan idish. Bug' yuqoriga chiqadi, suv esa qaytadan aylanishga tushadi.
en: A steam drum in an HRSG separates water from steam. Steam rises off the top while water returns to circulate again.
ru: Барабан пара (steam drum) — ёмкость в HRSG, отделяющая воду от пара. Пар уходит вверх, а вода возвращается в циркуляцию.

uz: Bug' turbinasiga kirayotgan bug' juda toza bo'lishi kerak — undagi mayda tuz zarralari pichoqlarga o'tirib, ularni yemirishi mumkin.
en: Steam entering the steam turbine must be very clean — tiny salt particles in it can deposit on blades and corrode them.
ru: Пар, поступающий в паровую турбину, должен быть очень чистым — мелкие частицы соли в нём могут оседать на лопатках и разъедать их.

uz: Kondensator minglab yupqa quvurchalardan iborat — ular ichidan sovutuvchi suv o'tadi, tashqarisida bug' sovib suvga aylanadi.
en: A condenser is made of thousands of thin tubes — cooling water flows inside them while steam condenses to water on the outside.
ru: Конденсатор состоит из тысяч тонких трубок — внутри них проходит охлаждающая вода, а снаружи пар остывает и превращается в воду.

uz: Kondensatordagi sovutish ba'zan daryo/dengiz suvi bilan, ba'zan esa 'sovutish minorasi' (cooling tower) orqali havoda amalga oshiriladi.
en: Condenser cooling is sometimes done with river/sea water, and sometimes through a cooling tower that rejects heat to the air.
ru: Охлаждение в конденсаторе иногда идёт речной/морской водой, а иногда через градирню (cooling tower) в воздухе.

uz: Sovutish minorasida issiq suv yupqa parda bo'lib tushadi va havo bilan uchrashadi — bir qismi bug'lanib, qolganini sovutadi. Oq 'tutun' aslida suv bug'i.
en: In a cooling tower hot water falls as a thin film and meets air — part evaporates, cooling the rest. The white 'smoke' is actually water vapor.
ru: В градирне горячая вода стекает тонкой плёнкой и встречается с воздухом — часть испаряется, охлаждая остальную. Белый 'дым' — на самом деле водяной пар.

uz: Nasoslar stansiyada suv va moyni harakatga keltiradi. 'Boiler feed pump' (qozon oziqlantirish nasosi) suvni yuqori bosim ostida HRSG'ga haydaydi.
en: Pumps move water and oil around the plant. The boiler feed pump forces water into the HRSG at high pressure.
ru: Насосы перемещают воду и масло по станции. Питательный насос котла (boiler feed pump) под высоким давлением подаёт воду в HRSG.

uz: Boiler feed pump stansiyadagi eng quvvatli nasoslardan biri — u suvni o'nlab atmosfera bosimigacha siqib haydaydi.
en: The boiler feed pump is one of the most powerful pumps in the plant — it pushes water up to dozens of atmospheres of pressure.
ru: Питательный насос котла — один из самых мощных насосов станции; он сжимает и подаёт воду до давления в десятки атмосфер.

uz: 'Valve' (klapan) suyuqlik yoki gaz oqimini ochadi, yopadi yoki rostlaydi. Turbinada 'control valve' bug' oqimini nozik boshqarib, quvvatni belgilaydi.
en: A valve opens, closes or regulates flow of liquid or gas. In a turbine, a control valve finely manages steam flow to set the power.
ru: Клапан (valve) открывает, закрывает или регулирует поток жидкости или газа. В турбине регулирующий клапан (control valve) тонко управляет потоком пара, задавая мощность.

uz: 'Stop valve' (to'xtatish klapani) favqulodda holatda bug'ni bir zumda to'liq to'sadi — bu turbinani himoya qiladigan tez ta'sirli qurilma.
en: A stop valve instantly and fully blocks steam in an emergency — a fast-acting device that protects the turbine.
ru: Стопорный клапан (stop valve) в аварийной ситуации мгновенно полностью перекрывает пар — это быстродействующее устройство защиты турбины.

uz: Turbina 'diffuser' orqali chiqindi gazni sekinlashtiradi. Oqimni sekinlashtirish bosimni tiklaydi va turbinadan ko'proq energiya olishga yordam beradi.
en: A turbine exhausts through a 'diffuser' that slows the gas. Slowing the flow recovers pressure and helps extract more energy from the turbine.
ru: Турбина замедляет выхлопной газ через диффузор. Замедление потока восстанавливает давление и помогает извлечь из турбины больше энергии.

uz: Kompressor pichoqlari kirishdan chiqishga tomon kichrayib boradi — havo siqilib zichlashgani sari kichikroq hajm kerak bo'ladi.
en: Compressor blades get smaller from inlet to outlet — as air is compressed and gets denser, less volume is needed.
ru: Лопатки компрессора уменьшаются от входа к выходу — по мере сжатия и уплотнения воздуха требуется меньший объём.

uz: 'Surge' — kompressorda havo oqimi teskari yo'nalishga urilib ketadigan xavfli hodisa. IGV/VV va boshqaruv tizimi buni oldini oladi.
en: 'Surge' is a dangerous event where airflow reverses in the compressor. The IGV/VV and control system work to prevent it.
ru: Помпаж (surge) — опасное явление, при котором поток воздуха в компрессоре устремляется в обратную сторону. IGV/VV и система управления предотвращают его.

uz: Turbina 'enclosure' (qobiq/kabina) ichiga joylashtiriladi — bu shovqinni kamaytiradi, issiqlikni ushlaydi va yong'in himoyasini osonlashtiradi.
en: A turbine sits inside an enclosure — this reduces noise, contains heat, and makes fire protection easier.
ru: Турбину размещают в кожухе/кабине (enclosure) — это снижает шум, удерживает тепло и облегчает противопожарную защиту.

uz: Gaz turbinasi kabinasi ichida havo doimiy almashtirilib turiladi (ventilyatsiya) — sizib chiqishi mumkin bo'lgan gazni tarqatib, portlash xavfini kamaytiradi.
en: The gas turbine enclosure is continuously ventilated — this disperses any leaking gas and reduces explosion risk.
ru: Внутри кабины газовой турбины воздух постоянно обновляется (вентиляция) — это рассеивает возможные утечки газа и снижает опасность взрыва.

uz: 'Instrument air' (asbob havosi) — toza, quruq siqilgan havo. U klapan va boshqaruv qurilmalarini harakatga keltiradi. Nam havo asboblarni buzishi mumkin.
en: 'Instrument air' is clean, dry compressed air that drives valves and control devices. Moist air could damage the instruments.
ru: Приборный воздух (instrument air) — чистый, сухой сжатый воздух. Он приводит в действие клапаны и устройства управления. Влажный воздух может испортить приборы.

uz: SFC (Static Frequency Converter) — gaz turbinasini ishga tushirishda generatorni motor sifatida ishlatib, rotorni aylantiradigan elektron qurilma. Ya'ni generatorning o'zi 'starter' bo'ladi.
en: An SFC (Static Frequency Converter) is an electronic device that spins the rotor at startup by running the generator as a motor. The generator itself becomes the 'starter'.
ru: SFC (Static Frequency Converter) — электронное устройство, которое при запуске газовой турбины использует генератор как двигатель и раскручивает ротор. То есть генератор сам становится стартером.

uz: SFC yordamida alohida ishga tushirish dvigateli kerak bo'lmaydi — generator ham motor, ham tok manbai vazifasini bajaradi, bu joy va xarajatni tejaydi.
en: With an SFC no separate starting motor is needed — the generator acts as both motor and power source, saving space and cost.
ru: С помощью SFC не нужен отдельный пусковой двигатель — генератор выполняет роль и двигателя, и источника тока, что экономит место и затраты.

uz: Generator 'step-up transformer' orqali to'rga ulanadi. U generatorning past kuchlanishini (masalan ~20 kV) uzatish uchun yuqori kuchlanishga (masalan 220/500 kV) ko'taradi.
en: A generator connects to the grid through a step-up transformer, raising the generator's low voltage (~20 kV) to a high transmission voltage (e.g. 220/500 kV).
ru: Генератор подключается к сети через повышающий трансформатор (step-up). Он поднимает низкое напряжение генератора (например ~20 кВ) до высокого для передачи (например 220/500 кВ).

uz: Transformatorda harakatlanuvchi qism yo'q, lekin u qiziydi. Yirik transformatorlar moy bilan sovutiladi — moy ham izolatsiya, ham issiqlikni chiqarish vazifasini bajaradi.
en: A transformer has no moving parts but heats up. Large transformers are oil-cooled — the oil both insulates and carries away heat.
ru: У трансформатора нет движущихся частей, но он нагревается. Крупные трансформаторы охлаждаются маслом — масло служит и изоляцией, и отводит тепло.

uz: Transformator ikki g'altakdan iborat: 'birlamchi' kirish tokini oladi, 'ikkilamchi' o'zgargan kuchlanishni beradi. G'altaklar orasidagi o'ram soni nisbati kuchlanishni belgilaydi.
en: A transformer has two coils: the primary takes the input, the secondary gives the transformed voltage. The ratio of coil turns sets the voltage change.

uz: 'Excitation cubicle' (qo'zg'atish shkafi) generator rotoriga o'zgarmas tok beradi. Bu tok rotorni magnitlab, generator kuchlanishini boshqaradi.
en: The excitation cubicle supplies DC current to the generator rotor. This current magnetizes the rotor and controls the generator's voltage.

uz: AVR (Automatic Voltage Regulator) qo'zg'atish tokini avtomatik rostlab, generator kuchlanishini barqaror ushlaydi — yuklama o'zgarsa ham kuchlanish tekis qoladi.
en: An AVR (Automatic Voltage Regulator) automatically adjusts the excitation current to keep the generator voltage steady even as load changes.

uz: 'Neutral grounding' (neytral yerlashtirish) generator neytral nuqtasini yerga ulaydi. Nosozlik yuz berganda bu tokni xavfsiz yo'naltirib, jihozni himoya qiladi.
en: Neutral grounding connects the generator's neutral point to earth. During a fault it safely channels current, protecting equipment.

uz: Generator neytrali ko'pincha to'g'ridan-to'g'ri emas, balki rezistor yoki transformator orqali yerlashtiriladi — bu nosozlik tokini xavfsiz darajada cheklaydi.
en: A generator neutral is often grounded through a resistor or transformer rather than directly — this limits fault current to a safe level.

uz: 'Circuit breaker' (avtomatik uzgich) nosozlik yoki ortiqcha tok paydo bo'lganda elektr zanjirini bir zumda uzadi. U elektr tarmog'ining asosiy himoyachisi.
en: A circuit breaker instantly disconnects an electrical circuit when a fault or overcurrent appears. It is the main protector of the electrical network.

uz: Yuqori kuchlanishli avtomatik uzgichlar yoyni (uchqun) o'chirish uchun maxsus muhitdan foydalanadi — masalan SF₆ gazi yoki vakuum, chunki oddiy havoda yoy uzoq yonadi.
en: High-voltage breakers use a special medium to quench the arc — such as SF₆ gas or vacuum — because in ordinary air the arc would persist.

uz: 'Busbar' (shina) — elektr energiyasini bir necha zanjirga taqsimlaydigan metall o'tkazgich. U stansiyaning elektr 'chorrahasi' kabidir.
en: A busbar is a metal conductor that distributes electric power to several circuits. It acts like an electrical 'junction' of the plant.

uz: 'Switchgear' — avtomatik uzgich, ajratgich va himoya qurilmalarini birlashtirgan panel/shkaflar to'plami. U elektr oqimini xavfsiz ulash va uzishni ta'minlaydi.
en: 'Switchgear' is an assembly of breakers, disconnectors and protection devices. It enables safe connection and disconnection of electrical power.

uz: 'Protective relay' (himoya rele) — elektr tarmog'ini kuzatib, nosozlik (masalan qisqa tutashuv) sezilsa avtomatik uzgichga uzish buyrug'ini beradigan 'aqlli qorovul'.
en: A protective relay is a 'smart guard' that monitors the electrical network and, on sensing a fault such as a short circuit, commands the breaker to trip.

uz: Zamonaviy himoya releleri raqamli — ular tok va kuchlanishni sekundiga minglab marta o'lchab, nosozlikni bir soniyaning ulushida aniqlaydi.
en: Modern protective relays are digital — they measure current and voltage thousands of times per second and detect faults in a fraction of a second.

uz: 'Current transformer' (CT) katta tokni kichik, o'lchash mumkin bo'lgan tokka aylantiradi. Bu himoya relelariga xavfsiz signal beradi.
en: A current transformer (CT) scales a large current down to a small, measurable one. This gives protective relays a safe signal to work with.

uz: 'Voltage transformer' (VT/PT) yuqori kuchlanishni past, xavfsiz kuchlanishga aylantirib, o'lchash va himoya asboblarini ta'minlaydi.
en: A voltage transformer (VT/PT) steps high voltage down to a low, safe level to feed measuring and protection instruments.

uz: 'Ignition system' (yoqish tizimi) gaz turbinasida yonishni boshlaydi. U elektr uchqun (svecha) bilan yoqilg'i-havo aralashmasini alangalatadi, xuddi zajigalka kabi.
en: The ignition system starts combustion in a gas turbine. It lights the fuel-air mixture with an electric spark (igniter), much like a lighter.

uz: Yonish boshlangandan keyin uchqun kerak emas — alanga o'zini o'zi tutib turadi, xuddi gaz plitasi yongandan keyin uchqun o'chirilgani kabi.
en: Once combustion begins the spark is no longer needed — the flame sustains itself, like a gas stove that keeps burning after the spark stops.

uz: 'Flame detector' (alanga datchigi) yonish kamerasida alanga bor-yo'qligini kuzatadi. Agar alanga o'chib qolsa, u yoqilg'ini darhol to'xtatib, portlash xavfini oldini oladi.
en: A flame detector watches whether a flame is present in the combustor. If the flame goes out, it stops the fuel immediately to prevent an explosion risk.

uz: 'Rotor grounding device' generator validagi statik zaryadni yerga chiqaradi. Bunday zaryad to'planib qolsa, podshipnik yuzalariga uchqun urib, ularni yemirishi mumkin.
en: A rotor grounding device drains static charge from the generator shaft to earth. If such charge built up, it could spark across bearing surfaces and erode them.

uz: Aylanuvchi val ishqalanish va magnit ta'siridan elektr zaryad to'playdi — grounding cho'tkasi bu zaryadni xavfsiz yerga uzatadi.
en: A rotating shaft accumulates electric charge from friction and magnetic effects — a grounding brush safely conducts this charge to earth.

uz: Stansiyada elektr uch darajada bo'ladi: yuqori kuchlanish (to'rga uzatish), o'rta kuchlanish (yirik motorlar) va past kuchlanish (yoritish, asboblar).
en: A plant has electricity at three levels: high voltage (grid transmission), medium voltage (large motors), and low voltage (lighting, instruments).

uz: Stansiyaning o'zi ham elektr iste'mol qiladi (nasoslar, ventilyatorlar, boshqaruv) — bu 'auxiliary power' deb ataladi va odatda generator quvvatining bir necha foizini tashkil qiladi.
en: A plant also consumes electricity itself (pumps, fans, controls) — this 'auxiliary power' is typically a few percent of the generator's output.

uz: 'Auxiliary transformer' generator ishlab chiqargan tokning bir qismini stansiyaning o'z ehtiyojlari uchun pasaytiradi — motorlar va asboblarni ta'minlaydi.
en: An auxiliary transformer steps down part of the generated power for the plant's own needs — feeding motors and instruments.

uz: Stansiya butunlay tokdan uzilib qolsa ham xavfsiz to'xtashi uchun 'emergency power' — akkumulyator (batareya) va dizel-generator zaxirasi bo'ladi.
en: So a plant can shut down safely even if it loses all power, there is 'emergency power' — battery banks and a backup diesel generator.

uz: Akkumulyatorlar (DC batareya) boshqaruv va himoya tizimlarini tok yo'qolganda ham bir muddat ta'minlab turadi — bu turbinani xavfsiz to'xtatishga imkon beradi.
en: Battery banks (DC) keep control and protection systems running for a while during a power loss — enabling a safe turbine shutdown.

uz: 'UPS' (Uzluksiz ta'minlash manbai) muhim asboblarga tokni bir zumda ham uzilmasdan yetkazadi — batareya va inverter orqali ishlaydi.
en: A UPS (Uninterruptible Power Supply) delivers power to critical instruments without even a momentary break — via battery and inverter.

uz: 'Grounding/earthing' butun stansiya bo'ylab metall qismlarni yerga ulaydigan tarmoq. U nosozlik tokini yerga chiqarib, odamlarni tok urishidan himoya qiladi.
en: Grounding (earthing) is a network connecting metal parts across the plant to earth. It channels fault current away and protects people from electric shock.

uz: Chaqmoqdan himoya uchun stansiyada 'lightning arrester' (chaqmoq o'tkazgich) bo'ladi — u chaqmoq zaryadini xavfsiz yerga yo'naltiradi.
en: For lightning protection a plant has lightning arresters that safely divert a lightning strike's charge to earth.

uz: Elektr motorlar stansiyada nasos va ventilyatorlarni harakatga keltiradi. Yirik motorlar to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ishga tushsa katta tok tortadi, shuning uchun ba'zan 'soft starter' ishlatiladi.
en: Electric motors drive pumps and fans in the plant. Large motors draw a big current if started directly, so a 'soft starter' is sometimes used.

uz: 'VFD' (o'zgaruvchan chastota drayveri) motor tezligini chastotani o'zgartirib boshqaradi — bu energiya tejaydi, chunki nasos har doim to'liq tezlikda aylanmaydi.
en: A VFD (Variable Frequency Drive) controls motor speed by varying frequency — this saves energy, since a pump need not always run at full speed.

uz: 'Power factor' — foydali quvvat va to'liq quvvat nisbati. U 1 ga qancha yaqin bo'lsa, elektr tarmog'i shuncha samarali ishlaydi.
en: 'Power factor' is the ratio of useful power to total power. The closer it is to 1, the more efficiently the electrical system works.

uz: Generator nafaqat 'aktiv' quvvat (vatt), balki 'reaktiv' quvvat (var) ham beradi — reaktiv quvvat to'r kuchlanishini barqaror ushlashga yordam beradi.
en: A generator supplies not only 'active' power (watts) but also 'reactive' power (vars) — reactive power helps keep the grid voltage stable.

uz: Generatorni to'rga ulash 'synchroscope' yoki avtomatik sinxronlashtirgich yordamida bajariladi — u faza mosligini kuzatib, aniq lahzada ulaydi.
en: Connecting a generator to the grid uses a synchroscope or automatic synchronizer — it watches phase alignment and connects at the exact moment.

uz: 'Cable tray' va 'conduit' — stansiya bo'ylab minglab kabellarni tartibli va himoyalangan holda olib boruvchi tizim. Kabellar issiqlik va shikastdan himoyalanadi.
en: Cable trays and conduits carry the plant's thousands of cables in an organized, protected way. Cables are shielded from heat and damage.

uz: Boshqaruv signallari uchun 'shielded cable' (ekranli kabel) ishlatiladi — metall ekran tashqi elektr shovqinni to'sib, signalni toza saqlaydi.
en: Control signals use shielded cable — a metal shield blocks external electrical noise, keeping the signal clean.

uz: Ko'p stansiyalarda optik tolali (fiber optic) aloqa ishlatiladi — u elektr shovqiniga befarq va ma'lumotni tez, ishonchli uzatadi.
en: Many plants use fiber optic communication — it is immune to electrical noise and transmits data fast and reliably.

uz: DCS (Distributed Control System) — butun stansiyani markazdan boshqaradigan raqamli tizim. Operatorlar bir necha ekran orqali minglab nuqtani kuzatadi.
en: A DCS (Distributed Control System) is the digital system that controls the whole plant centrally. Operators monitor thousands of points through a few screens.

uz: DCS 'distributed' (taqsimlangan) deyiladi, chunki boshqaruv bitta kompyuterda emas, ko'p kontrollerlarga taqsimlangan — biri ishlamay qolsa, tizim to'xtamaydi.
en: A DCS is called 'distributed' because control is spread across many controllers, not one computer — if one fails, the system keeps running.

uz: 'Inlet air filter' (kirish havo filtri) gaz turbinasiga kirayotgan havoni chang va zarrachalardan tozalaydi. Iflos havo kompressor pichoqlarini yeydi va FIKni pasaytiradi.
en: An inlet air filter cleans dust and particles from air entering the gas turbine. Dirty air erodes compressor blades and lowers efficiency.

uz: Yirik gaz turbinasi sekundiga yuzlab kilogramm havo yutadi — shuning uchun kirish havo filtri juda katta yuzali bo'ladi.
en: A large gas turbine ingests hundreds of kilograms of air per second — so its inlet air filter has a very large surface area.

uz: Filtrlar ifloslanib borgani sari havo o'tishiga qarshilik oshadi. Bu 'differential pressure' (bosim farqi) datchigi bilan kuzatiladi — farq oshsa, filtrni tozalash/almashtirish kerak.
en: As filters clog, resistance to airflow rises. This is watched with a differential pressure sensor — a growing difference signals it's time to clean or replace the filter.

uz: 'Exhaust system' (chiqindi tizimi) turbinadan chiqqan issiq gazni HRSG'ga yo'naltiradi. Combined cycle'da bu gaz behuda ketmay, bug' hosil qilishga ishlatiladi.
en: The exhaust system directs hot gas from the turbine to the HRSG. In combined cycle this gas isn't wasted but is used to raise steam.

uz: Chiqindi tizimi juda issiq gazga bardosh berishi kerak, shuning uchun ichkaridan issiqbardosh izolatsiya bilan qoplanadi va kengayish bo'g'inlariga ega bo'ladi.
en: The exhaust system must withstand very hot gas, so it is lined with heat-resistant insulation and has expansion joints.

uz: 'Fuel gas system' (yoqilg'i gaz tizimi) tabiiy gazni to'g'ri bosim va toza holatda turbinaga yetkazadi. Gaz avval filtrlanadi va suv/zarrachalardan tozalanadi.
en: The fuel gas system delivers natural gas to the turbine at the right pressure and cleanliness. The gas is first filtered and cleared of water and particles.

uz: Turbinaga kirayotgan yoqilg'i gazi ko'pincha 'fuel gas heater' bilan isitiladi — issiq gaz barqarorroq yonadi va sikl samaradorligini oshiradi.
en: Fuel gas entering the turbine is often warmed by a fuel gas heater — hotter gas burns more stably and improves cycle efficiency.

uz: Yoqilg'i gazidagi suyuq tomchilar xavfli — ular yonish kamerasiga kirsa, notekis yonish va shikast keltiradi. Shuning uchun 'scrubber/separator' suyuqlikni ajratadi.
en: Liquid droplets in fuel gas are dangerous — if they reach the combustor they cause uneven burning and damage. A scrubber/separator removes the liquid.

uz: 'Lube oil system' (moylash tizimi) turbina va generator podshipniklarini moy bilan ta'minlaydi. Moy podshipniklarni ham moylaydi, ham sovutadi.
en: The lube oil system supplies oil to turbine and generator bearings. The oil both lubricates and cools the bearings.

uz: 'Lube oil main pump' asosiy moy nasosi normal ishda moyni haydaydi. Agar u to'xtasa, 'emergency pump' (favqulodda nasos) darhol ishga tushib, moy uzluksizligini saqlaydi.
en: The lube oil main pump circulates oil in normal operation. If it fails, an emergency pump starts immediately to keep oil flowing without interruption.

uz: Favqulodda moy nasosi ko'pincha DC (batareya) tokida ishlaydi — shu bois butun stansiya tokdan uzilib qolsa ham, podshipniklar moysiz qolmaydi.
en: The emergency oil pump often runs on DC (battery) power — so even if the whole plant loses power, the bearings won't be left without oil.

uz: 'Lube oil cooler' (moy sovutgich) podshipniklardan qizib chiqqan moyni sovutadi. Odatda ikkita bo'ladi (A va B) — biri ishlaydi, ikkinchisi zaxira yoki almashish uchun.
en: A lube oil cooler cools the oil that returns hot from the bearings. There are usually two (A and B) — one working, the other on standby or for changeover.

uz: Moy juda sovuq bo'lsa quyuqlashadi va yaxshi oqmaydi, juda issiq bo'lsa yupqalashib himoya pardasini yo'qotadi. Shuning uchun moy harorati aniq oraliqda ushlanadi.
en: If oil is too cold it thickens and flows poorly; too hot and it thins, losing its protective film. So oil temperature is kept within a precise range.

uz: 'Lube oil filter' moydagi mayda metall zarralar va ifloslikni ushlaydi. Toza moy podshipniklarni yeyilishdan saqlaydi.
en: A lube oil filter traps fine metal particles and dirt in the oil. Clean oil protects bearings from wear.

uz: Moy tizimida ikkita filtr bo'lib, ular 'changeover' qilinadi — turbina ishlab turganda bir filtrdan boshqasiga o'tib, ifloslanganini almashtirish mumkin.
en: The oil system has two filters that can be 'changed over' — while the turbine runs, flow can switch from one to the other to replace a dirty filter.

uz: 'Lube oil accumulator' (moy akkumulyatori) bosim ostidagi moyni zaxira sifatida saqlaydi. Nasoslar orasidagi qisqa uzilishda ham moy uzatishni ta'minlaydi.
en: A lube oil accumulator stores pressurized oil as a reserve. It maintains oil supply even during a brief gap between pumps.

uz: 'Lube oil mist separator' — moy bakidan chiqadigan moy tumanini (bug'ini) ushlab, toza havoni chiqaradi. Bu moyni tejaydi va atrofni ifloslamaydi.
en: A lube oil mist separator captures oil mist (vapor) leaving the oil tank and releases clean air. This saves oil and avoids contaminating the surroundings.

uz: Moy baki ustida biroz past bosim (vakuum) ushlanadi — bu moy tumanini bir joyga yig'ib, sizib chiqishining oldini oladi.
en: A slight vacuum is kept above the oil tank — this collects the oil mist in one place and prevents it from leaking out.

uz: 'Lube oil heater' (moy isitgich) turbina ishga tushishidan oldin sovuq moyni isitadi. Iliq moy yaxshi oqadi va ishga tushishni osonlashtiradi.
en: A lube oil heater warms cold oil before startup. Warm oil flows well and makes starting easier.

uz: 'Control oil system' (boshqaruv moyi tizimi) — klapan va aktuatorlarni harakatga keltiradigan yuqori bosimli moy. U turbinani nozik boshqarish uchun ishlatiladi.
en: The control oil system is high-pressure oil that moves valves and actuators. It is used for precise control of the turbine.

uz: Boshqaruv moyi ko'pincha moylash moyidan alohida va yuqoriroq bosimda bo'ladi — chunki klapanlarni tez va aniq harakatga keltirish uchun katta kuch kerak.
en: Control oil is often separate from and at higher pressure than lube oil — because moving valves quickly and precisely needs greater force.

uz: 'Cooling air system' (sovutuvchi havo tizimi) kompressordan bir qism havoni olib, turbinaning eng issiq qismlarini (pichoq, disk) sovutishga yo'naltiradi.
en: The cooling air system takes some air from the compressor and directs it to cool the turbine's hottest parts (blades, discs).

uz: Turbinani sovutish uchun kompressor havosining bir qismi 'qurbon qilinadi' — u foydali ishdan chetlashtiriladi, lekin bu qismlarni erib ketishdan saqlaydi.
en: Some compressor air is 'sacrificed' to cool the turbine — it is taken away from useful work, but it saves parts from melting.

uz: 'Cooling air cooler' sovutuvchi havoni ishlatishdan oldin sovutadi — sovuqroq havo turbina qismlarini yaxshiroq sovutadi va ularning umrini uzaytiradi.
en: A cooling air cooler chills the cooling air before use — cooler air cools turbine parts better and extends their life.

uz: Zamonaviy turbinalarda 'enhanced cooling air cooler' bo'ladi — u sovutuvchi havoni yanada sovutib, harorat sinfini oshirish va FIKni yaxshilash imkonini beradi.
en: Modern turbines have an 'enhanced cooling air cooler' that chills the cooling air further, allowing a higher temperature class and better efficiency.

uz: 'Ventilation fan' (ventilyatsiya ventilyatori) turbina kabinasi ichidagi havoni doimiy almashtiradi. Bu issiqlikni chiqaradi va sizib chiqqan gazni tarqatadi.
en: A ventilation fan constantly refreshes the air inside the turbine enclosure. This removes heat and disperses any leaked gas.

uz: Turbina kabinasi ventilyatsiyasi xavfsizlik uchun muhim — gaz to'planib qolmasligi kerak, aks holda portlash xavfi tug'iladi.
en: Enclosure ventilation is vital for safety — gas must not accumulate, or an explosion risk arises.

uz: 'Casing cooling air fan' turbina korpusini (casing) sovutadi. Bu korpusning notekis qizib deformatsiyalanishini oldini oladi va rotor bilan mos ishlashini ta'minlaydi.
en: A casing cooling air fan cools the turbine casing. This prevents uneven heating and deformation, keeping the casing aligned with the rotor.

uz: 'CO₂ fire fighting system' (CO₂ o't o'chirish tizimi) yong'in chiqsa turbina bo'limini karbonat angidrid gazi bilan to'ldiradi. Gaz kislorodni siqib chiqarib, olovni bo'g'adi.
en: A CO₂ fire fighting system floods the turbine compartment with carbon dioxide if a fire breaks out. The gas displaces oxygen and smothers the flame.

uz: CO₂ tizimi ishga tushganda odamlar uchun xavfli (kislorod kamayadi), shuning uchun avval ogohlantirish signali beriladi va hamma chiqib ketishi kerak.
en: When the CO₂ system activates it is dangerous for people (oxygen drops), so a warning alarm sounds first and everyone must evacuate.

uz: 'GT 220V DC system' — gaz turbinasining batareyali o'zgarmas tok tizimi. U tok yo'qolganda ham himoya, boshqaruv va favqulodda nasoslarni ta'minlaydi.
en: The GT 220V DC system is the gas turbine's battery-backed direct-current supply. It powers protection, control and emergency pumps even during a power loss.

uz: DC (o'zgarmas tok) tizimi batareyadan keladi, shuning uchun to'r yo'qolsa ham darhol ishlaydi — bu turbinani xavfsiz to'xtatish uchun hayotiy muhim.
en: The DC system comes from batteries, so it works instantly even if the grid is lost — vital for safely shutting down the turbine.

uz: 'Drain system' (drenaj tizimi) quvur va idishlardagi ortiqcha suyuqlik va kondensatni yig'ib chiqaradi. Bu suyuqlik to'planib jihozga zarar berishining oldini oladi.
en: A drain system collects and removes excess liquid and condensate from pipes and vessels. This prevents liquid buildup from damaging equipment.

uz: Bug' quvurlarida ishga tushirishda kondensat (suyuq suv) to'planadi — 'drain' uni chiqarib yubormasa, 'water hammer' (suv zarbasi) quvurni shikastlashi mumkin.
en: Condensate (liquid water) collects in steam pipes during startup — if drains don't remove it, 'water hammer' can damage the piping.

uz: 'Vent system' (shamollatish/havo chiqarish) tizimlardagi ortiqcha gaz yoki havoni xavfsiz chiqaradi. Ishga tushirishda quvurlardagi havoni chiqarish uchun ham ishlatiladi.
en: A vent system safely releases excess gas or air from systems. It's also used to purge air from pipes during startup.

uz: Gaz tizimlari ishga tushishdan oldin inert gaz yoki havo bilan 'purge' (tozalash) qilinadi — bu portlovchi aralashma qolmasligini ta'minlaydi.
en: Gas systems are 'purged' with inert gas or air before startup — this ensures no explosive mixture remains.

uz: 'Seal air system' (zichlagich havo tizimi) podshipniklar atrofiga havo yuborib, moyning turbina ichiga yoki tashqariga sizib ketishini oldini oladi.
en: A seal air system blows air around bearings to prevent oil from leaking into or out of the turbine.

uz: Ba'zi tizimlar 'redundant' (zaxirali) quriladi — muhim nasos yoki ventilyator ikkitadan bo'ladi, biri buzilsa ikkinchisi ishni davom ettiradi.
en: Some systems are built 'redundant' — critical pumps or fans come in pairs, so if one fails the other continues the job.

uz: Barcha yordamchi tizimlar (moy, havo, gaz, suv, sovutish) birgalikda ishlaydi — biri ishlamay qolsa, gaz turbinasi xavfsiz to'xtatiladi. Ular turbinaning 'qon-tomir tizimi' kabidir.
en: All auxiliary systems (oil, air, gas, water, cooling) work together — if one fails, the gas turbine is safely stopped. They are like the turbine's 'circulatory system'.

uz: Gaz turbinasi 'axial' (o'q bo'ylab) tipda: havo va gaz val yo'nalishi bo'ylab to'g'ri oqadi. Bu katta hajmdagi oqim uchun samaraliroq.
en: A gas turbine is 'axial' type: air and gas flow straight along the shaft direction. This is more efficient for large flow volumes.

uz: Kompressorda o'nlab bosqich bo'ladi — har bosqich havoni bir oz siqadi, birgalikda ular bosimni 20-25 baravar oshiradi.
en: A compressor has dozens of stages — each compresses the air a little, and together they raise the pressure 20-25 times.

uz: Har kompressor bosqichi ikki qatordan iborat: aylanuvchi 'rotor' pichoqlar havoni tezlashtiradi, qo'zg'almas 'stator' pichoqlar esa tezlikni bosimga aylantiradi.
en: Each compressor stage has two rows: rotating 'rotor' blades speed the air up, and stationary 'stator' vanes convert that speed into pressure.

uz: Turbina qismida esa teskari jarayon: issiq gaz kengayib, pichoqlarga urilib ularni aylantiradi. Bosim va harorat bosqichma-bosqich tushadi.
en: In the turbine section the reverse happens: hot gas expands, striking the blades to spin them. Pressure and temperature drop stage by stage.

uz: Bitta valda ham kompressor, ham turbina o'rnatilgan — turbina ishlab chiqargan quvvatning bir qismi shu val orqali kompressorni aylantiradi.
en: Both compressor and turbine sit on one shaft — part of the power the turbine makes drives the compressor through this shaft.

uz: Gaz turbinasi 'open cycle' (ochiq sikl)da ishlaydi: havo tashqaridan olinadi, gaz tashqariga chiqariladi. Combined cycle esa bu chiqindi issiqlikni qayta ishlatadi.
en: A gas turbine runs an 'open cycle': air is taken from outside, gas is exhausted out. Combined cycle then reuses that exhaust heat.

uz: Turbina rotori juda og'ir (o'nlab tonna), lekin u shunchalik aniq balanslanadiki, qo'l bilan ham asta aylantirsa bo'ladi.
en: A turbine rotor is very heavy (dozens of tons), yet balanced so precisely that it can be turned slowly even by hand.

uz: 'Clearance' — aylanuvchi pichoq uchi bilan qo'zg'almas korpus orasidagi mayda tirqish. U qancha kichik bo'lsa, sizish kam va FIK yuqori, lekin tegib ketish xavfi ortadi.
en: 'Clearance' is the tiny gap between a rotating blade tip and the stationary casing. The smaller it is, the less leakage and higher efficiency — but the greater the risk of rubbing.

uz: Ishga tushishda metall qismlar turli tezlikda kengayadi — shuning uchun tirqishlar (clearance) sovuq va issiq holatda farq qiladi, buni loyihada hisobga olishadi.
en: During startup metal parts expand at different rates — so clearances differ between cold and hot states, which designers account for.

uz: 'Combustor' (yonish kamerasi)da ko'p 'basket'/'can' (kichik yonish idishlari) bo'lishi mumkin — ular halqa bo'ylab joylashib, gazni bir tekis qizdiradi.
en: A combustor may have several 'baskets'/'cans' (small combustion chambers) arranged in a ring — they heat the gas evenly around the circle.

uz: Yonish kamerasi 'liner'i (ichki devor) eng qattiq issiqlikka duchor bo'ladi — u maxsus sovutish teshiklari va keramik qoplama bilan himoyalanadi.
en: The combustor 'liner' (inner wall) faces the fiercest heat — it is protected by special cooling holes and ceramic coating.

uz: 'Turndown' — turbinaning minimal barqaror quvvati. Yaxshi turndown stansiyaga to'rga kam quvvat kerak bo'lganda ham to'xtamasdan ishlash imkonini beradi.
en: 'Turndown' is the minimum stable power of a turbine. Good turndown lets a plant keep running without shutting down when the grid needs less power.

uz: Gaz turbinasi to'rga tez javob bera oladi — bir necha daqiqada quvvatni oshirib/kamaytirib, to'r muvozanatini saqlashga yordam beradi.
en: A gas turbine can respond quickly to the grid — raising or lowering power within minutes, helping keep the grid balanced.

uz: 'Baseload' rejimida stansiya doim to'liq quvvatda ishlaydi — bu eng samarali va jihoz uchun eng yumshoq rejim, chunki harorat o'zgarishlari kam.
en: In 'baseload' mode a plant runs at full power continuously — the most efficient and gentlest mode for equipment, since temperature swings are few.

uz: Har bir ishga tushirish/to'xtatish sikli turbina qismlarida 'termik charchoq' (thermal fatigue) to'playdi — shuning uchun startlar soni jihoz umriga ta'sir qiladi.
en: Each start/stop cycle accumulates 'thermal fatigue' in turbine parts — so the number of starts affects equipment life.

uz: 'Equivalent operating hours' — jihoz umrini hisoblashda ishlatiladigan o'lchov. Bir start bir necha soat ishlashga teng deb hisoblanadi, chunki u ko'proq charchatadi.
en: 'Equivalent operating hours' is a measure used to track equipment life. One start counts as several running hours, because it wears parts more.

uz: Rejalashtirilgan texnik xizmat (maintenance) uch darajada: 'inspection' (ko'zdan kechirish), 'minor' va 'major overhaul' (katta ta'mirlash) — ochib, qismlarni almashtirish.
en: Planned maintenance comes in levels: inspection (visual check), minor, and major overhaul — opening the machine and replacing parts.

uz: 'Borescope inspection' — turbinani ochmasdan, ingichka kamera (borescope) orqali ichki pichoqlarni ko'zdan kechirish usuli. Bu vaqt va xarajatni tejaydi.
en: A borescope inspection checks internal blades through a thin camera (borescope) without opening the turbine — saving time and cost.

uz: 'Condition monitoring' — jihoz holatini doimiy kuzatib (vibratsiya, harorat, moy tahlili), nosozlikni oldindan sezish. Bu kutilmagan to'xtashlarni kamaytiradi.
en: 'Condition monitoring' continuously watches equipment (vibration, temperature, oil analysis) to catch faults early. This reduces unexpected shutdowns.

uz: Moy tahlili (oil analysis) — moydagi mayda metall zarralarni tekshirib, qaysi qism yeyilayotganini aniqlash. Go'yo qon tahlili kabi jihoz 'salomatligi'ni ko'rsatadi.
en: Oil analysis checks tiny metal particles in the oil to find which part is wearing. Like a blood test, it reveals the equipment's 'health'.

uz: Vibratsiya datchiklari podshipniklarga o'rnatiladi — vibratsiyaning ortishi nomutanosiblik, yeyilish yoki tegib ketishning erta belgisi bo'lishi mumkin.
en: Vibration sensors are mounted on bearings — rising vibration can be an early sign of imbalance, wear or rubbing.

uz: Turbina harorati 'thermocouple' (termopara) datchiklari bilan o'lchanadi — ular ikki xil metall birikmasidan hosil bo'lgan kichik kuchlanish orqali haroratni aniqlaydi.
en: Turbine temperature is measured with thermocouples — they sense temperature through a small voltage generated at a junction of two different metals.

uz: Chiqindi gaz harorati ko'p nuqtada o'lchanadi — agar bir nuqta boshqalardan keskin farq qilsa, bu yonishdagi nosozlikdan darak beradi.
en: Exhaust gas temperature is measured at many points — if one point differs sharply from others, it hints at a combustion problem.

uz: Bug' turbinasi 'reaction' va 'impulse' tiplarga bo'linadi. Impulse turbinada bug' soplo orqali tezlashtiriladi, reaction turbinada esa pichoqlarning o'zi soplo vazifasini o'taydi.
en: Steam turbines are 'reaction' or 'impulse' types. In impulse, steam is sped up through nozzles; in reaction, the blades themselves act as nozzles.

uz: Bug' turbinasi 'gland seal' (val zichlagichi) orqali val chiqadigan joyni zichlaydi — u tashqi havoning kondensator vakuumiga kirishini oldini oladi.
en: A steam turbine's gland seal seals where the shaft exits — it prevents outside air from entering the condenser's vacuum.

uz: 'Vacuum' kondensatorda 'ejector' yoki vakuum nasosi bilan yaratiladi — ular havo va bug'lanmagan gazlarni doimiy so'rib chiqaradi.
en: The condenser vacuum is created by an 'ejector' or vacuum pump — they continuously suck out air and non-condensing gases.

uz: 'Water treatment' (suv tayyorlash) — stansiya suvidan tuz va minerallarni tozalash. Toza suv qozon va turbinada quyqa (scale) va korroziyaning oldini oladi.
en: Water treatment removes salts and minerals from plant water. Clean water prevents scale and corrosion in the boiler and turbine.

uz: Qozon suvida hatto ozgina qattiqlik (kalsiy/magniy) bo'lsa ham, u issiq yuzalarda quyqa hosil qilib, issiqlik o'tishini yomonlashtiradi.
en: Even a little hardness (calcium/magnesium) in boiler water forms scale on hot surfaces, worsening heat transfer.

uz: 'Demineralized water' (mineralsizlantirilgan suv) — deyarli barcha erigan tuzlar olib tashlangan ultra-toza suv. U bug' siklida ishlatiladi.
en: Demineralized water is ultra-pure water with almost all dissolved salts removed. It is used in the steam cycle.

uz: 'Chemical dosing' — suvga oz miqdorda kimyoviy modda qo'shib, uning kislotaligi (pH) va kislorod miqdorini boshqarish. Bu metallni korroziyadan himoya qiladi.
en: 'Chemical dosing' adds small amounts of chemicals to water to control its acidity (pH) and oxygen level. This protects metal from corrosion.

uz: Stansiya chiqindi issiqligining bir qismi muqarrar atrofga tarqaladi — hech qanday issiqlik dvigateli 100% samarali bo'la olmaydi (termodinamika qonuni).
en: Some of a plant's heat is inevitably rejected to the environment — no heat engine can be 100% efficient (a law of thermodynamics).

uz: 'Carnot limiti' — issiqlik dvigatelining nazariy maksimal FIKi, u issiq va sovuq manba haroratlariga bog'liq. Real dvigatellar undan pastroq ishlaydi.
en: The 'Carnot limit' is the theoretical maximum efficiency of a heat engine, set by the hot and cold source temperatures. Real engines fall below it.

uz: 'Grid frequency' (to'r chastotasi) elektr talab va ishlab chiqarish muvozanatini ko'rsatadi. Talab oshsa chastota tushadi, generatorlar quvvatni oshirib javob beradi.
en: Grid frequency reflects the balance of electrical demand and supply. If demand rises, frequency dips, and generators raise power to respond.

uz: To'rdagi barcha generatorlar bir xil chastotada, sinxron aylanadi — ular go'yo bitta ulkan mashina kabi birga ishlaydi.
en: All generators on the grid spin synchronously at the same frequency — they work together as if one giant machine.

uz: 'Governor' (tezlik rostlagich) turbina tezligini (demak to'r chastotasini) boshqaradi. Yuk oshsa, u yoqilg'i/bug'ni ko'paytirib tezlikni saqlaydi.
en: A governor controls turbine speed (hence grid frequency). If load rises, it increases fuel/steam to maintain speed.

uz: 'Black start' — stansiyani tashqi tokdan foydalanmasdan, noldan ishga tushirish qobiliyati. Bu to'r butunlay o'chgan avariyadan keyin tiklashda muhim.
en: 'Black start' is the ability to start a plant from zero without external power. It's vital for restoring the grid after a total blackout.

uz: Black start uchun kichik dizel-generator yoki batareya ishlatiladi — u avval yordamchi tizimlarni yoqadi, keyin asosiy turbina ishga tushadi.
en: Black start uses a small diesel generator or battery — it first powers auxiliary systems, then the main turbine starts up.

uz: 'Load rejection' — generator to'satdan to'rdan uzilib, yukini yo'qotishi. Turbina birdan tezlashib ketmasligi uchun himoya tizimi darhol yoqilg'ini kamaytiradi.
en: 'Load rejection' is when a generator suddenly disconnects from the grid, losing its load. To stop the turbine overspeeding, protection instantly cuts fuel.

uz: 'P&I diagram' (Piping and Instrumentation Diagram) — quvurlar, klapanlar va asboblarni ko'rsatadigan batafsil sxema. Operatorlar tizim qanday bog'langanini shundan o'rganadi.
en: A P&I diagram (Piping and Instrumentation Diagram) is a detailed drawing showing pipes, valves and instruments. Operators learn how a system is connected from it.

uz: Har bir klapan, nasos va datchik P&I diagrammada o'ziga xos 'tag number' (belgi raqami) bilan ko'rsatiladi — bu ularni aniq topishga yordam beradi.
en: Every valve, pump and sensor is shown on a P&I diagram with a unique 'tag number' — helping locate them precisely.

uz: 'Interlock' — bir shart bajarilmaguncha ikkinchi amalni bloklaydigan xavfsizlik mantig'i. Masalan, ventilyatsiya ishlamasa, gaz klapani ochilmaydi.
en: An 'interlock' is a safety logic that blocks one action until a condition is met. For example, the gas valve won't open unless ventilation is running.

uz: Interloklar operator xatosidan himoya qiladi — noto'g'ri ketma-ketlikda buyruq berilsa, tizim uni bajarishdan bosh tortadi.
en: Interlocks protect against operator error — if a command is given in the wrong sequence, the system refuses to carry it out.

uz: 'Permissive' — biror amalni bajarishga 'ruxsat' beruvchi shart. Barcha permissivlar bajarilsagina, masalan, turbina ishga tushirilishi mumkin.
en: A 'permissive' is a condition that grants permission for an action. Only when all permissives are satisfied can, say, a turbine be started.

uz: 'Trip' va 'alarm' farqli: alarm operatorni ogohlantiradi (e'tibor ber), trip esa jihozni avtomatik to'xtatadi (kech, harakat qil).
en: 'Trip' and 'alarm' differ: an alarm warns the operator (pay attention), while a trip automatically stops equipment (act now).

uz: 'First-out' tizimi ko'p trip signali orasidan qaysi biri birinchi bo'lganini ko'rsatadi — bu nosozlikning asl sababini topishga yordam beradi.
en: A 'first-out' system shows which of many trip signals came first — helping find the true root cause of a shutdown.

uz: 'Redundancy' (zaxiralilik) — muhim datchik yoki tizimni takrorlash. '2-out-of-3' mantiqda uch datchikdan ikkitasi rozi bo'lsa harakat qilinadi.
en: 'Redundancy' means duplicating a critical sensor or system. In '2-out-of-3' logic, action is taken only if two of three sensors agree.

uz: 2-out-of-3 mantiq bitta datchik noto'g'ri ishlaganda ham tizimni xato triplardan saqlaydi — ko'pchilik ovoz g'olib chiqadi.
en: 2-out-of-3 logic keeps the system from false trips even if one sensor misbehaves — the majority vote wins.

uz: 'Startup curve' — turbinani qanday tezlikda qizdirish va tezlatishni belgilaydigan jadval. Uni buzish termik kuchlanish va shikast keltiradi.
en: A 'startup curve' defines how fast to heat and accelerate a turbine. Violating it causes thermal stress and damage.

uz: Ishga tushishda turbina ma'lum tezliklarda 'kritik tezlik'dan (rezonans) tez o'tishi kerak — bu tezlikda uzoq tursa, kuchli vibratsiya bo'ladi.
en: During startup a turbine must pass quickly through certain 'critical speeds' (resonance) — lingering there causes strong vibration.

uz: 'Critical speed' — rotorning tabiiy tebranish chastotasiga mos keladigan aylanish tezligi. Bu tezlikda vibratsiya kuchayadi, shuning uchun undan tez o'tiladi.
en: A 'critical speed' is a rotation speed matching the rotor's natural vibration frequency. Vibration peaks there, so it's passed through quickly.

uz: 'Barring/turning gear' rotorni juda sekin (daqiqada bir necha marta) aylantiradi. To'xtagandan keyin soatlab shunday aylantiriladi.
en: A barring/turning gear rotates the rotor very slowly (a few times per minute). After shutdown it keeps turning for hours.

uz: Agar turning gear ishlamay, issiq rotor to'xtab qolsa va egilib qolsa (bow), uni qayta to'g'rilash uzoq va qimmat jarayon bo'ladi.
en: If the turning gear fails and a hot rotor stops and bows, straightening it again is a long and costly process.

uz: 'Eccentricity' datchigi rotorning egilganlik darajasini o'lchaydi. Ishga tushirishdan oldin rotor yetarlicha to'g'ri bo'lishi shart.
en: An 'eccentricity' sensor measures how much the rotor is bowed. Before startup the rotor must be straight enough.

uz: 'Wobbe index' — yoqilg'i gazining yonish 'kuchini' o'lchaydigan ko'rsatkich. Gaz tarkibi o'zgarsa, turbina sozlamalari ham moslashtirilishi kerak.
en: The 'Wobbe index' measures the combustion 'strength' of fuel gas. If gas composition changes, turbine settings must adapt.

uz: Tabiiy gaz tarkibi manbaga qarab farq qiladi — turbina turli 'Wobbe index'li gazda barqaror ishlashi uchun boshqaruv tizimi moslashadi.
en: Natural gas composition varies by source — the control system adapts so the turbine runs stably on gas of different Wobbe index.

uz: 'Purge' (tozalash) — ishga tushirishdan oldin yonish yo'lidan yonuvchi gazni havo bilan surib chiqarish. Bu yoqishda portlash xavfini yo'qotadi.
en: A 'purge' clears combustible gas from the combustion path with air before startup. This removes explosion risk at ignition.

uz: Ishga tushirish tartibi 'purge → ignition → warm-up → acceleration → synchronization' ketma-ketligida boradi — har qadam tekshiriladi.
en: The startup sequence goes 'purge → ignition → warm-up → acceleration → synchronization' — each step is verified.

uz: 'Cooldown' (sovutish) — to'xtatishdan keyin turbinani rejalashtirilgan tartibda sovutish. Tez sovutish ham, tez qizdirish kabi, zararli.
en: 'Cooldown' is cooling a turbine in a planned manner after shutdown. Fast cooling, like fast heating, is harmful.
