uz: 'Blokirovka' — himoyani ma'lum sharoitda vaqtincha to'sib qo'yish. Masalan, kuchlanish yo'qolganda ba'zi himoyalar bloklanadi (yolg'on ishlamaslik uchun).
en: A 'block' temporarily inhibits protection under certain conditions. For example, some protections are blocked when voltage is lost (to avoid misoperation).

uz: Zamin (yerga) tutashuvda kompensatsiya: ba'zi tarmoqlar neytralida 'Petersen g'altagi' bo'ladi — u yerga tutashuv tokini kompensatsiya qilib, yoyni o'z-o'zidan o'chiradi.
en: For earth faults, some networks use a 'Petersen coil' in the neutral — it compensates the earth-fault current, self-extinguishing the arc.

uz: Petersen g'altagi o'tkinchi zamin tutashuvlarini o'z-o'zidan o'chiradi — shuning uchun bunday tarmoqlar bir faza yerga tegsa ham qisqa muddat ishlab tura oladi.
en: A Petersen coil self-extinguishes transient earth faults — so such networks can keep running briefly even with one phase touching earth.

q: Petersen g'altagi (neytralda) nima qiladi?
options: Yerga tutashuv tokini kompensatsiya qilib yoyni o'chiradi
explain: O'tkinchi zamin tutashuvini o'z-o'zidan o'chiradi — tarmoq qisqa muddat ishlab tura oladi.

uz: Releli himoya energetika tizimining 'immun tizimi' kabi — u kasallikni (nosozlik) sezadi, joyini aniqlaydi va tez ajratib, butun 'organizm'ni saqlab qoladi.
en: Relay protection is like the power system's 'immune system' — it senses illness (a fault), locates it and quickly isolates it, saving the whole 'body'.

uz: Bug' turbinasi 'gland seal' (val zichlagichi) tizimi val korpusdan chiqadigan joyni zichlaydi. U tashqi havoning kondensator vakuumiga kirishini va bug'ning tashqariga sizishini oldini oladi.
en: A steam turbine's gland seal system seals where the shaft exits the casing. It prevents outside air from entering the condenser vacuum and steam from leaking out.

uz: Gland seal past bosimli qismda 'bug' beradi' (havo kirmasligi uchun), yuqori bosimli qismda esa bug'ni 'ushlaydi' (sizib chiqmasligi uchun) — bir tizim ikki vazifa.
en: The gland seal 'supplies' steam at low-pressure ends (to keep air out) and 'contains' steam at high-pressure ends (to stop leakage) — one system, two jobs.

q: Bug' turbinasi 'gland seal' (val zichlagichi) nima uchun kerak?
options: Havo kondensatorga kirmasligi va bug' sizmasligi uchun
explain: Val korpusdan chiqadigan joyni zichlab, vakuumni saqlaydi va bug' yo'qotishning oldini oladi.

uz: 'Gland steam condenser' — gland seal'dan chiqqan bug'-havo aralashmasini yig'ib, bug'ni kondensatlaydi. Bu bug'ni tejaydi va bug' xonaga tarqalmasligini ta'minlaydi.
en: A gland steam condenser collects the steam-air mixture from the gland seals and condenses the steam. This saves steam and keeps it from escaping into the room.

uz: 'Steam drain' (bug' drenaji) tizimi quvur va turbinada to'plangan kondensatni (suyuq suvni) chiqarib tashlaydi. Ishga tushirishda bu ayniqsa muhim.
en: A steam drain system removes condensate (liquid water) that collects in pipes and the turbine. This is especially important during startup.

uz: Ishga tushirishda sovuq quvurlarda bug' kondensatlanib suv hosil bo'ladi — drenaj uni chiqarmasa, 'water hammer' (suv zarbasi) turbina va quvurlarni shikastlashi mumkin.
en: During startup, steam condenses to water in cold pipes — if drains don't remove it, 'water hammer' can damage the turbine and piping.

q: Ishga tushirishda bug' drenaji (steam drain) nima uchun juda muhim?
options: Kondensatni chiqarib, water hammer'ning oldini olish
explain: Sovuq quvurlarda hosil bo'lgan suv chiqarilmasa, suv zarbasi jihozni sindiradi.

uz: 'LP hood spray' — past bosim (LP) qismidagi haroratni nazorat qiluvchi suv purkash tizimi. Yuk kam bo'lganda LP qismi qizib ketishi mumkin, spray uni sovutadi.
en: An 'LP hood spray' is a water spray system that controls temperature in the low-pressure (LP) section. At low load the LP section can overheat, and the spray cools it.

uz: Sovuq rotorga to'satdan issiq bug' berilsa, tashqi qismi ichkarisidan tezroq kengayadi — bu kuchlanish va yoriqlar keltiradi. Pre-warming buni yumshatadi.
en: If hot steam suddenly hits a cold rotor, its outer part expands faster than the inside — causing stress and cracks. Pre-warming softens this.

uz: Gland seal past bosimli qismda bug' beradi (havo kirmasligi uchun), yuqori bosimli qismda esa bug'ni ushlaydi (sizib chiqmasligi uchun) — bir tizim ikki vazifa.
en: The gland seal supplies steam at low-pressure ends (to keep air out) and contains steam at high-pressure ends (to stop leakage) — one system, two jobs.

uz: Gland steam condenser gland seal'dan chiqqan bug'-havo aralashmasini yig'ib, bug'ni kondensatlaydi. Bu bug'ni tejaydi va bug' xonaga tarqalmasligini ta'minlaydi.
en: A gland steam condenser collects the steam-air mixture from the gland seals and condenses the steam. This saves steam and keeps it from escaping into the room.

uz: Steam drain (bug' drenaji) tizimi quvur va turbinada to'plangan kondensatni (suyuq suvni) chiqarib tashlaydi. Ishga tushirishda bu ayniqsa muhim.
en: A steam drain system removes condensate (liquid water) that collects in pipes and the turbine. This is especially important during startup.

uz: LP hood spray past bosim qismidagi haroratni nazorat qiluvchi suv purkash tizimi. Yuk kam bo'lganda LP qismi qizib ketishi mumkin, spray uni sovutadi.
en: An LP hood spray is a water spray system that controls temperature in the low-pressure section. At low load the LP section can overheat, and the spray cools it.

uz: Rotor pre-warming (rotorni oldindan isitish) sovuq turbinani ishga tushirishdan oldin rotorni asta-sekin isitadi. Bu termik kuchlanishni kamaytiradi va startni tezlashtiradi.
en: Rotor pre-warming gently heats the rotor before starting a cold turbine. This reduces thermal stress and speeds up the start.

uz: Gidravlik moy tizimi turbina klapanlarini (HPV, IPV) harakatga keltiradi. U yuqori bosimli va tez ta'sirli — klapanni bir zumda yopa oladi.
en: A hydraulic oil system moves the turbine valves (HPV, IPV). It is high-pressure and fast-acting, able to close a valve in an instant.

uz: HPV (High Pressure Valve) va IPV (Intermediate Pressure Valve) bug' turbinasiga kirayotgan bug' oqimini boshqaradigan asosiy klapanlar. Ular quvvatni rostlaydi va favqulodda yopiladi.
en: HPV (High Pressure Valve) and IPV (Intermediate Pressure Valve) are the main valves controlling steam flow into the turbine. They regulate power and close in emergencies.

uz: Har klapan ikki qismdan iborat: stop valve (favqulodda to'liq yopadi) va control valve (oqimni nozik rostlaydi). Ular birga turbinani himoya va boshqaradi.
en: Each valve has two parts: a stop valve (closes fully in emergency) and a control valve (finely regulates flow). Together they protect and control the turbine.

uz: Rotor vibratsiyasi bug' turbinasi sog'lig'ining asosiy ko'rsatkichi. Podshipniklardagi datchiklar vibratsiyani doimiy o'lchaydi, uning o'sishi nosozlikdan darak beradi.
en: Rotor vibration is a key health indicator of a steam turbine. Sensors on the bearings measure it continuously, and a rise signals trouble.

uz: Bug' turbinasida vibratsiya sabablari: nomutanosiblik, rotor egilishi (bow), podshipnik yeyilishi yoki pichoqda nuqson. Har biri alohida belgi beradi.
en: Causes of steam turbine vibration include imbalance, rotor bow, bearing wear or blade defect. Each gives a distinct signature.

uz: Off-frequency operation — to'r chastotasi me'yordan chetga chiqqanda turbinaning ishlashi. Juda past yoki yuqori chastotada uzoq ishlash pichoqlarni charchatadi (rezonans).
en: Off-frequency operation is running the turbine when grid frequency deviates from normal. Prolonged running at very low or high frequency fatigues the blades (resonance).

uz: Steam purity (bug' tozaligi) bug' turbinasi uchun juda muhim. Bug'dagi erigan tuz va minerallar pichoqlarga cho'kma hosil qilib, ularni yemiradi va samaradorlikni pasaytiradi.
en: Steam purity is critical for a steam turbine. Dissolved salts and minerals in the steam form deposits on blades, corroding them and lowering efficiency.

uz: Exhaust pressure — bug' turbinasi LP qismi chiqishidagi bosim, u kondensator vakuumiga teng. Past bosim (yaxshi vakuum) ko'proq quvvat beradi.
en: Exhaust pressure is the pressure at the LP section outlet, equal to the condenser vacuum. Low pressure (good vacuum) yields more power.

uz: Bug' turbinasi trip va himoya tizimi xavfli holatda (yuqori vibratsiya, past moy bosimi, over-speed, past vakuum) turbinani darhol xavfsiz to'xtatadi.
en: A steam turbine's trip and protection system immediately and safely stops the turbine in dangerous conditions (high vibration, low oil pressure, overspeed, low vacuum).

uz: Bug' turbinasida over-speed trip eng muhim himoyalardan. Bug' klapanlari to'liq yopilib, rotorning xavfli tezlashib ketishini oldini oladi.
en: An overspeed trip is among the most important protections in a steam turbine. Steam valves close fully, preventing the rotor from dangerously accelerating.

uz: Turning gear to'xtagan turbina rotorini sekin aylantirib turadi. To'xtagandan keyin soatlab shunday aylantiriladi — rotor egilib (bow) qolmasligi uchun.
en: A turning gear slowly rotates a stopped turbine rotor. After shutdown it runs for hours to keep the rotor from bowing.

uz: Bug' LP bosqichda eng ko'p kengayadi, shuning uchun LP pichoqlari eng uzun (metrga yaqin) va turbinaning eng katta qismi.
en: Steam expands most in the LP section, so LP blades are the longest (nearly a meter) and the biggest part of the turbine.

uz: Cold reheat va hot reheat — bug' HP turbinadan chiqib, HRSG'da qayta qizdirilib, IP turbinaga qaytadi. Bu FIK'ni oshiradi.
en: Cold reheat and hot reheat describe steam leaving the HP turbine, reheated in the HRSG, and returning to the IP turbine. This raises efficiency.

uz: Bug' turbinasi reaction va impulse tiplarga bo'linadi. Impulse turbinada bug' soplo orqali tezlashadi, reaction turbinada pichoqlarning o'zi soplo vazifasini o'taydi.
en: Steam turbines are reaction or impulse type. In impulse, steam speeds up through nozzles; in reaction, the blades themselves act as nozzles.

uz: Last stage blade (LP oxirgi bosqich pichog'i) bug' turbinasidagi eng uzun va eng ko'p sinovga tushadigan pichoq — u katta hajmdagi past bosimli bug'ni qabul qiladi.
en: The last stage blade (LP final stage) is the longest and most stressed blade in a steam turbine — it handles a large volume of low-pressure steam.

uz: Bug' turbinasi casing (korpus) yuqori bosimli issiq bug'ni ushlab turadi. U qalin metalldan yasaladi va notekis qizishdan deformatsiyalanmasligi uchun ehtiyotkorlik bilan qizdiriladi.
en: A steam turbine casing contains the high-pressure hot steam. It's made of thick metal and heated carefully to avoid deforming from uneven heating.

uz: Katta bug' turbinasi korpusi ikki qavat bo'lishi mumkin (double casing) — ichki va tashqi. Bu bosim va harorat yukini taqsimlab, deformatsiyani kamaytiradi.
en: A large steam turbine casing can be double-walled (inner and outer). This distributes pressure and temperature load, reducing deformation.

uz: Steam blowing (bug' bilan puflash) yangi bug' quvurlarini ishga tushirishdan oldin yuqori tezlikdagi bug' bilan tozalaydi. U quvurdagi qoldiq va zang zarrachalarini uchirib chiqaradi.
en: Steam blowing cleans new steam pipes before commissioning by blasting them with high-velocity steam. It blows out debris and rust particles.

uz: Lube oil main pump (asosiy moy nasosi) normal ishda moyni haydaydi. U odatda valga ulangan yoki alohida motorli bo'ladi.
en: The lube oil main pump circulates oil in normal operation. It's usually shaft-driven or has its own motor.

uz: Lube oil emergency pump (favqulodda nasos) asosiy nasos to'xtasa darhol ishga tushadi. U ko'pincha DC (batareya) tokida ishlaydi — tok yo'qolsa ham podshipniklar moysiz qolmaydi.
en: The lube oil emergency pump starts at once if the main pump fails. It often runs on DC (battery), so bearings aren't left without oil during power loss.

uz: Lube oil cooler (moy sovutgich) ikkita bo'ladi (A va B). Changeover — turbina ishlab turganda biridan ikkinchisiga o'tib, ifloslanganini tozalash mumkin.
en: There are two lube oil coolers (A and B). Changeover means switching from one to the other while the turbine runs, to clean the dirty one.

uz: Lube oil filter moydagi mayda metall zarrachalar va ifloslikni ushlaydi. Toza moy podshipniklarni yeyilishdan saqlaydi. U ham ikkita (changeover).
en: A lube oil filter traps fine metal particles and dirt. Clean oil protects bearings from wear. It's also dual (changeover).

uz: Lube oil mist separator (moy tumani ajratgich) moy bakidan chiqadigan moy tumanini ushlab, toza havoni chiqaradi. Bu moyni tejaydi va atrofni ifloslamaydi.
en: A lube oil mist separator captures oil mist leaving the tank and releases clean air. This saves oil and avoids contaminating surroundings.

uz: Lube oil heater (moy isitgich) turbina ishga tushirishdan oldin sovuq moyni isitadi. Iliq moy yaxshi oqadi va startni osonlashtiradi.
en: A lube oil heater warms cold oil before startup. Warm oil flows well and eases starting.

uz: Podshipnik oq metall (babbitt) bilan qoplanadi — bu yumshoq qotishma val bilan ishqalanishni kamaytiradi va uni himoya qiladi.
en: Bearings are lined with white metal (babbitt), a soft alloy that reduces friction with the shaft and protects it.

uz: Oq metall yumshoq bo'lganidan, agar zarracha tushsa, u valni emas, o'zini shikastlaydi — ya'ni arzon podshipnik qimmatli valni saqlaydi.
en: Because white metal is soft, if a particle enters it damages itself, not the shaft — a cheap bearing protects the expensive shaft.

uz: Gaz turbinasida ikki xil podshipnik: journal bearing valni yon tomondan ushlaydi (aylanishga), thrust bearing esa uni o'q bo'ylab siljishdan ushlaydi.
en: A gas turbine has two bearing types: journal bearings support the shaft radially (for rotation), and the thrust bearing holds it against axial movement.

uz: Zamonaviy turbinalarda tilting-pad (egiluvchi tagliksimon) podshipniklar ishlatiladi — ular yuqori tezlikda barqaror va vibratsiyaga chidamli.
en: Modern turbines use tilting-pad bearings — their pads pivot to stay stable at high speed and resist vibration.

uz: Lube oil accumulator (moy akkumulyatori) bosim ostida moyni zaxira sifatida saqlaydi. Nasoslar orasidagi qisqa uzilishda ham moy uzatishni ta'minlaydi.
en: A lube oil accumulator stores pressurized oil as a reserve. It maintains oil supply even during a brief gap between pumps.

uz: Releli himoya energetika tizimining immun tizimi kabi ishlaydi — u kasallikni (nosozlik) sezadi, joyini aniqlaydi va tez ajratadi. Bu butun tizimni saqlab qoladi.
en: Relay protection works like the power system's immune system — it senses illness (a fault), locates it and isolates it quickly. This saves the whole system.

uz: Tokli otsechka (tez tokli himoya) juda katta toklarda darhol, kechikishsiz ishlaydi. U faqat manbaga yaqin, eng xavfli qisqa tutashuvlarga javob beradi.
en: An instantaneous overcurrent (current cut-off) operates immediately at very high currents. It responds only to the most dangerous faults near the source.

uz: Bosqichli himoya bir necha zonadan iborat: birinchi zona tez (kechikishsiz), keyingilari vaqt kechikishi bilan. Bu selektivlik va zaxira himoyani birga beradi.
en: Stepped protection has several zones: the first is fast (no delay), later ones with time delay. This provides selectivity and backup together.

uz: Shina (busbar) himoyasi podstansiyaning eng muhim nuqtasini himoya qiladi. Shinada nosozlik butun podstansiyani o'chirishi mumkin, shuning uchun himoya juda tez bo'lishi kerak.
en: Busbar protection guards the most critical point of a substation. A busbar fault can shut down the whole substation, so protection must be very fast.

uz: Chastota himoyasi (AChR) tizim chastotasi xavfli pasaysa ishga tushadi. Chastota pasayishi ishlab chiqarish talabdan kam ekanini bildiradi.
en: Frequency protection (load shedding) operates when system frequency drops dangerously. A frequency drop means generation is below demand.

uz: APV (avtomatik qayta ulash) liniya uzilgach, uni avtomatik qayta ulashga urinadi. Ko'p qisqa tutashuvlar o'tkinchi — qayta ulaganda yo'qoladi.
en: Auto-reclosing (APV) automatically tries to re-energize a line after it trips. Many faults are transient — they disappear on reclosing.

uz: AVR (zaxirani avtomatik ulash) asosiy ta'minot yo'qolsa, iste'molchini zaxira manbaga avtomatik ulaydi. Bu uzilishni minimallashtiradi.
en: Automatic transfer switching (ATS) connects a consumer to a backup supply automatically when the main supply is lost. This minimizes interruption.

uz: Motorlar himoyalanadi: ortiqcha yukdan (issiqlik), qisqa tutashuvdan, faza yo'qolishidan va kuchlanish pasayishidan. Har biri motor uchun xavfli.
en: Motors are protected from overload (thermal), short circuit, phase loss and undervoltage. Each is dangerous for a motor.

uz: Operativ zanjir (boshqaruv zanjiri) relelar, uzgichlar va signal qurilmalarini bog'laydi. U odatda o'zgarmas tok (batareya) bilan ishlaydi.
en: The control circuit links relays, breakers and signaling devices. It usually runs on DC (battery) power.

uz: Petersen g'altagi ba'zi tarmoq neytralida bo'ladi — u yerga tutashuv tokini kompensatsiya qilib, yoyni o'z-o'zidan o'chiradi.
en: A Petersen coil is used in some network neutrals — it compensates earth-fault current, self-extinguishing the arc.

uz: GT cooling air system (sovutuvchi havo tizimi) kompressordan havoning bir qismini olib, turbinaning eng issiq qismlarini (pichoq, disk) sovutadi.
en: The GT cooling air system takes some air from the compressor to cool the turbine's hottest parts (blades, discs).

uz: Casing cooling air fan turbina korpusini (casing) sovutadi. Bu korpusning notekis qizib deformatsiyalanishini oldini oladi va rotor bilan mos ishlashini ta'minlaydi.
en: A casing cooling air fan cools the turbine casing. This prevents uneven heating and deformation, keeping the casing aligned with the rotor.

uz: GT fuel gas heater (yoqilg'i gaz isitgich) turbinaga kirayotgan gazni isitadi. Issiq gaz barqarorroq yonadi va sikl samaradorligini oshiradi.
en: A GT fuel gas heater warms the gas entering the turbine. Hotter gas burns more stably and raises cycle efficiency.

uz: GT inlet air system (kirish havo tizimi) turbinaga kirayotgan havoni filtrlaydi va yo'naltiradi. Toza havo kompressor pichoqlarini yeyilishdan saqlaydi.
en: The GT inlet air system filters and directs air entering the turbine. Clean air protects compressor blades from erosion.

uz: GT exhaust system (chiqindi tizimi) turbinadan chiqqan issiq gazni HRSG'ga yo'naltiradi. Combined cycle'da bu gaz behuda ketmay, bug' hosil qilishga ishlatiladi.
en: The GT exhaust system directs hot gas from the turbine to the HRSG. In combined cycle this gas isn't wasted but is used to raise steam.

uz: Control oil system (boshqaruv moyi tizimi) klapan va aktuatorlarni harakatga keltiradigan yuqori bosimli moy. U turbinani nozik boshqaruv uchun ishlatiladi.
en: The control oil system is high-pressure oil that moves valves and actuators. It's used for precise turbine control.

uz: GT CO2 fire fighting system yong'in chiqsa turbina bo'limini CO2 bilan to'ldiradi. Gaz kislorodni surib chiqarib, olovni bo'g'adi.
en: The GT CO2 fire fighting system floods the turbine compartment with CO2 if a fire breaks out. The gas displaces oxygen and smothers the flame.

uz: CO2 tizimi ishga tushganda odamlar uchun xavfli (kislorod kamayadi), shuning uchun avval ogohlantirish signali beriladi, hamma chiqib ketishi kerak.
en: When the CO2 system activates it's dangerous for people (oxygen drops), so a warning alarm sounds first and everyone must leave.

uz: Instrument air (asbob havosi) toza, quruq siqilgan havo. U klapan va boshqaruv qurilmalarini harakatga keltiradi. Nam havo asboblarni buzishi mumkin.
en: Instrument air is clean, dry compressed air that drives valves and control devices. Moist air could damage the instruments.

uz: Instrument air dryer (quritgich) orqali o'tkaziladi — namlik olib tashlanadi, aks holda klapanlarda korroziya yoki muzlash bo'lishi mumkin.
en: Instrument air passes through a dryer — moisture is removed, or valves could corrode or freeze.

uz: Cooling water system (sovutuvchi suv tizimi) stansiyadagi ko'p jihozni (moy cooler, generator, kondensator) sovutadi. U yopiq yoki ochiq siklda ishlaydi.
en: A cooling water system cools many devices in a plant (oil coolers, generator, condenser). It runs in a closed or open loop.

uz: Step-up transformator generator past kuchlanishini (masalan 20 kV) to'rga uzatish uchun yuqori kuchlanishga (220/500 kV) oshiradi.
en: A step-up transformer raises the generator's low voltage (e.g. 20 kV) to a high grid voltage (220/500 kV) for transmission.

uz: Busbar (shina) elektr energiyasini bir necha zanjirga taqsimlaydi. U stansiyaning elektr chorrahasi kabidir.
en: A busbar distributes electric power to several circuits. It acts like the electrical junction of the plant.

uz: Stansiya o'zi ham elektr iste'mol qiladi (nasoslar, ventilyatorlar, boshqaruv) — bu auxiliary power deb ataladi, odatda generator quvvatining bir necha foizi.
en: A plant consumes electricity itself (pumps, fans, controls) — this is auxiliary power, typically a few percent of the generator's output.

uz: Stansiya butunlay tokdan uzilsa ham xavfsiz to'xtashi uchun emergency power — batareya (DC) va dizel-generator zaxirasi bo'ladi.
en: So a plant can shut down safely even if it loses all power, there's emergency power — battery banks (DC) and a backup diesel generator.

uz: UPS (uzluksiz ta'minlash manbai) muhim asboblarga tokni bir zumga ham uzilmasdan yetkazadi — batareya va inverter orqali ishlaydi.
en: A UPS (Uninterruptible Power Supply) delivers power to critical instruments without even a momentary break — via battery and inverter.

uz: Generator circuit breaker generatorni to'rdan tez ajratishga imkon beradi — bu nosozlik yoki texnik xizmat paytida muhim.
en: A generator circuit breaker allows quickly isolating the generator from the grid — important during a fault or maintenance.

uz: Generatorni to'rga ulash sinxronizatsiya talab qiladi: chastota, kuchlanish va faza to'rga aniq mos kelishi kerak, aks holda kuchli zarba bo'ladi.
en: Connecting a generator to the grid requires synchronization: frequency, voltage and phase must exactly match the grid, or a damaging shock occurs.

uz: Excitation transformator generator qo'zg'atish tizimiga tok beradi. Bu tok rotorni magnitlab, generator kuchlanishini boshqaradi.
en: An excitation transformer feeds current to the generator's excitation system. This current magnetizes the rotor and controls the generator voltage.

uz: Rotor grounding device generator validagi statik zaryadni yerga chiqaradi. Bunday zaryad to'plansa, podshipnik yuzalariga uchqun urib ularni yemiradi.
en: A rotor grounding device drains static charge from the generator shaft to earth. If it built up, it would spark across bearings and erode them.

uz: GT 220V DC system — gaz turbinasining batareyali o'zgarmas tok tizimi. U tok yo'qolganda ham himoya, boshqaruv va favqulodda nasoslarni ta'minlaydi.
en: The GT 220V DC system is the gas turbine's battery-backed DC supply. It powers protection, control and emergency pumps even during power loss.

uz: GT 400V AC motor control center (MCC) stansiyadagi past kuchlanishli motorlarni (nasos, ventilyator) boshqaradi va himoyalaydi.
en: The GT 400V AC motor control center (MCC) controls and protects the plant's low-voltage motors (pumps, fans).

uz: PID controller jarayonni kerakli qiymatga (setpoint) yaqinlashtiradi. U proporsional (hozirgi xato), integral (to'plangan xato) va differensial (o'zgarish tezligi) qismlardan iborat.
en: A PID controller drives a process toward a setpoint. It has proportional (current error), integral (accumulated error) and derivative (rate of change) terms.

uz: Thermocouple (termopara) ikki xil metall birikmasidan hosil bo'lgan kichik kuchlanish orqali haroratni o'lchaydi. U yuqori haroratlarni o'lchash uchun ideal.
en: A thermocouple measures temperature via a small voltage at a junction of two different metals. It's ideal for high temperatures.

uz: RTD (Resistance Temperature Detector) haroratni metall qarshiligining o'zgarishi orqali o'lchaydi. U termoparadan aniqroq, lekin yuqori haroratda kamroq ishlaydi.
en: An RTD (Resistance Temperature Detector) measures temperature via change in a metal's resistance. It's more accurate than a thermocouple but works less at very high temperatures.

uz: Interlock — bir shart bajarilmaguncha ikkinchi amalni bloklaydigan xavfsizlik mantig'i. Masalan, ventilyatsiya ishlamasa, gaz klapani ochilmaydi.
en: An interlock is a safety logic that blocks one action until a condition is met. For example, the gas valve won't open unless ventilation runs.

uz: SCADA — masofadan nazorat va ma'lumot yig'ish tizimi. U operatorlarga stansiyani (yoki ko'p stansiyani) markazdan kuzatishga imkon beradi.
en: SCADA is a supervisory control and data acquisition system. It lets operators monitor a plant (or many) centrally from a distance.

uz: Pressure transmitter (bosim datchigi) suyuqlik yoki gaz bosimini o'lchab, uni elektr signalga aylantiradi. Stansiyada yuzlab shunday datchik bor.
en: A pressure transmitter measures liquid or gas pressure and converts it to an electrical signal. A plant has hundreds of them.

uz: Sanoat datchiklari ko'pincha 4-20 mA signal beradi — 4 mA eng past, 20 mA eng yuqori qiymat. Bu elektr shovqinga chidamli standart.
en: Industrial sensors often output a 4-20 mA signal — 4 mA is the lowest, 20 mA the highest value. It's a noise-resistant standard.

uz: Preventiv ta'mir (rejali) jihoz buzilishdan oldin, jadval bo'yicha xizmat ko'rsatish. Bu kutilmagan to'xtashlar va katta zararlarning oldini oladi.
en: Preventive (planned) maintenance means servicing equipment on schedule, before it breaks. This avoids unexpected shutdowns and major damage.

uz: Prediktiv ta'mir jihoz holatini (vibratsiya, harorat, moy) kuzatib, ta'mirni aynan kerak bo'lganda qiladi. Bu vaqt va xarajatni tejaydi.
en: Predictive maintenance monitors equipment condition (vibration, temperature, oil) to service it exactly when needed. This saves time and cost.

uz: LOTO (Lockout-Tagout) ta'mir paytida jihozni tasodifan yoqilishdan saqlaydigan xavfsizlik tartibi. Energiya manbai qulflanadi va belgi osiladi.
en: LOTO (Lockout-Tagout) is a safety procedure preventing equipment from being switched on accidentally during repair. The energy source is locked and a tag is hung.

uz: LOTO'da qulfni faqat ishni bajaruvchi shaxsning o'zi ochadi — shu bilan boshqa birov jihozni bexosdan yoqib yubormaydi.
en: In LOTO, only the person doing the work removes the lock — so no one else can switch the equipment on by accident.

uz: Confined space (tor makon) HRSG yoki kondensator ichi kabi joylar. Ularga kirishdan oldin havo tarkibi tekshiriladi, chunki kislorod kam yoki zaharli gaz bo'lishi mumkin.
en: A confined space is a place like the inside of an HRSG or condenser. Before entry the air is tested, since oxygen may be low or toxic gas present.

uz: Hot work — payvandlash yoki kesish kabi uchqun va olov chiqaradigan ishlar. Ular uchun maxsus ruxsat (permit) olinadi va yong'in choralari ko'riladi.
en: Hot work is work like welding or cutting that produces sparks and flame. It requires a special permit and fire precautions.

uz: NDT (Non-Destructive Testing) jihozni buzmasdan tekshirish usullari: ultratovush, radiografiya, magnit zarrachalar. Ular yashirin yoriqlarni topadi.
en: NDT (Non-Destructive Testing) inspects equipment without damaging it: ultrasound, radiography, magnetic particles. They find hidden cracks.

uz: Condition monitoring jihoz holatini doimiy kuzatib (vibratsiya, harorat, moy tahlili), nosozlikni oldindan sezadi. Bu kutilmagan to'xtashlarni kamaytiradi.
en: Condition monitoring continuously watches equipment (vibration, temperature, oil analysis) to catch faults early. This reduces unexpected shutdowns.

uz: Oil analysis (moy tahlili) moydagi mayda metall zarrachalarni tekshirib, qaysi qism yeyilayotganini aniqlaydi. Go'yo qon tahlili kabi jihoz salomatligini ko'rsatadi.
en: Oil analysis checks tiny metal particles in oil to find which part is wearing. Like a blood test, it reveals equipment health.

uz: Hot gas path inspection turbinaning eng issiq qismlarini (pichoq, transition piece) ko'zdan kechirish va almashtirish. Bu eng muhim ta'mir turlaridan.
en: A hot gas path inspection examines and replaces the turbine's hottest parts (blades, transition pieces). It's among the most important overhauls.

uz: Borescope inspection turbinani ochmasdan, ingichka kamera orqali ichki pichoqlarni ko'zdan kechirish. Bu vaqt va xarajatni tejaydi.
en: A borescope inspection checks internal blades through a thin camera without opening the turbine — saving time and cost.

uz: Stansiyada shaxsiy himoya vositalari (PPE) majburiy: kaska, quloq himoyasi, ko'zoynak, xavfsizlik poyabzali. Ular jismoniy shikastdan himoya qiladi.
en: Personal protective equipment (PPE) is mandatory in a plant: helmet, hearing protection, goggles, safety shoes. They protect from physical injury.

uz: Risk assessment (xavf-xatarni baholash) ishdan oldin mumkin xavflarni aniqlab, ularni kamaytirish choralari ko'rish. Bu baxtsizlik hodisalarini oldini oladi.
en: A risk assessment identifies possible hazards before work and takes steps to reduce them. This prevents accidents.

uz: Xavfsizlik belgilarida ranglar muhim: qizil xavf yoki to'xtash, sariq ogohlantirish, yashil xavfsiz yoki ishga tayyor. Ular tez tushunishni ta'minlaydi.
en: Safety sign colors matter: red danger or stop, yellow warning, green safe or ready. They enable quick understanding.

uz: GTCC (Gas Turbine Combined Cycle) stansiyasida gaz turbinasi umumiy quvvatning taxminan uchdan ikki, bug' turbinasi uchdan bir qismini beradi — bir yoqilg'idan ikki manba.
en: In a GTCC plant the gas turbine gives about two-thirds of total power and the steam turbine one-third — two sources from one fuel.

uz: Ba'zi stansiyalarda inlet air cooling bo'ladi — kirayotgan havoni sovutib uni zichroq qiladi va issiq kunlarda quvvatni tiklaydi.
en: Some plants use inlet air cooling — chilling incoming air to make it denser and recover power on hot days.

uz: Heat rate — bir birlik elektr ishlab chiqarish uchun sarflangan issiqlik. U qancha past bo'lsa, stansiya shuncha samarali.
en: Heat rate is the heat used to produce one unit of electricity. The lower it is, the more efficient the plant.

uz: Availability — stansiyaning ishlashga tayyor bo'lgan vaqti ulushi. Yuqori availability ko'proq daromad va ishonchlilikni bildiradi.
en: Availability is the fraction of time a plant is ready to run. High availability means more revenue and reliability.

uz: Rankine sikli — bug' turbinasi ishlaydigan termodinamik sikl: suv qizdirilib bug'ga, bug' turbinani aylantirib, keyin kondensatlanib qayta suvga aylanadi.
en: The Rankine cycle is the thermodynamic cycle of a steam turbine: water is heated to steam, the steam spins the turbine, then condenses back to water.

uz: Cogeneration (birgalikda ishlab chiqarish) stansiya ham elektr, ham foydali issiqlik (bug', issiq suv) beradi. Bu umumiy samaradorlikni yanada oshiradi.
en: Cogeneration means a plant produces both electricity and useful heat (steam, hot water). This raises overall efficiency further.

uz: Capacity factor stansiya haqiqatda qancha ishlab chiqarganini maksimal mumkinga nisbatan ko'rsatadi. Yuqori bo'lsa, stansiya samarali ishlatilayotgan.
en: Capacity factor shows how much a plant actually produced versus the maximum possible. High means the plant is used efficiently.

uz: Black start qobiliyati to'r o'chganda stansiya o'zini toksiz ishga tushiradi. Total blackoutdan keyin tashqi toksiz ishga tushib, to'rni tiklashga yordam beradi.
en: Black start capability lets a plant start itself without external power when the grid is down. After a total blackout it can start and help restore the grid.

uz: Elektr energiya kuchlanish (Volt), tok (Amper) va quvvat (Vatt) bilan o'lchanadi. Quvvat kuchlanish va tok ko'paytmasiga teng — bu elektrotexnikaning asosiy formulasi.
en: Electricity is measured by voltage (Volt), current (Ampere) and power (Watt). Power equals voltage times current — the basic formula of electrical engineering.

uz: Bir megavatt (MVt) million vattga teng. Yirik elektr stansiyasi yuzlab yoki minglab megavatt quvvat ishlab chiqaradi.
en: One megawatt (MW) equals a million watts. A large power plant produces hundreds or thousands of MW.

uz: O'zgaruvchan tok (AC) yo'nalishini sekundiga 50 marta o'zgartiradi (50 Hz). Deyarli barcha elektr tarmoqlari AC'da ishlaydi, chunki uni transformator bilan oson o'zgartirish mumkin.
en: Alternating current (AC) reverses direction 50 times per second (50 Hz). Almost all power grids use AC, because it's easy to transform with a transformer.

uz: Uch fazali tizim uch alohida AC tokidan iborat, ular bir-biridan 120 gradusga surilgan. Bu motorlar va uzatish uchun samaraliroq.
en: A three-phase system has three separate AC currents, offset from each other by 120 degrees. This is more efficient for motors and transmission.

uz: Grid frequency (to'r chastotasi) elektr talab va ishlab chiqarish muvozanatini ko'rsatadi. Talab oshsa chastota tushadi, generatorlar quvvatni oshirib javob beradi.
en: Grid frequency reflects the balance of demand and supply. If demand rises, frequency dips, and generators raise power in response.

uz: Governor (tezlik rostlagich) turbina tezligini (demak to'r chastotasini) boshqaradi. Yuk oshsa, u yoqilg'i yoki bug'ni ko'paytirib tezlikni saqlaydi.
en: A governor controls turbine speed (hence grid frequency). If load rises, it increases fuel or steam to maintain speed.

uz: Centrifugal pump (markazdan qochma nasos) aylanuvchi g'ildirak (impeller) bilan suyuqlikni tashqariga uloqtirib bosim hosil qiladi. Stansiyadagi eng keng tarqalgan nasos.
en: A centrifugal pump uses a spinning impeller to fling liquid outward, creating pressure. It's the most common pump in a plant.

uz: Gate valve (shiber klapan) to'liq ochiq yoki to'liq yopiq holatda ishlatiladi — oqimni to'sish yoki ochish uchun, rostlash uchun emas.
en: A gate valve is used fully open or fully closed — to block or allow flow, not to regulate it.

uz: Globe valve (sharli klapan) esa oqimni nozik rostlash uchun — u qisman ochiq turib oqim miqdorini boshqaradi.
en: A globe valve, in contrast, is for fine flow regulation — it can stay partly open to control the flow rate.

uz: Butterfly valve (kapalak klapan) diski 90 gradusga burilib oqimni ochadi yoki yopadi. U yengil, arzon va katta quvurlar uchun qulay.
en: A butterfly valve has a disc that turns 90 degrees to open or close flow. It's light, cheap and suitable for large pipes.

uz: Strainer (filtr to'r) suyuqlikdagi yirik zarrachalarni ushlab, nasos va klapanlarni ulardan himoya qiladi. U davriy tozalanadi.
en: A strainer catches large particles in a liquid, protecting pumps and valves from them. It is cleaned periodically.

uz: Nasoslar ko'pincha juftlik bo'lib o'rnatiladi: biri ishlaydi (duty), ikkinchisi zaxira (standby). Biri buzilsa, ikkinchisi avtomatik ishga tushadi.
en: Pumps are often installed in pairs: one running (duty), the other standby. If one fails, the other starts automatically.

uz: NPSH (Net Positive Suction Head) nasos so'rish tomonida kavitatsiyadan qochish uchun kerak bo'lgan minimal bosim. Uni ta'minlash muhim.
en: NPSH (Net Positive Suction Head) is the minimum pressure needed at a pump's suction to avoid cavitation. Ensuring it is important.

uz: Nasosdagi kavitatsiya bosim pasayib bug' pufakchalari hosil bo'lib, ular portlab nasosni yemirganda yuzaga keladi. Bu shovqin va shikast keltiradi.
en: Cavitation in a pump occurs when low pressure forms vapor bubbles that collapse and erode the pump. This causes noise and damage.

uz: HRSG economizer eng oxirgi (eng sovuq gaz) qismi. U qolgan issiqlik bilan HRSG'ga kirayotgan suvni oldindan isitadi, bu samaradorlikni oshiradi.
en: An HRSG economizer is the last (coolest gas) section. It preheats the incoming water with remaining heat, raising efficiency.

uz: HRSG evaporator suvni qaynatib bug'ga aylantiradi. Bu yerda suv va bug' aralashmasi bug' barabaniga borib ajratiladi.
en: An HRSG evaporator boils water into steam. Here the water-steam mixture goes to the steam drum to be separated.

uz: Steam drum (bug' barabani) suv va bug'ni ajratadi. Bug' yuqoriga chiqadi va turbinaga boradi, suv esa qayta aylanishga tushadi.
en: A steam drum separates water from steam. Steam rises and goes to the turbine, while water returns to circulate.

uz: Bug' barabanida suv sathi nazorati juda muhim — juda past bo'lsa quvurlar kuyadi, juda yuqori bo'lsa suv turbinaga o'tib ketadi.
en: Water level control in the steam drum is critical — too low and tubes overheat, too high and water carries into the turbine.

uz: Attemperator (desuperheater) bug'ga oz suv purkab, uning haroratini kerakli darajaga tushiradi. Juda issiq bug' turbinani shikastlashi mumkin.
en: An attemperator (desuperheater) sprays a little water into steam to lower its temperature. Steam that's too hot can damage the turbine.

uz: Duct burner HRSG ichida qo'shimcha yoqilg'i yoqib, ko'proq bug' hosil qiladi. U talab yuqori bo'lganda quvvatni oshiradi.
en: A duct burner burns extra fuel inside the HRSG to make more steam. It boosts power when demand is high.

uz: Deaerator suvdan erigan kislorod va gazlarni chiqarib tashlaydi. Kislorod metallni yemiradi (korroziya), shuning uchun bug' tizimidan oldin olib tashlanadi.
en: A deaerator removes dissolved oxygen and gases from water. Oxygen corrodes metal, so it's stripped out before the water enters the steam system.

uz: Blowdown qozon suvidan bir qismini chiqarib tashlash. Bug'lanish natijasida to'plangan tuzlarni olib chiqib, quyqa hosil bo'lishini oldini oladi.
en: Blowdown removes part of the boiler water. It carries out salts concentrated by evaporation, preventing scale buildup.

uz: Feedwater — HRSG'ga haydaladigan suv. U avval qizdiriladi va deaeratorda kislorodsizlantiriladi, so'ng yuqori bosim ostida qozonga boradi.
en: Feedwater is water pumped into the HRSG. It's first heated and deaerated, then sent to the boiler under high pressure.

uz: Gaz turbinasi ishga tushishida SFC (Static Frequency Converter) generatorni motor qilib ishlatib, rotorni yonish boshlanguncha aylantiradi.
en: At startup, the SFC (Static Frequency Converter) runs the generator as a motor to spin the rotor until combustion takes over.

uz: FSNL (Full Speed No Load) turbina to'liq tezlikda aylanayotgan, lekin hali to'rga quvvat bermayotgan holat. Bu sinxronizatsiyadan oldingi tayyorgarlik.
en: FSNL (Full Speed No Load) is when the turbine spins at full speed but isn't yet supplying power — a preparation stage before synchronization.

uz: Load ramp turbina to'rga ulangach, quvvatni asta-sekin oshirish. Tez ramp foydali, lekin jihozni ko'proq charchatadi (termik kuchlanish).
en: A load ramp is gradually raising power after the turbine connects to the grid. Fast ramping is useful but wears equipment more (thermal stress).

uz: Turning operation turbina to'xtagach rotorni sekin aylantirib turish. To'xtagandan keyin soatlab davom etadi, rotor egilib (bow) qolmasligi uchun.
en: Turning operation is slowly rotating the rotor after shutdown. It continues for hours to keep the rotor from bowing.

uz: Spin cooling turbinani to'xtatgach uni bir muddat aylantirib, issiqlikni bir tekis tarqatib sovutish usuli. Bu notekis sovushdan kelib chiqadigan egilishni oldini oladi.
en: Spin cooling is rotating the turbine for a while after shutdown to distribute heat evenly. It prevents bowing from uneven cooling.

uz: Ishga tushirish ketma-ketligi: rotorni aylantirish (SFC), purge, yoqish, tezlatish, sinxronizatsiya, yuk berish. Har qadam tekshiriladi.
en: Startup sequence: spin the rotor (SFC), purge, ignition, accelerate, synchronize, apply load. Each step is verified.

q: Lube oil emergency pump ko'pincha qaysi tokda ishlaydi?
options: DC (batareya) — tok yo'qolsa ham ishlashi uchun
explain: Batareyada ishlaganidan, umumiy tok yo'qolsa ham podshipniklarga moy uzatadi.

q: Lube oil cooler changeover nima imkon beradi?
options: Turbina to'xtatmasdan coolerni almashtirish va tozalash
explain: Biri ishlaganda ikkinchisi xizmat ko'rsatiladi, turbina uzluksiz ishlaydi.

q: Lube oil mist separator nima qiladi?
options: Moy tumanini ushlab toza havo chiqaradi
explain: Moy bakidan chiqadigan tumanni ushlab, moyni tejaydi va atrofni ifloslamaydi.

q: Nega podshipnik yumshoq oq metall (babbitt) bilan qoplanadi?
options: Zarracha tushsa valni emas, o'zini shikastlaydi
explain: Arzon yumshoq qatlam qimmatli valni shikastdan saqlaydi.

q: Journal bearing va thrust bearing farqi nima?
options: Journal yon tomondan, thrust o'q bo'ylab ushlaydi
explain: Journal aylanishni, thrust o'q bo'ylab siljishni ushlaydi.

q: Podshipnikda val va metall orasida nima bor?
explain: Val moy qatlamida suzadi, metall metallga tegmaydi, ishqalanish kamayadi.

q: Jacking oil (yuqori bosimli moy) qachon eng muhim?
explain: Sekin aylanishda moy pardasi zaif, jacking oil valni ko'tarib metall tegishdan saqlaydi.

q: Tilting-pad podshipnik nima afzallik beradi?
options: Yuqori tezlikda barqaror va vibratsiyaga chidamli
explain: Egiluvchi tagliklar valga moslashib yuqori tezlikda barqarorlik beradi.

q: Lube oil heater nima uchun kerak?
options: Start oldi sovuq moyni isitib yaxshi oqishini ta'minlash
explain: Iliq moy yaxshi oqadi, sovuq moy quyuq, start osonlashadi.

q: Nega moy tizimida ikkita cooler yoki filter bo'ladi?
options: Biri ishlaganda ikkinchisini tozalash va almashtirish mumkin
explain: Turbina to'xtatmasdan biri ishlab, ikkinchisini xizmat ko'rsatish mumkin.

q: Turbinani sovutuvchi havo qayerdan olinadi?
options: Kompressordan — bir qismi ajratilib turbinani sovutadi
explain: Kompressor havosining bir qismi turbinaning issiq qismlarini sovutadi.

q: Casing cooling (korpusni sovutish) nima uchun kerak?
explain: Notekis qizish korpusni egadi, sovutish rotor bilan mosligini saqlaydi.

q: Kirish havo filtri nega muhim?
explain: Iflos havo pichoqlarni yeyadi va FIK'ni tushiradi, filtr ularni himoya qiladi.

q: Nega yoqilg'i gaz turbinaga kirishdan oldin isitiladi?
options: Issiq gaz barqarorroq yonadi, FIK oshadi
explain: Isitilgan gaz barqaror yonadi va combined cycle samaradorligini oshiradi.

q: CO2 fire fighting tizimi ishga tushishdan oldin nima bo'ladi?
explain: CO2 kislorodni kamaytiradi, odamlar uchun xavfli, avval ogohlantiradi.

q: Nega instrument air (asbob havosi) quruq bo'lishi kerak?
options: Nam havo asbob va klapanni buzadi (korroziya, muzlash)
explain: Namlik korroziya yoki muzlashga olib keladi, dryer havoni quritadi.

q: Gaz turbinasi chiqindi gazi combined cycle'da qayerga boradi?
explain: Chiqindi issiqligi HRSG'da bug' hosil qilib qo'shimcha quvvat beradi.

q: Lube oil va control oil farqi nima?
options: Lube podshipnik uchun, control klapan harakati uchun
explain: Lube oil podshipnik moylash va sovutish, control oil klapan va aktuator harakati uchun.

q: AVR (Automatic Voltage Regulator) nima qiladi?
options: Qo'zg'atish tokini rostlab kuchlanishni barqaror ushlaydi
explain: Yuk o'zgarsa ham generator kuchlanishini tekis ushlaydi.

q: Nega generator vodorod bilan to'ldirishdan oldin CO2 bilan tozalanadi?
options: Vodorod havo bilan aralashsa portlash xavfli
explain: Inert gaz (CO2) havoni surib chiqaradi, portlash xavfini yo'qotadi.

q: Generatorni sovutish uchun suv qanday bo'lishi kerak?
options: Juda toza (deionlangan) — aks holda tok o'tkazadi
explain: Oddiy suv tok o'tkazib qisqa tutashuv qiladi, deionlangan suv izolyator.

q: Partial discharge monitoringi nimaga yordam beradi?
explain: Mayda uchqunlar izolatsiya eskirishini ko'rsatadi, kutilmagan nosozlik oldini oladi.

q: Nega turbina pichoqlari superqotishmadan yasaladi?
options: Yuqori haroratda mustahkam qolib, erish va creepga chidaydi
explain: Superqotishma juda yuqori haroratda ham mustahkamlikni saqlaydi.

q: Creep (metall cho'zilishi) nima?
options: Yuqori harorat va yukdan metall asta cho'zilishi
explain: Turbina pichoqlari yillar davomida sekin cho'ziladi, umri shu bilan cheklangan.

q: TBC (termik bariyer qoplama) nima qiladi?
explain: Keramik qoplama metallni issiqdan himoya qilib pichoq umrini uzaytiradi.

q: Bug' turbinasi gland seal (val zichlagichi) nima uchun kerak?
options: Havo kondensatorga kirmasligi va bug' sizmasligi uchun
explain: Val korpusdan chiqadigan joyni zichlab, vakuumni saqlaydi va bug' yo'qotishning oldini oladi.

q: Ishga tushirishda bug' drenaji nima uchun juda muhim?
options: Kondensatni chiqarib water hammer'ning oldini olish
explain: Sovuq quvurlarda hosil bo'lgan suv chiqarilmasa, suv zarbasi jihozni sindiradi.

q: LP hood spray nima uchun kerak?
options: Past yukda LP qismini sovutish uchun
explain: Kam bug' oqimida LP qismi qizib ketadi, suv purkash uni sovutadi.

q: Rotor pre-warming (oldindan isitish) nima beradi?
explain: Sovuq rotorni asta isitib, to'satdan issiq bug'dan keladigan kuchlanishni oldini oladi.

q: HPV va IPV klapanlar bug' turbinasida nima qiladi?
options: Kirayotgan bug' oqimini boshqaradi va favqulodda yopadi
explain: Ular quvvatni rostlaydi (control) va xavfda to'liq yopiladi (stop).

q: Bug' turbinasida rotor vibratsiyasi nima uchun kuzatiladi?
explain: Vibratsiya o'sishi nomutanosiblik, rotor egilishi yoki podshipnik yeyilishini ko'rsatadi.

q: Nega off-frequency operation (me'yordan chetga chastota) vaqti cheklanadi?
explain: Pichoqlar ma'lum chastotaga mo'ljallangan, chetda rezonans ularni yemiradi.

q: Nega bug' turbinasiga toza (past tuzli) bug' kerak?
options: Tuz pichoqlarga cho'kma bo'lib ularni yemiradi
explain: Erigan tuzlar pichoqlarda cho'kma hosil qilib korroziya va samaradorlik yo'qotishiga olib keladi.

q: Bug' turbinasi qaysi qismida eng ko'p kengayadi?
explain: Past bosimda hajm katta, LP pichoqlari shu bois eng uzun.

q: Bug'ni reheat qilish (qayta qizdirish) nima beradi?
options: Ko'proq ish, yuqori FIK, quruqroq bug'
explain: Ikki marta qizdirib ko'proq ish oladi va oxirgi bosqichda bug'ni quruqroq saqlaydi.

q: Nega to'xtagan bug' turbinasi rotori turning gear bilan aylantiriladi?
explain: Bir joyda tursa rotor notekis sovub egiladi, aylantirib turish buni oldini oladi.

q: HRSG'ning qaysi qismi suvni oldindan isitadi?
explain: Economizer qolgan issiqlik bilan suvni oldindan isitib samaradorlikni oshiradi.

q: Bug' barabanida suv sathi juda yuqori bo'lsa nima xavf?
options: Suv turbinaga o'tib ketib shikast beradi
explain: Ortiqcha suv turbinaga o'tsa (carryover), pichoqlarni shikastlaydi.

q: Attemperator nima qiladi?
explain: Juda issiq bug' turbinaga zararli, attemperator uni kerakli haroratga tushiradi.

q: Duct burner qachon foydalanadi?
options: Talab yuqori bo'lganda ko'proq bug' va quvvat uchun
explain: HRSG'da qo'shimcha yoqilg'i yoqib ko'proq bug' va quvvat beradi.

q: Deaerator nima uchun kerak?
options: Suvdan kislorodni chiqarib korroziyani oldini oladi
explain: Erigan kislorod metallni yemiradi, deaerator uni chiqaradi.

q: Qozon blowdown'i nima uchun qilinadi?
options: To'plangan tuzlarni chiqarib quyqani oldini oladi
explain: Bug'lanishdan to'plangan tuzlarni chiqarib korroziya va quyqani oldini oladi.

q: Kompressor surge'i nima?
explain: Teskari oqim kuchli tebranish va pichoqlarga shikast keltiradi, IGV va VV buni oldini oladi.

q: Nega kompressor pichoqlari chiqishga tomon kichrayadi?
options: Havo siqilib zichlashgan sari kam hajm kerak
explain: Siqilgan havo zichroq, kamroq hajm egallaydi, shu bois pichoqlar kichrayadi.

q: Offline kompressor yuvish online'dan nima bilan farq qiladi?
options: To'xtatib chuqur tozalaydi, ko'proq FIK tiklaydi
explain: Online yengil ishlab turganda, offline chuqur to'xtatib, ko'proq FIK tiklaydi.

q: Flame detector alanga o'chganini sezsa nima qiladi?
explain: Aks holda yonmagan gaz to'planib portlash xavfi tug'iladi.

q: Transition piece nima vazifani bajaradi?
options: Yonish kamerasini turbinaga bog'lab eng issiq gazga bardosh beradi
explain: Yonish kamerasi bilan turbina orasidagi eng issiq qism.

q: Gaz turbinasi yonishi boshlangach ignition (uchqun) kerakmi?
explain: Yonish boshlangach alanga o'zini saqlaydi, uchqun o'chiriladi.

q: PID controller qaysi uch qismdan iborat?
explain: Proporsional (hozirgi xato), integral (to'plangan) va differensial (o'zgarish tezligi) silliq boshqaruv beradi.

q: Thermocouple (termopara) qanday ishlaydi?
options: Ikki metall birikmasidagi kuchlanish orqali harorat o'lchaydi
explain: Ikki xil metall birikmasi haroratga qarab kichik kuchlanish beradi, yuqori harorat uchun ideal.

q: Interlock nima vazifani bajaradi?
options: Xavfli yoki noto'g'ri ketma-ketlikdagi amalni bloklaydi
explain: Shart bajarilmasa amalni bloklab, jihoz va odamni himoya qiladi.

q: Nega sanoat datchiklari 4-20 mA signaldan foydalanadi?
explain: 4-20 mA elektr shovqinga chidamli va uzoq masofaga ishonchli uzatiladi.

q: Gate valve va globe valve farqi nima?
options: Gate ochiq yoki yopiq, globe oqimni rostlaydi
explain: Gate valve to'sish yoki ochish uchun, globe valve oqimni nozik rostlash uchun.

q: Strainer (filtr to'r) nima uchun kerak?
options: Yirik zarrachalarni to'sib nasos va klapanni himoya qilish
explain: Zarrachalar impeller va klapanlarni shikastlashi mumkin, strainer ularni ushlaydi.

q: Nega muhim nasoslar juftlik (duty va standby) o'rnatiladi?
options: Biri buzilsa ikkinchisi ishlab to'xtash bo'lmasligi uchun
explain: Zaxira nasos avtomatik ishga tushib, stansiya to'xtamasligini ta'minlaydi.

q: NPSH nima uchun muhim?
options: So'rishda yetarli bosim bo'lmasa cavitatsiya boshlanadi
explain: Yetarli so'rish bosimi bo'lmasa cavitatsiya nasosni shikastlaydi.

q: Sovutish minorasidan chiqadigan oq tutun aslida nima?
explain: Bu tutun emas, bug'langan suvning kondensatlangan bug'i.

q: Condensate pump nima qiladi?
options: Kondensator tubidan suvni qayta siklga haydaydi
explain: Yig'ilgan suvni deaerator yoki HRSG'ga qaytarib, yopiq siklni davom ettiradi.

q: Releli himoyada selektivlik (tanlovchanlik) nima degani?
options: Faqat shikastlangan qismni uzish, sog'lomini qoldirish
explain: Selektivlik faqat nosoz qismni uzib, iste'molchilarni keraksiz o'chishdan saqlaydi.

q: Zaxira himoya (backup) qachon ishlaydi?
explain: Zaxira himoya biroz kechikish bilan, asosiy himoya ishlamasa harakatga kiradi.

q: APV (avtomatik qayta ulash) nima uchun foydali?
options: Ko'p qisqa tutashuvlar o'tkinchi — qayta ulaganda yo'qoladi
explain: O'tkinchi nosozlik (masalan chaqmoq) qayta ulaganda ketadi, ta'minot tiklanadi.

q: Nega releli himoya operativ zanjiri batareya (DC)da ishlaydi?
options: Asosiy tok yo'qolganda ham ishlashi uchun
explain: Batareya tufayli asosiy ta'minot yo'qolganda ham himoya ishlaydi.

q: AVR (zaxirani avtomatik ulash) qachon ishlaydi?
explain: Iste'molchini zaxira manbaga avtomatik ulab, uzilishni minimallashtiradi.

q: Yirik transformatorlar nega moy bilan sovutiladi?
options: Moy ham izolatsiya, ham issiqlik chiqaradi
explain: Moy ikki vazifa: elektr izolyatsiyasi va issiqlikni olib chiqish.

q: Yuqori kuchlanishli uzgich yoyni qanday o'chiradi?
explain: Oddiy havoda yoy uzoq yonadi, SF6 yoki vakuum uni tez o'chiradi.

q: Auxiliary power nima?
options: Stansiyaning o'zi ishlashi uchun sarflaydigan elektr
explain: Nasos, ventilyator, boshqaruv — stansiyaning o'z ehtiyoji, generator quvvatining bir necha foizi.

q: Nega stansiyada batareya (DC) tizimi bo'ladi?
options: Asosiy tok yo'qolganda ham himoya va boshqaruv ishlashi uchun
explain: Batareya asosiy ta'minot yo'qolganda himoya va turbinani xavfsiz to'xtatishga imkon beradi.

q: UPS nima uchun kerak?
explain: Batareya va inverter orqali bir zumga ham uzilmasdan tok beradi.

q: Generatorni to'rga ulashdan oldin nima qilinadi?
options: Sinxronizatsiya — chastota, kuchlanish, faza mos qilinadi
explain: Chastota, kuchlanish va faza mos kelmasa kuchli zarba bo'ladi.

q: Rotor grounding device nega kerak?
options: Val zaryadini yerga chiqarib podshipnikni saqlash
explain: Statik zaryad podshipnikka uchqun urib yemiradi, grounding uni yerga chiqaradi.

q: Motor control center (MCC) nima qiladi?
options: Past kuchlanishli motorlarni boshqaradi va himoyalaydi
explain: Nasos, ventilyator kabi motorlarni ulash, uzish va himoya qiladi.

q: Preventiv ta'mir va prediktiv ta'mir farqi nima?
options: Preventiv jadval bo'yicha, prediktiv holatga qarab
explain: Preventiv jadval bilan, prediktiv jihoz holatini kuzatib kerakli vaqtda qilinadi.

q: LOTO'da qulfni kim ocha oladi?
explain: Faqat ishni bajaruvchi ochadi, boshqa birov bexosdan yoqib yubormaydi.

q: Nega tor makonga kirishdan oldin havo tekshiriladi?
options: Kislorod yetarli va zaharli gaz yo'qligiga ishonch uchun
explain: Kislorod kam yoki zaharli gaz bo'lishi mumkin, kirishdan oldin tekshiriladi.

q: Borescope inspection qanday afzallik beradi?
explain: Ingichka kamera orqali ichki pichoqlar ko'riladi, vaqt va xarajat tejaladi.

q: Xavfsizlik belgilarida qizil rang nimani bildiradi?
explain: Qizil xavf yoki to'xtash, sariq ogohlantirish, yashil xavfsiz.

q: NDT (non-destructive testing) afzalligi nima?
explain: Ultratovush, radiografiya yashirin yoriqlarni jihozni buzmasdan topadi.

q: Hot work permit nima uchun kerak?
options: Uchqun va olovli ishni xavfsiz sharoitda bajarish
explain: Yoqilg'i va moy yaqinida uchqun xavfli, permit xavfsizlikni ta'minlaydi.

q: GTCC'da gaz va bug' turbinasi quvvat nisbati qanday?
options: Gaz taxminan uchdan ikki, bug' uchdan bir
explain: Gaz turbinasi asosiy quvvat, bug' turbinasi chiqindi issiqlikdan qo'shimcha.

q: Nega yozda gaz turbinasi quvvati pasayadi?
options: Issiq havo kam zich — kompressor kam havo siqadi
explain: Issiq havo zichligi past, kompressor kamroq massali havo siqadi, quvvat tushadi.

q: Past heat rate nimani bildiradi?
explain: Heat rate past bo'lsa FIK yuqori, kam yoqilg'i bilan ko'p elektr.

q: Inlet air cooling nima beradi?
options: Havoni zichroq qilib issiq kunda quvvat tiklaydi
explain: Sovuq zich havo kompressorga ko'proq massa beradi, quvvat tiklanadi.

q: Elektr quvvati qanday hisoblanadi?
explain: Quvvat (Vatt) kuchlanish (Volt) va tok (Amper) ko'paytmasiga teng.

q: Nega elektr tarmoqlari o'zgaruvchan tok (AC)da ishlaydi?
options: Transformator bilan kuchlanishni oson o'zgartirish mumkin
explain: AC'ni transformator bilan oson oshirish yoki pasaytirish mumkin, uzatish uchun qulay.

q: Uch fazali tizimda fazalar bir-biridan qancha surilgan?
explain: Uch faza 120 gradusga surilgan, bu silliq va samarali quvvat beradi.

q: Governor (tezlik rostlagich) nima qiladi?
explain: Yuk oshsa yoqilg'i yoki bug'ni ko'paytirib tezlikni (chastotani) saqlaydi.

q: Gaz turbinasi ishga tushirishda SFC nima qiladi?
explain: Generator vaqtincha motor bo'lib, rotorni yonish boshlanguncha aylantiradi.

q: FSNL (Full Speed No Load) nima holat?
explain: Sinxronizatsiyadan oldingi holat, to'liq tezlik, lekin hali yuk yo'q.

q: Nega tez load ramp (quvvat oshirish) jihozni charchatadi?
explain: Tez isitish va sovutish termik kuchlanish va charchoq keltiradi.

q: Gaz turbinasi ishga tushirish to'g'ri ketma-ketligi qaysi?
options: Aylantirish, purge, yoqish, tezlatish, sinxron, yuk
explain: Har qadam tartib bilan va tekshirilgan holda bajariladi.

q: Turning operation to'xtagach qancha davom etadi?
explain: Rotor egilib qolmasligi uchun soatlab sekin aylantiriladi.

uz: Podshipnik vibratsiyasi asta oshib borsa, operator buni jiddiy qabul qilishi kerak: bu nomutanosiblik, moy pardasi buzilishi yoki podshipnik yeyilishining birinchi belgisi. Trend (o'sish tezligi) keskin bo'lsa, yuk kamaytiriladi va tekshiruv rejalashtiriladi.
en: If bearing vibration slowly rises, the operator must take it seriously: it's an early sign of imbalance, oil-film breakdown or bearing wear. If the trend rises sharply, load is reduced and inspection scheduled.

uz: Podshipnik harorati normal ishda barqaror bo'lishi kerak. Agar bir podshipnik boshqalaridan issiqroq bo'lsa yoki asta ko'tarilib borsa — bu moy oqimi kamaygan yoki yeyilish boshlanganini bildiradi. Operator moy bosimi va oqimini tekshiradi.
en: Bearing temperature should be steady in normal operation. If one bearing is hotter than the others or slowly climbs, it means reduced oil flow or beginning wear. The operator checks oil pressure and flow.

uz: Moy bosimi pasaya boshlasa, operator birinchi navbatda filtrni tekshiradi (tiqilib qolgan bo'lishi mumkin) va zaxira nasos ishlayotganiga ishonch hosil qiladi. Bosim kritik darajaga tushsa, turbina avtomatik trip bo'ladi.
en: If oil pressure starts dropping, the operator first checks the filter (it may be clogged) and confirms the standby pump is running. If pressure falls to a critical level, the turbine trips automatically.

uz: Moy filtrini almashtirish (changeover) paytida operator bosimni diqqat bilan kuzatadi: yangi filtrga o'tishda bosim bir zumga o'zgarishi mumkin. Almashtirish silliq bo'lishi va bosim tushib ketmasligi kerak.
en: During oil filter changeover, the operator watches pressure carefully: switching to the new filter can briefly change pressure. The changeover must be smooth without a pressure drop.

uz: Bug' turbinasini sovuq holatdan ishga tushirganda operator startup egri chizig'iga qat'iy amal qiladi: rotorni asta qizdirib, harorat farqini (differensial kengayish) nazorat qiladi. Shoshilish yoriq va deformatsiya keltiradi.
en: When starting a steam turbine from cold, the operator strictly follows the startup curve: heating the rotor slowly and watching the temperature difference (differential expansion). Rushing causes cracks and deformation.

uz: Differensial kengayish — rotor va korpusning turlicha kengayishi. Operator buni doimiy kuzatadi: agar rotor korpusdan tezroq kengaysa, ular tegib ketishi (rubbing) mumkin. Chegaraga yaqinlashsa, qizdirish sekinlashtiriladi.
en: Differential expansion is the different expansion of rotor and casing. The operator watches it constantly: if the rotor expands faster than the casing, they can rub. Near the limit, heating is slowed.

uz: Bug' turbinasida g'ayritabiiy shovqin yoki keskin vibratsiya sakrashi 'rubbing' (rotor korpusga tegishi) belgisi bo'lishi mumkin. Operator darhol yukni kamaytiradi va sababni aniqlaydi — bu jiddiy ogohlantirish.
en: An unusual noise or a sudden vibration jump in a steam turbine can signal rubbing (rotor touching casing). The operator immediately reduces load and finds the cause — a serious warning.

uz: Kondensator vakuumi asta yomonlashsa, operator sabablarni tekshiradi: havo sizishi, vakuum nasosi nosozligi yoki sovutish suvi kamayishi. Vakuum tushsa, turbina quvvati ham tushadi.
en: If condenser vacuum slowly worsens, the operator checks the causes: air in-leak, vacuum pump fault or reduced cooling water. If vacuum drops, turbine power drops too.

uz: Chiqindi gaz harorati (EGT) notekis bo'lsa — ya'ni ba'zi datchiklar boshqalaridan yuqori ko'rsatsa — bu yonish kamerasida muammo (bir combustor yaxshi yonmayapti) belgisi. Operator EGT tarqalishini (spread) kuzatadi.
en: If exhaust gas temperature (EGT) is uneven — some sensors read higher than others — it signals a combustor problem (one isn't burning well). The operator watches the EGT spread.

uz: EGT spread (harorat tarqalishi) keskin oshsa, bu yoqilg'i forsunkasi tiqilishi yoki alanga muammosini bildiradi. Chegaradan oshsa, boshqaruv tizimi turbinani himoya uchun trip qiladi.
en: A sharp rise in EGT spread indicates a clogged fuel nozzle or flame issue. If it exceeds the limit, the control system trips the turbine for protection.

uz: Gaz turbinasi ishga tushishida operator yoqish (ignition) sodir bo'lganini EGT ko'tarilishidan biladi. Agar belgilangan vaqtda alanga tutmasa, tizim yoqilg'ini to'xtatib, qayta purge qiladi — yonmagan gaz to'planmasligi uchun.
en: During gas turbine startup, the operator knows ignition occurred from the EGT rise. If the flame doesn't catch in time, the system stops fuel and purges again — so unburned gas doesn't accumulate.

uz: Kompressor surge belgilari: keskin shovqin (bo'kirish), vibratsiya va oqim tebranishi. Operator buni sezsa, darhol yukni kamaytiradi va IGV holatini tekshiradi. Surge pichoqlarni tez shikastlaydi.
en: Compressor surge signs: a loud noise (booming), vibration and flow oscillation. If the operator senses it, they immediately reduce load and check IGV position. Surge quickly damages blades.

uz: Kompressor samaradorligi asta tushib borsa (bir xil yoqilg'ida quvvat kamaysa), bu pichoqlar ifloslanganini bildiradi. Operator online yuvishni rejalashtiradi; katta tushish bo'lsa, offline yuvish kerak.
en: If compressor efficiency slowly falls (less power at the same fuel), it means the blades are fouled. The operator schedules online washing; for a big drop, offline washing is needed.

uz: Generatorni to'rga ulashda operator sinxroskopni kuzatadi: chastota, kuchlanish va faza mos kelgan lahzada uzgichni yopadi. Noto'g'ri lahzada ulash kuchli mexanik zarba beradi.
en: When connecting a generator to the grid, the operator watches the synchroscope: closing the breaker at the moment frequency, voltage and phase match. Closing at the wrong moment gives a strong mechanical shock.

uz: Vodorod bilan sovutiladigan generatorda operator vodorod bosimi va tozaligini kuzatadi. Tozalik tushsa (havo aralashsa), bu xavfli — seal oil tizimi tekshiriladi. Vodorod sizishi jiddiy xavfsizlik masalasi.
en: In a hydrogen-cooled generator, the operator monitors hydrogen pressure and purity. If purity drops (air mixing in), it's dangerous — the seal oil system is checked. Hydrogen leakage is a serious safety issue.

uz: Generator stator o'ramlari harorati notekis bo'lsa yoki ko'tarilsa, operator sovutish tizimini (havo, vodorod yoki suv) tekshiradi. Qizib ketish izolatsiyani buzadi va generator umrini qisqartiradi.
en: If generator stator winding temperature is uneven or rises, the operator checks the cooling system (air, hydrogen or water). Overheating damages insulation and shortens generator life.

uz: Alarm chiqqanda operatorning birinchi vazifasi — uni tan olish (acknowledge) va sababni aniqlash, ko'r-ko'rona o'chirmaslik. Har alarm bir voqeani bildiradi; e'tiborsizlik katta nosozlikka olib kelishi mumkin.
en: When an alarm sounds, the operator's first task is to acknowledge it and find the cause, not blindly silence it. Each alarm signals an event; ignoring it can lead to a major fault.

uz: Tajribali operator faqat hozirgi qiymatga emas, trendga (o'zgarish yo'nalishiga) qaraydi. Sekin ko'tarilayotgan harorat yoki bosim — kelajakdagi nosozlikning ogohlantirishi. Trendni erta ko'rish avariyani oldini oladi.
en: An experienced operator looks not just at the current value but at the trend (direction of change). A slowly rising temperature or pressure warns of a future fault. Seeing the trend early prevents a breakdown.

uz: Ishga tushirishdan oldin purge (tozalash) majburiy: ventilyator yoki aylanuvchi turbina yo'llardagi yonmagan gazni chiqarib tashlaydi. Operator purge to'liq bajarilganiga ishonch hosil qilmaguncha yoqishga ruxsat berilmaydi.
en: Before startup, a purge is mandatory: a fan or the spinning turbine clears any unburned gas from the paths. Ignition isn't allowed until the operator confirms the purge is complete.

uz: Rotorni tezlatishda operator kritik tezliklardan tez o'tadi — bu tezliklarda rezonans vibratsiyasi kuchayadi. Kritik tezlikda uzoq turish taqiqlanadi, chunki u shikast keltiradi.
en: When accelerating the rotor, the operator passes quickly through critical speeds — resonance vibration peaks at these speeds. Lingering at a critical speed is forbidden, as it causes damage.

uz: HRSG barabani suv sathi operator uchun eng muhim ko'rsatkichlardan. Juda past — quvurlar kuyadi; juda yuqori — suv turbinaga o'tadi. Operator sathni tor oraliqda ushlaydi va feedwater klapanini shunga qarab rostlaydi.
en: The HRSG drum water level is one of the most important indicators for an operator. Too low and tubes overheat; too high and water carries to the turbine. The operator keeps the level in a narrow band and adjusts the feedwater valve accordingly.

uz: Bug'da namlik ortsa (carryover), bu baraban sathi juda yuqori yoki suv sifati yomon ekanini bildiradi. Operator sathni pasaytiradi va suv kimyosini tekshiradi — nam bug' turbina pichoqlarini yeyadi.
en: If steam moisture rises (carryover), it means the drum level is too high or water quality is poor. The operator lowers the level and checks water chemistry — wet steam erodes turbine blades.

uz: Generator trip bo'lganda operator avval nima sabab bo'lganini (qaysi himoya ishlagan) aniqlaydi. Sababni tushunmasdan qayta ulash xavfli — agar nosozlik saqlanib qolgan bo'lsa, u yana takrorlanadi.
en: When a generator trips, the operator first identifies the cause (which protection operated). Reconnecting without understanding the cause is dangerous — if the fault remains, it will recur.

uz: To'r chastotasi pasaysa, bu tizimda quvvat yetishmasligini bildiradi. Operator (yoki avtomatika) generator quvvatini oshiradi. Agar chastota juda tushsa, yuk tushirish (load shedding) ishga tushadi.
en: If grid frequency drops, it means the system is short of power. The operator (or automatics) raises generator output. If frequency falls too far, load shedding activates.

uz: Jihozni ta'mirga topshirishda operator LOTO tartibini bajaradi: jihozni to'xtatib, energiya manbaini uzadi, qulflaydi va belgi osadi. Faqat shundan keyin ta'mirchi xavfsiz ishlay oladi.
en: When handing equipment over for repair, the operator follows LOTO: stops the equipment, isolates the energy source, locks it and hangs a tag. Only then can the technician work safely.

uz: Operator muntazam obhodda (aylanib chiqishda) ko'zi, qulog'i va hidi bilan tekshiradi: g'ayritabiiy shovqin, tebranish, sizib chiqqan moy yoki kuygan hid. Ko'p nosozlik datchik ko'rsatishdan oldin shunday seziladi.
en: On regular rounds, the operator inspects with eyes, ears and nose: unusual noise, vibration, leaked oil or a burning smell. Many faults are noticed this way before a sensor shows them.

uz: Nasos g'alati shag'irlagan ovoz chiqarsa (go'yo ichida tosh bordek), bu kavitatsiya belgisi. Operator so'rish bosimini tekshiradi va oqimni rostlaydi. Kavitatsiya davom etsa, nasos ichini yemiradi.
en: If a pump makes a strange rattling sound (as if gravel is inside), it's a sign of cavitation. The operator checks suction pressure and adjusts flow. If cavitation continues, it erodes the pump internals.

uz: Ishlayotgan nasos to'xtab qolsa, zaxira nasos avtomatik ishga tushishi kerak. Operator buni tasdiqlaydi va to'xtagan nasosning sababini aniqlaydi. Ikkala nasos ham ishlamasa, tizim xavf ostida qoladi.
en: If the running pump stops, the standby pump should start automatically. The operator confirms this and finds why the first pump stopped. If both pumps fail, the system is at risk.

q: Gaz turbinasi qaysi termodinamik siklda ishlaydi?
explain: Gaz turbinasi Brayton siklida ishlaydi: siqish, yonish, kengayish.

q: Gaz turbinasining uch asosiy qismi qaysi?
explain: Kompressor havoni siqadi, yonish kamerasi yoqilg'i yoqadi, turbina energiyani aylanishga aylantiradi.

q: Gaz turbinasida foydali quvvat qanday olinadi?
explain: Kompressor turbina quvvatining deyarli yarmini iste'mol qiladi, qolgani foydali.

q: Nega eng issiq turbina pichoqlari monokristall (single-crystal) qilinadi?
options: Butun pichoq bitta kristall, yuqori haroratda mustahkamroq
explain: Kristall chegaralari yo'qligi pichoqni yuqori haroratda mustahkamroq qiladi.

q: Kompressorda stator (qo'zg'almas) pichoqlari nima qiladi?
explain: Rotor pichoqlar tezlashtiradi, stator pichoqlar tezlikni bosimga aylantiradi.

q: Nega kompressorda o'nlab bosqich bo'ladi?
options: Har bosqich oz siqadi, birga katta bosim beradi
explain: Bir bosqich havoni oz siqadi, o'nlab bosqich birgalikda 20-25 barobar oshiradi.

q: VV (Variable Vanes) IGV bilan birga nima qiladi?
options: Havo oqimini moslab surge'ni oldini oladi
explain: Kompressor bosqichlaridagi o'zgaruvchan pichoqlar oqimni moslab surge'dan saqlaydi.

q: Yonish kamerasi 'liner' (ichki devor) qanday himoyalanadi?
options: Sovutish teshiklari va keramik qoplama bilan
explain: Liner eng qattiq issiqlikka duchor, sovutish teshiklari va keramik qoplama uni saqlaydi.

q: Combustion dynamics (bosim tebranishi) nega kuzatiladi?
explain: Premix yonish samarali, lekin tebranishga moyil, nazorat qismlarni saqlaydi.

q: Generator exciter (qo'zg'atgich) nima beradi?
explain: Exciter rotorga magnitlash tokini beradi, bu tok kuchlanishni boshqaradi.

q: Vodorod bilan sovutiladigan generatorda seal oil nima qiladi?
options: Val atrofidan vodorod sizib chiqishini to'sadi
explain: Seal oil val atrofini zichlab, vodorodning sizib chiqishini oldini oladi.

q: Katta generator stator o'ramlari suv bilan qanday sovutiladi?
options: Ich bo'sh mis o'tkazgichlar orqali toza suv oqadi
explain: Deionlangan suv ich bo'sh mis o'tkazgichlar ichidan oqib, issiqlikni olib chiqadi.

q: Nega tok va kuchlanish CT/VT orqali o'lchanadi?
options: Katta qiymatni xavfsiz kichiraytirib, asboblarni himoya qilish
explain: CT/VT katta tok va kuchlanishni xavfsiz kichik qiymatga aylantiradi.

q: Gland steam condenser nima qiladi?
options: Gland seal'dan chiqqan bug'ni yig'ib kondensatlaydi
explain: Val zichlagichidan chiqqan bug'-havo aralashmasini yig'ib, bug'ni tejaydi.

q: Bug' turbinasi last stage blade nega eng ko'p sinovga tushadi?
options: Katta hajmdagi past bosim bug'ni qabul qiladi
explain: Eng uzun pichoq, katta markazdan qochma kuch va katta bug' hajmiga duchor.

q: Impulse bug' turbinasida bug' qayerda tezlashadi?
explain: Impulse'da soplo, reaction'da pichoqning o'zi bug'ni tezlashtiradi.

q: Bug' turbinasi klapanlarini nima harakatga keltiradi?
explain: Gidravlik moy tizimi yuqori bosimli va tez, klapanni bir zumda yopa oladi.

q: HRSG evaporator nima qiladi?
explain: Evaporator suvni qaynatadi, aralashma barabanda ajratiladi.

q: Steam drum (bug' barabani) nima vazifani bajaradi?
explain: Bug' yuqoriga chiqib turbinaga boradi, suv qayta aylanishga tushadi.

q: Nega feedwater (HRSG suvi) oldindan isitiladi?
options: Iliq suvni bug'ga aylantirish kam issiqlik talab qiladi
explain: Iliq feedwater samaradorlikni oshiradi, kam qo'shimcha issiqlik kerak.

q: Nega bug' quvurlarida kengayish bo'g'ini bo'ladi?
explain: Issiq quvur kengayadi, bo'g'inlar harakatga imkon berib sinishni oldini oladi.

q: Combined cycle qaysi ikki siklni birlashtiradi?
explain: Gaz turbinasi Brayton, bug' turbinasi Rankine siklida, birga yuqori FIK.

q: Cogeneration nima beradi?
explain: Elektr va issiqlik birga, chiqindi issiqlik ishlatilib samaradorlik oshadi.

q: Availability (tayyorlik) yuqori bo'lsa nima yaxshi?
explain: Yuqori availability stansiya ko'p vaqt ishga tayyor va samarali ekanini bildiradi.

q: Capacity factor (quvvat koeffitsienti) nima ko'rsatadi?
explain: Yuqori capacity factor stansiya samarali va ko'p ishlatilganini bildiradi.

q: Bir megavatt (MVt) necha vattga teng?
explain: 1 MVt million vattga teng, yirik stansiya yuzlab MVt beradi.

q: Uch fazali tizim bir fazalidan nima bilan afzal?
options: Ko'proq quvvat uzatadi va motorlarni silliq aylantiradi
explain: Uch faza ko'proq quvvat uzatadi va motorlarni silliq aylantiradi, sanoat standarti.

q: To'rdagi generatorlar qanday aylanadi?
explain: Hamma bir chastotada sinxron, bitta ulkan mashina kabi birga ishlaydi.

q: To'rda talab to'satdan oshsa chastota nima bo'ladi?
options: Bir oz tushadi, generatorlar quvvat oshirib tiklaydi
explain: Chastota pasayishi talab oshganini bildiradi, generatorlar javob beradi.

q: Gaz turbinasi ishga tushirishda purge qaysi qadamda bo'ladi?
explain: Yonuvchi gazni tozalab, yoqishda portlash xavfini yo'qotadi.

q: Nega cold start hot start'dan uzoqroq davom etadi?
explain: Sovuq qismlarni tez qizdirish termik kuchlanish va shikast keltiradi.

q: Centrifugal pump bosimni qanday hosil qiladi?
explain: Impeller suyuqlikni markazdan tashqariga uloqtirib bosim yaratadi.

q: Butterfly valve (kapalak klapan) qanday ishlaydi?
explain: Disk burilib ochadi va yopadi, yengil va katta quvurlar uchun qulay.

q: RTD haroratni qanday o'lchaydi?
explain: Metall qarshiligi haroratga qarab o'zgaradi, RTD aniq lekin o'rta harorat uchun.

q: SCADA tizimi nima imkon beradi?
explain: Masofadan nazorat va ma'lumot yig'ish, dispetcher markazdan kuzatadi.

q: Pressure transmitter (bosim datchigi) nima qiladi?
explain: Bosim qiymatini datchik elektr signal (4-20 mA)ga aylantiradi.

q: Hot gas path inspection nimani tekshiradi?
options: Turbinaning eng issiq qismlari (pichoq, transition piece)
explain: Eng issiq qismlar eng ko'p yeyiladi, ular ko'zdan kechiriladi va almashtiriladi.

q: Oil analysis (moy tahlili) nimani aniqlaydi?
explain: Moydagi metall zarrachalar qaysi qism yeyilayotganini ko'rsatadi.

q: Condition monitoring nima beradi?
options: Nosozlikni oldindan sezib kutilmagan to'xtashni kamaytiradi
explain: Vibratsiya, harorat, moy kuzatilib nosozlik erta seziladi.

q: Lube oil accumulator nima qiladi?
options: Bosimli moyni zaxira sifatida saqlab uzilishda beradi
explain: Nasoslar orasidagi qisqa uzilishda ham moy uzatishni ta'minlaydi.

q: Kondensatorda issiqlik qanday uzatiladi?
options: Bug'dan sovutuvchi suvga quvur devori orqali
explain: Bug' quvur tashqarisida, sovutuvchi suv ichida, issiqlik devor orqali o'tadi.

q: Kondensatorda vakuumni nima saqlab turadi?
explain: Ular havo va bug'lanmagan gazlarni so'rib, past bosimni ushlab turadi.

q: Nega qisqa tutashuvni tez o'chirish muhim?
options: Energetika tizimi barqarorligini saqlaydi, avariya kengaymaydi
explain: Kechiksa generatorlar sinxronizmdan chiqib avariya kengayishi mumkin.

q: Releli himoyada sezgirlik nima degani?
options: Eng kichik nosozlikni ham sezish qobiliyati
explain: Sezgirlik tizimning barcha rejimlarida, hatto minimal rejimda ham yetarli bo'lishi kerak.

q: Releli himoyada ishonchlilik nimani anglatadi?
options: Kerak bo'lganda ishlash, kerak bo'lmaganda yolg'on ishlamaslik
explain: Sxema soddaligi va sifatli elementlar ishonchlilikni oshiradi.

q: Rele nima?
options: Kirish kattaligi chegaradan oshsa ishga tushib trip beradigan qurilma
explain: Rele kontaktlarini yopib, uzgichga trip buyrug'ini beradi.

q: Nega tokli otsechka liniyaning butun uzunligini qamramaydi?
options: Uzoq nosozlikda tok kamayadi, otsechka ajrata olmaydi
explain: Faqat boshini tez himoya qiladi, qolgani zaxira himoyada.

q: Rele o'rnatmasi (ustavka) noto'g'ri bo'lsa nima bo'ladi?
explain: To'g'ri o'rnatma kerak, aks holda yolg'on trip yoki nosozlikni o'tkazib yuborish.

q: Nega uzatish liniyalari eng ko'p himoya talab qiladi?
options: Uzun va ochiq havoda — chaqmoq, shamol, muz ta'sir qiladi
explain: Liniyalar energetika tizimining eng ko'p uchraydigan nosozlik joyi.

q: Yerga tutashuv himoyasi qachon ishlaydi?
explain: Yerga tutashuv ko'p uchraydigan nosozlik, tez topish muhim.

q: Teskari quvvat himoyasi nimani sezadi?
options: Generator motor bo'lib to'rdan tok tortishini
explain: Turbina quvvat bermay qolsa generator to'rdan tok tortadi, bu xavfli.

q: Transformator ulanganda o'tadigan inrush toki himoyaga qanday muammo tug'diradi?
explain: Differensial himoya inrush tokini haqiqiy nosozlikdan ajrata olishi kerak.

q: Transformatorning differensial himoyasi nimani solishtiradi?
explain: Ikki tomon toki farqi ichki nosozlikni (o'ram tutashuvi) ko'rsatadi.

q: Moy bosimi pasaya boshlaganda operator birinchi navbatda nimani tekshiradi?
explain: Filtr tiqilib qolishi mumkin, zaxira nasos ishlayotganiga ishonch hosil qilinadi.

q: Bir podshipnik boshqalardan issiqroq bo'lsa, bu nimani bildiradi?
options: Moy oqimi kamaygan yoki yeyilish boshlangan
explain: Operator moy bosimi va oqimini tekshiradi, bu erta ogohlantirish.

q: Differensial kengayish chegaraga yaqinlashsa operator nima qiladi?
explain: Rotor korpusdan tezroq kengaysa tegib ketishi (rubbing) mumkin, qizdirish sekinlashtiriladi.

q: Bug' turbinasida g'ayritabiiy shovqin va keskin vibratsiya sakrashi nima belgisi?
explain: Operator darhol yukni kamaytiradi va sababni aniqlaydi, bu jiddiy ogohlantirish.

q: EGT spread (harorat tarqalishi) keskin oshsa bu nimani bildiradi?
options: Yoqilg'i forsunkasi tiqilishi yoki alanga muammosi
explain: Chegaradan oshsa boshqaruv tizimi turbinani himoya uchun trip qiladi.

q: Kompressor surge belgilarini sezgan operator nima qiladi?
options: Darhol yukni kamaytiradi va IGV holatini tekshiradi
explain: Surge pichoqlarni tez shikastlaydi, keskin shovqin va vibratsiya belgisi.

q: Vodorod tozaligi tushsa (havo aralashsa) operator nimani tekshiradi?
explain: Vodorod sizishi jiddiy xavfsizlik masalasi, seal oil val atrofini zichlaydi.

q: Alarm chiqqanda operatorning birinchi vazifasi nima?
options: Uni tan olish va sababni aniqlash, ko'r-ko'rona o'chirmaslik
explain: Har alarm bir voqeani bildiradi, e'tiborsizlik katta nosozlikka olib kelishi mumkin.

q: Tajribali operator nimaga qaraydi?
explain: Sekin ko'tarilayotgan harorat yoki bosim kelajakdagi nosozlik ogohlantirishi.

q: HRSG baraban suv sathini operator qanday ushlaydi?
explain: Past bo'lsa quvurlar kuyadi, yuqori bo'lsa suv turbinaga o'tadi.

q: Generator trip bo'lganda operator avval nima qiladi?
explain: Sababni tushunmasdan qayta ulash xavfli, nosozlik takrorlanadi.

q: Nasos g'alati shag'irlagan ovoz chiqarsa (tosh bordek) bu nima belgisi?
explain: Operator so'rish bosimini tekshiradi, kavitatsiya nasos ichini yemiradi.

q: Operator muntazam obhodda (aylanib chiqishda) nima bilan tekshiradi?
options: Ko'z, quloq va hid bilan (shovqin, tebranish, sizish, kuygan hid)
explain: Ko'p nosozlik datchik ko'rsatishdan oldin shunday seziladi.

uz: EHC (Electro-Hydraulic Control) bug' turbinasining elektr-gidravlik boshqaruv tizimi. U elektr signalni gidravlik kuchga aylantirib, klapanlarni aniq va tez harakatga keltiradi. Zamonaviy turbinalarda mexanik boshqaruv o'rnini bosgan.
en: EHC (Electro-Hydraulic Control) is a steam turbine's electro-hydraulic control system. It converts electrical signals into hydraulic force to move valves precisely and quickly. In modern turbines it has replaced mechanical control.

uz: EHC tizimining boshqaruv shkafi va panellari toza va quruq saqlanishi kerak. Chang va namlik nozik elektronikani buzadi, bu esa turbina boshqaruvining ishonchliligini pasaytiradi.
en: The EHC system's control cabinet and panels must be kept clean and dry. Dust and moisture damage the sensitive electronics, reducing the reliability of turbine control.

q: EHC (Electro-Hydraulic Control) nima qiladi?
options: Elektr signalni gidravlik kuchga aylantirib klapanlarni harakatlantiradi
explain: EHC elektr-gidravlik boshqaruv, klapanlarni aniq va tez harakatga keltiradi.

uz: MOP (Main Oil Pump — asosiy moy nasosi) turbina normal ishlaganda moy tizimini ta'minlaydi. U ko'pincha turbina valiga ulangan, shuning uchun turbina aylanganda o'zi ishlaydi.
en: The MOP (Main Oil Pump) supplies the oil system when the turbine runs normally. It's often connected to the turbine shaft, so it works on its own as the turbine spins.

uz: Agar moy tizimi avtomatik ishga tushmasa, operator MOP (asosiy moy nasosi) ishlayotganini tekshiradi. Moy tizimining ishonchliligi butun turbina xavfsizligining asosi.
en: If the oil system doesn't start automatically, the operator checks whether the MOP (Main Oil Pump) is running. The reliability of the oil system is the foundation of the whole turbine's safety.

q: MOP (Main Oil Pump) ko'pincha qanday harakatlanadi?
options: Turbina valiga ulangan, aylanishda o'zi ishlaydi
explain: Valga ulanganidan, turbina aylanganda MOP o'zi moy tizimini ta'minlaydi.
