uz: GSC (Gland Steam Condenser) drenaj liniyasida 'loop seal' (suvli tsikl) bo'ladi. Bu suv to'plami havoning vakuumga teskari kirishini to'sadi — go'yo suvli tiqin kabi ishlaydi.
en: The GSC (Gland Steam Condenser) drain line has a loop seal (water trap). This pool of water blocks air from leaking back into the vacuum — working like a water plug.

uz: Loop seal ishlashi uchun unda doim suv bo'lishi kerak. Operator ishga tushirishdan oldin loop sealda suv borligini tekshiradi — aks holda vakuum ushlanmaydi.
en: For a loop seal to work it must always contain water. Before startup the operator checks that the loop seal has water — otherwise the vacuum won't hold.

q: GSC drenaj liniyasidagi loop seal (suvli tsikl) nima qiladi?
options: Suv tiqini kabi havoning vakuumga kirishini to'sadi
explain: Suv to'plami havoning vakuumga teskari kirishini to'sadi, suv bo'lishi shart.

uz: GSC blower (gland steam condenser puflagichi) gland steam condenserda yengil vakuum yaratadi. Bu vakuum val zichlagichidan chiqqan bug'-havo aralashmasini o'ziga tortadi.
en: The GSC blower (gland steam condenser blower) creates a slight vacuum in the gland steam condenser. This vacuum draws in the steam-air mixture from the shaft seals.

q: GSC blower nima qiladi?
options: Gland steam condenserda vakuum yaratib bug'-havoni tortadi
explain: Yengil vakuum val zichlagichidan chiqqan bug'-havo aralashmasini tortadi.

uz: HFP (Hydraulic Fluid Pump — gidravlik suyuqlik nasosi) turbina klapanlarini harakatga keltiruvchi bosimli suyuqlikni ta'minlaydi. Odatda ikkita bo'ladi (A va B) — biri ishlaydi, ikkinchisi zaxira.
en: The HFP (Hydraulic Fluid Pump) supplies the pressurized fluid that moves the turbine valves. There are usually two (A and B) — one working, the other standby.

uz: Gidravlik boshqaruv suyuqligi juda toza bo'lishi kerak — undagi eng kichik zarracha ham nozik klapan mexanizmini tiqib qo'yishi mumkin. Shu bois u alohida filtrlanadi.
en: Hydraulic control fluid must be very clean — even the smallest particle can jam the fine valve mechanism. So it is filtered separately.

q: Nega gidravlik boshqaruv suyuqligi juda toza bo'lishi kerak?
options: Kichik zarracha ham nozik klapan mexanizmini tiqib qo'yadi
explain: Nozik klapan mexanizmi zarrachaga juda sezgir, shu bois alohida filtrlanadi.

uz: Eccentricity (rotor egriligi) datchigi to'xtagan yoki sekin aylanayotgan rotorning qanchalik egilganini o'lchaydi. Ishga tushirishdan oldin rotor to'g'ri (egilmagan) bo'lishi kerak.
en: An eccentricity sensor measures how much a stopped or slowly turning rotor has bowed. Before startup the rotor must be straight (not bowed).

uz: Agar rotor eccentricity (egriligi) yuqori bo'lsa, operator ishga tushirmaydi — avval turning gearda rotorni aylantirib to'g'irlaydi. Egilgan rotorni ishga tushirish kuchli vibratsiya beradi.
en: If rotor eccentricity is high, the operator won't start — first the rotor is straightened by turning it on the turning gear. Starting a bowed rotor causes strong vibration.

q: Rotor eccentricity (egriligi) yuqori bo'lsa operator nima qiladi?
options: Ishga tushirmaydi, avval turning gearda to'g'irlaydi
explain: Egilgan rotorni ishga tushirish kuchli vibratsiya beradi, avval to'g'irlanadi.

uz: TSI (Turbine Supervisory Instrumentation) — turbina holatini kuzatuvchi asboblar to'plami: vibratsiya, rotor siljishi (axial position), eccentricity, tezlik va kengayish. Ular birgalikda turbina 'sog'lig'ini' ko'rsatadi.
en: TSI (Turbine Supervisory Instrumentation) is a set of instruments monitoring turbine condition: vibration, axial position, eccentricity, speed and expansion. Together they show the turbine's health.

q: TSI (Turbine Supervisory Instrumentation) nima kuzatadi?
options: Vibratsiya, rotor siljishi, eccentricity, tezlik, kengayish
explain: Bu asboblar birgalikda turbina sog'lig'ining to'liq manzarasini beradi.

uz: Axial position (o'q bo'ylab holat) datchigi rotorning o'q bo'ylab qancha siljiganini o'lchaydi. Katta siljish thrust bearing (o'q podshipnigi) yeyilganini bildiradi — bu jiddiy nosozlik.
en: An axial position sensor measures how far the rotor has shifted along its axis. A large shift indicates thrust bearing wear — a serious fault.

q: Rotorning katta axial (o'q bo'ylab) siljishi nimani bildiradi?
explain: Bu jiddiy nosozlik, thrust bearing rotorni o'q bo'ylab ushlab turadi.

uz: Turbina qizib to'liq yukka chiqqanda, val zichlagichi 'o'z-o'zini zichlash' (self-sealing) rejimiga o'tadi — turbinaning o'zidan chiqqan ortiqcha bug' zichlash uchun yetarli bo'ladi, tashqi bug' kerak emas.
en: When the turbine warms and reaches full load, the shaft seal enters 'self-sealing' mode — the turbine's own excess steam is enough for sealing, no external steam needed.

q: Turbina to'liq yukka chiqqanda val zichlagichi qanday ishlaydi?
options: O'z-o'zini zichlash — turbinaning o'z bug'i yetarli
explain: Turbinaning o'zidan chiqqan ortiqcha bug' zichlash uchun yetarli bo'ladi.

uz: Lube oil flushing (moy tizimini yuvish) yangi yoki ta'mirdan keyingi tizimda quvurlardagi qoldiq, zang va zarrachalarni moy aylantirib chiqarib tashlash. Bu podshipniklarga toza moy borishini ta'minlaydi.
en: Lube oil flushing (in a new or repaired system) circulates oil to wash out debris, rust and particles from the pipes. This ensures clean oil reaches the bearings.

q: Lube oil flushing (moy yuvish) nima uchun qilinadi?
options: Quvurlardagi qoldiq va zarrachalarni chiqarib tashlash
explain: Yangi yoki ta'mirdan keyingi tizimda podshipniklarga toza moy borishini ta'minlaydi.

uz: Commissioning (ishga tushirish sinovi) — yangi tizimni birinchi marta ishlatishdan oldin har bir qismini bosqichma-bosqich tekshirish va sinovdan o'tkazish. Bu nosozliklarni ishlashdan oldin topadi.
en: Commissioning is checking and testing each part of a new system step by step before first operation. This finds faults before running.

q: Commissioning (ishga tushirish sinovi) nima uchun qilinadi?
options: Yangi tizimni ishlatishdan oldin har qismini sinab, nosozlikni topish
explain: Nosozliklarni ishlashdan oldin topib, xavfsiz ishga tushirishni ta'minlaydi.

uz: Ba'zi klapanlarda 'soft packing' (yumshoq zichlagich) bo'ladi. Turbina uzoq to'xtab tursa, operator bu zichlagichlarni tekshiradi va kerak bo'lsa almashtiradi — ular vaqt o'tishi bilan qotib, zichligini yo'qotadi.
en: Some valves have soft packing (a soft seal). If the turbine sits idle for long, the operator checks and if needed replaces these seals — they harden over time and lose their seal.

q: Turbina uzoq to'xtab tursa klapan soft packing (yumshoq zichlagich)ga nima bo'ladi?
options: Qotib zichligini yo'qotadi, almashtirish kerak bo'lishi mumkin
explain: Vaqt o'tishi bilan qotadi, operator tekshirib kerak bo'lsa almashtiradi.

uz: Filtrlarda 'isolation valve' (ajratish klapani), 'filling valve' (to'ldirish klapani) va 'drain valve' (drenaj klapani) bo'ladi. Ular yordamida filtrni tizimdan ajratib, tozalab yoki almashtirib, keyin qayta ulash mumkin — turbina to'xtatmasdan.
en: Filters have an isolation valve, a filling valve and a drain valve. Using these, a filter can be isolated from the system, cleaned or replaced, then reconnected — without stopping the turbine.

q: Filtr isolation, filling va drain klapanlari nima imkon beradi?
options: Filtrni ajratib tozalash yoki almashtirish, turbina to'xtatmasdan
explain: Filtrni tizimdan ajratib xizmat ko'rsatish, keyin qayta ulash mumkin.

uz: MOV (Motor Operated Valve — motorli klapan) elektr motor yordamida masofadan ochiladi va yopiladi. Operator boshqaruv xonasidan turib katta klapanlarni boshqara oladi, qo'lda burashsiz.
en: An MOV (Motor Operated Valve) opens and closes remotely via an electric motor. The operator can control large valves from the control room without turning them by hand.

q: MOV (Motor Operated Valve) nima afzallik beradi?
explain: Elektr motor yordamida katta klapanlar masofadan boshqariladi.

uz: MOV (motorli klapan)larning mexanizmi ham moylanishi kerak. Operator davriy tekshiruvda har MOV va uning uzatmasi (reduktor) yetarli moy yoki grease (qiyom) bilan ta'minlanganini tekshiradi.
en: An MOV's mechanism also needs lubrication. On periodic checks the operator verifies each MOV and its gearbox has enough oil or grease.

q: MOV (motorli klapan) mexanizmiga davriy tekshiruvda nima kerak?
options: Yetarli moy yoki grease (qiyom) bilan ta'minlanganini tekshirish
explain: Mexanizm va reduktor moylanmasa, klapan qotib qolishi mumkin.

uz: Duplex filter — ikkita filtr bir korpusda, ular orasida almashtirish klapani bor. Biri ishlaganda ikkinchisini tozalash mumkin. Almashtirish klapani oqimni bir filtrdan ikkinchisiga to'xtatmasdan o'tkazadi.
en: A duplex filter has two filters in one housing with a transfer valve between them. One works while the other is cleaned. The transfer valve switches flow from one filter to the other without stopping.

q: Duplex filter nima afzallik beradi?
options: Biri ishlaganda ikkinchisini tozalash, oqim to'xtamaydi
explain: Almashtirish klapani oqimni to'xtatmasdan bir filtrdan ikkinchisiga o'tkazadi.

uz: Filtr ifloslanganini bilish uchun undagi bosim tushishi (delta P) o'lchanadi. Filtr toza bo'lsa oqim erkin o'tadi (kam bosim tushishi); iflos bo'lsa oqim qiyinlashadi (katta bosim tushishi). Delta P belgilangan chegaraga yetsa, filtr tozalanadi.
en: To tell if a filter is dirty, the pressure drop across it (delta P) is measured. A clean filter passes flow freely (low pressure drop); a dirty one restricts flow (high pressure drop). When delta P reaches a set limit, the filter is cleaned.

q: Filtr ifloslanganini qanday bilinadi?
explain: Iflos filtr oqimni qiyinlashtiradi, bosim tushishi oshadi, chegaraga yetsa tozalanadi.

uz: Filtrlar ikki holatda almashtiriladi: bosim tushishi chegaraga yetganda yoki belgilangan vaqt (masalan har necha oyda) o'tganda — qaysi biri avval kelsa. Bu tozalikni kafolatlaydi.
en: Filters are changed in two cases: when the pressure drop reaches the limit, or after a set time (e.g. every few months) — whichever comes first. This guarantees cleanliness.

q: Filtr qachon almashtiriladi?
options: Bosim tushishi chegaraga yetganda yoki belgilangan vaqt o'tganda
explain: Qaysi biri avval kelsa, shu paytda almashtiriladi, tozalikni kafolatlaydi.

uz: Basket filter (savat filtr) — savat shaklidagi filtr elementi. Suyuqlik savat ichidan tashqariga oqib, zarrachalar savat ichida qoladi. U yechib olinib tozalanadigan qilib yasalgan.
en: A basket filter has a basket-shaped filter element. Liquid flows from inside the basket outward, and particles stay inside. It's designed to be removed and cleaned.

q: Basket filter (savat filtr)da zarrachalar qayerda qoladi?
explain: Suyuqlik savat ichidan tashqariga oqadi, zarrachalar savat ichida ushlanadi.

uz: Ba'zi filtrlarda 'drain dirty' (iflos drenaj) klapani bo'ladi. Filtrni almashtirishdan oldin operator undagi iflos suyuqlikni shu klapan orqali chiqarib tashlaydi — bu toza tomonni ifloslamaydi.
en: Some filters have a 'drain dirty' valve. Before changing a filter, the operator drains the dirty fluid through this valve — keeping the clean side from being contaminated.

q: 'Drain dirty' klapani nima uchun kerak?
options: Filtrni almashtirishdan oldin iflos suyuqlikni chiqarish
explain: Iflos suyuqlikni chiqarib, toza tomonni ifloslamaydi.

uz: Accumulator (akkumulyator) ishlashdan oldin 'precharge' (oldindan to'ldirish) qilinadi — u ichidagi gaz (odatda azot) yostig'i bilan to'ldiriladi. Bu gaz yostig'i moy bosimini yumshoq ushlab, keskin o'zgarishlarni yumshatadi.
en: An accumulator is 'precharged' before use — filled with a gas cushion (usually nitrogen) inside. This gas cushion holds oil pressure smoothly and softens sudden changes.

q: Accumulator precharge (oldindan to'ldirish)da nima ishlatiladi?
explain: Gaz yostig'i moy bosimini yumshoq ushlab, keskin o'zgarishlarni yumshatadi.

uz: Nega azot ishlatiladi? Azot inert (befarq) gaz — u moy bilan reaksiyaga kirmaydi va yonmaydi. Havo ishlatilsa, undagi kislorod moyni oksidlab buzardi.
en: Why nitrogen? Nitrogen is an inert gas — it doesn't react with oil and doesn't burn. If air were used, its oxygen would oxidize and degrade the oil.

q: Nega accumulatorda havo emas, azot ishlatiladi?
options: Azot inert — moy bilan reaksiyaga kirmaydi va yonmaydi
explain: Havodagi kislorod moyni oksidlab buzardi, azot esa befarq.

uz: Lube oil cooler changeoverda operator ehtiyotkorlik bilan ishlaydi: yangi coolerga sovutuvchi suv oqimini ochadi, eski coolerdan oqimni sekin yopadi. Suvni birdan uzmasdan, moy harorati keskin ko'tarilmasligi kerak.
en: During lube oil cooler changeover the operator works carefully: opening cooling water flow to the new cooler, slowly closing flow from the old one. Water isn't cut suddenly, so oil temperature doesn't spike.

q: Lube oil cooler changeoverda operator nimaga e'tibor beradi?
options: Moy harorati keskin ko'tarilmasligiga (suvni sekin almashtiradi)
explain: Yangi coolerga suv ochilib, eskisidan sekin yopiladi, harorat sakramaydi.

uz: 'Block and bleed' klapan tizimi filtrni xavfsiz ajratish uchun: 'block' klapanlar oqimni to'sadi, 'bleed' klapan qolgan bosimni chiqaradi. Shundan keyin filtrni xavfsiz ochish mumkin — ichida bosim qolmaydi.
en: A 'block and bleed' valve arrangement safely isolates a filter: 'block' valves stop flow, a 'bleed' valve releases remaining pressure. Then the filter can be opened safely — no pressure left inside.

q: 'Block and bleed' klapan tizimi nima uchun kerak?
options: Filtrni ochishdan oldin oqim to'sib bosimni chiqarish
explain: Block oqimni to'sadi, bleed bosimni chiqaradi, filtr xavfsiz ochiladi.

uz: Gaz filtri va suyuqlik filtri turli chegarada almashtiriladi — gaz filtri kichikroq bosim tushishida (chunki gaz yengil), suyuqlik filtri kattaroq bosim tushishida almashtiriladi. Har biriga o'z qoidasi bor.
en: Gas filters and liquid filters are changed at different thresholds — a gas filter at a smaller pressure drop (gas is light), a liquid filter at a larger one. Each has its own rule.

q: Gaz va suyuqlik filtrlari almashtirish chegarasi bo'yicha qanday farq qiladi?
options: Gaz filtri kichikroq, suyuqlik filtri kattaroq bosim tushishida
explain: Gaz yengil, shu bois gaz filtri kichikroq bosim tushishida almashtiriladi.

uz: Adapter filter — filtr elementi maxsus 'adapter' (ulagich)ga o'rnatiladi, bu uni tez almashtirishga imkon beradi. Iflos element chiqarilib, yangisi shu adapterga o'rnatiladi.
en: An adapter filter has its element mounted on a special adapter, allowing quick replacement. The dirty element is removed and a new one fitted to the adapter.

q: Adapter filter nima afzallik beradi?
explain: Element maxsus adapterga o'rnatilgani uchun tez almashtiriladi.

uz: Cooler ishlayotganini tasdiqlash uchun operator sovutuvchi suv aslida oqayotganini tekshiradi — chiqish klapani orqali suv oqimi borligini ko'radi. Suv oqmasa, cooler moyni sovutmaydi va harorat ko'tariladi.
en: To confirm a cooler is working, the operator checks that cooling water is actually flowing — seeing water flow through the outlet valve. Without flow, the cooler won't cool the oil and temperature rises.

q: Cooler ishlayotganini operator qanday tasdiqlaydi?
explain: Suv oqmasa cooler moyni sovutmaydi, harorat ko'tariladi.

uz: Spin cooling operationda gaz turbinasi to'xtatilgach, uni bir muddat sekin aylantirib, ichidagi issiqlikni bir tekis tarqatadi. Bu rotor va korpusning notekis sovushi (va egilishi)ni oldini oladi.
en: In spin cooling operation, after the gas turbine stops, it's turned slowly for a while to distribute internal heat evenly. This prevents uneven cooling (and bowing) of rotor and casing.

q: Gaz turbinasi spin cooling nima beradi?
options: Issiqlikni bir tekis tarqatib rotor va korpus egilishini oldini oladi
explain: Turbinani sekin aylantirib notekis sovush va egilishni oldini oladi.

uz: Gaz turbinasi casing cooling schemesi — korpusni maqbul haroratda ushlash uchun havo bilan sovutish usullari. To'g'ri sovutish korpus va rotor orasidagi masofani (clearance) optimal ushlaydi.
en: Gas turbine casing cooling schemes are methods of air-cooling the casing to keep it at an optimal temperature. Correct cooling keeps the clearance between casing and rotor optimal.

q: Korpusni to'g'ri sovutish nimani optimal ushlaydi?
explain: To'g'ri clearance samaradorlik uchun muhim, juda kichik bo'lsa tegib ketadi.

uz: Turbina ta'mirida 'clearance' (qismlar orasidagi masofa) o'lchanadi. Aylanuvchi va qo'zg'almas qismlar orasida aniq masofa bo'lishi kerak — juda kichik bo'lsa tegib ketadi, juda katta bo'lsa gaz sizib samaradorlik tushadi.
en: During turbine overhaul, 'clearance' (the gap between parts) is measured. There must be a precise gap between rotating and stationary parts — too small and they rub, too large and gas leaks, lowering efficiency.

q: Turbinada clearance (qismlar orasidagi masofa) noto'g'ri bo'lsa nima bo'ladi?
options: Kichik bo'lsa tegadi, katta bo'lsa gaz sizib FIK tushadi
explain: Aniq masofa kerak, ikki tomonlama muammo bo'lishi mumkin.

uz: Rotor balansi (balancing) — uni shunday sozlashkiaylanganda tebranmasin. Rotorda og'irlik notekis taqsimlangan bo'lsa, aylanganda markazdan qochma kuch vibratsiya beradi. Balans og'irliklari qo'shib to'g'irlanadi.
en: Rotor balancing means adjusting it so it doesn't vibrate when spinning. If weight is unevenly distributed, centrifugal force causes vibration when rotating. It's corrected by adding balance weights.

q: Rotor balansi (balancing) nima uchun kerak?
explain: Notekis og'irlik markazdan qochma kuch bilan vibratsiya beradi, balans og'irliklari to'g'irlaydi.

uz: Kuchli pasaytiruvchi transformatorlar bir necha himoya turi bilan qamraladi: bo'ylama differensial, tokli kesim, gazli himoya, neytral himoyasi va zaxira maksimal tok himoyasi. Har biri turli nosozlikni qamraydi.
en: Large step-down transformers are covered by several protection types: longitudinal differential, current cut-off, gas protection, neutral protection and backup overcurrent. Each covers a different fault.

q: Kuchli transformator qaysi himoyalar bilan qamraladi?
options: Differensial, tokli kesim, gazli, neytral, zaxira maksimal tok
explain: Har bir himoya turi turli nosozlikni qamrab, transformatorni to'liq himoya qiladi.

uz: Bo'ylama differensial himoya transformator chulg'amlararo va chiqishlaridagi barcha turdagi qisqa tutashuvlardan himoyalaydi. U transformatorning ikki tomonidagi tokni solishtirib, farq bo'lsa ichki nosozlik borligini aniqlaydi.
en: Longitudinal differential protection guards against all types of short circuits between windings and at the terminals of a transformer. It compares currents on both sides, and a difference reveals an internal fault.

q: Bo'ylama differensial himoya transformatorda nimani solishtiradi?
explain: Chulg'amlararo va chiqishlardagi qisqa tutashuvlardan himoyalaydi.

uz: Sabr vaqtsiz tokli kesim (tez tokli himoya) differensial himoya o'rnatilmagan transformatorlarda qo'llaniladi. U transformatorning yuqori kuchlanish tarafidagi barcha qisqa tutashuvlardan tez himoyalaydi.
en: An instantaneous current cut-off (fast overcurrent) is used on transformers without differential protection. It quickly guards against all short circuits on the transformer's high-voltage side.

q: Tokli kesim (tez tokli himoya) qaysi transformatorlarda qo'llaniladi?
explain: Yuqori kuchlanish tarafidagi qisqa tutashuvlardan tez himoyalaydi.

uz: Gazli himoya (gaz relesi) transformator baki ichidagi har qanday gaz hosil bo'lishidan va bakda moy sathi kamayishidan himoyalaydi. Ichki yoy yoki o'ram kuyishi gaz chiqaradi — gaz relesi buni sezadi.
en: Gas protection (gas relay) guards against any gas formation inside the transformer tank and against a drop in oil level. An internal arc or winding burn produces gas — the gas relay detects it.

q: Gazli himoya (gaz relesi) nimalardan himoyalaydi?
options: Bak ichidagi gaz hosil bo'lishi va moy sathi kamayishidan
explain: Ichki yoy yoki o'ram kuyishi gaz chiqaradi, gaz relesi va past moy sathini sezadi.

uz: Quruq (moysiz) transformatorlar uchun gaz relesi o'rniga manometrli himoya qo'llaniladi — u bosim o'zgarishini sezadi. Moy bo'lmagani uchun gaz hosil bo'lmaydi, lekin ichki nosozlik bosimni oshiradi.
en: For dry (oil-free) transformers, pressure-based protection is used instead of a gas relay — it senses pressure change. Without oil there's no gas, but an internal fault raises pressure.

q: Quruq transformatorda gaz relesi o'rniga nima ishlatiladi?
explain: Moy yo'q, gaz hosil bo'lmaydi, lekin ichki nosozlik bosimni oshiradi.

uz: Neytral tarafidagi himoya transformator neytrali orqali yerga qisqa tutashuvlardan himoyalaydi. Yerlashtirilgan neytralda yerga tutashuv katta tok beradi, bu himoya uni sezadi.
en: Neutral-side protection guards against earth faults through the transformer neutral. With a grounded neutral, an earth fault gives a large current, which this protection detects.

q: Neytral tarafidagi himoya nimalardan himoyalaydi?
explain: Yerlashtirilgan neytralda yerga tutashuv katta tok beradi, himoya uni sezadi.

uz: Maxsus zaxira maksimal tok himoyasi transformatorning past kuchlanish tarafidagi fazalararo qisqa tutashuvlardan himoyalaydi. Bu asosiy himoyalar ishlamay qolsa, zaxira sifatida ishlaydi.
en: A special backup overcurrent protection guards against phase-to-phase short circuits on the transformer's low-voltage side. It serves as backup if the main protections fail.

q: Zaxira maksimal tok himoyasi transformatorda qaysi tarafni himoyalaydi?
options: Past kuchlanish tarafidagi fazalararo qisqa tutashuvni
explain: Asosiy himoyalar ishlamay qolsa, zaxira sifatida ishlaydi.

uz: Transformatorning 'ulanish guruhi' (masalan Y/delta-11) uning kirish va chiqish kuchlanishlari orasidagi faza siljishini ko'rsatadi. Differensial himoya sozlanganda bu siljish hisobga olinishi kerak, aks holda yolg'on ishlaydi.
en: A transformer's 'vector group' (e.g. Y/delta-11) shows the phase shift between its input and output voltages. When setting differential protection this shift must be accounted for, or it misoperates.

q: Nega differensial himoya sozlanganda transformator ulanish guruhi hisobga olinadi?
options: Faza siljishi hisobga olinmasa yolg'on ishlaydi
explain: Y/delta ulanishda faza siljadi, buni to'g'irlanmasa differensial himoya yolg'on ishlaydi.

uz: Transformator himoyasi ba'zan past kuchlanish tarafidan ketuvchi liniyalardagi qisqa tutashuvlardan ham himoyalaydi — agar o'sha liniyalarning o'z himoyalari ishlamay qolsa. Bu qo'shimcha zaxira qatlami.
en: Transformer protection sometimes also guards against short circuits on lines leaving the low-voltage side — if those lines' own protections fail. This is an extra backup layer.

q: Transformator himoyasi liniyalardan qachon himoyalaydi?
explain: Qo'shimcha zaxira qatlami, liniya himoyasi ishlamasa transformator himoyasi ishlaydi.

uz: Har bir himoya turi transformator quvvatiga qarab tanlanadi. Masalan gaz relesi ma'lum quvvatdan katta transformatorlarda, differensial himoya esa yanada kattaroqlarda qo'llaniladi. Kichik transformator kamroq himoya bilan qamraladi.
en: Each protection type is chosen according to transformer size. For example a gas relay is used above a certain power, differential protection on even larger ones. A small transformer is covered by fewer protections.

q: Transformator himoya turlari nimaga qarab tanlanadi?
explain: Kattaroq transformator ko'proq va murakkabroq himoya bilan qamraladi.

uz: Himoyalar orasida vaqt bo'yicha muvofiqlik: nosozlikka yaqin himoya tez ishlaydi, uzoqroqdagilari kechikish bilan. Shunda faqat nosozlikka eng yaqin himoya ishlab, sog'lom qismlar ishlab turadi.
en: Time coordination between protections: the protection nearest a fault acts fast, those farther act with delay. Thus only the protection closest to the fault operates, and healthy parts keep running.

q: Himoyalar orasida vaqt muvofiqligi qanday ishlaydi?
options: Yaqin himoya tez, uzoqdagilari kechikish bilan
explain: Faqat nosozlikka eng yaqin himoya ishlab, sog'lom qismlar ishlab turadi.

uz: Battery charger (batareya zaryadlagichi) stansiya batareyalarini doimo to'la holatda ushlaydi. Normal ishda u batareyani zaryadlaydi va DC yukni ta'minlaydi; tok yo'qolganda batareya o'zi yukni ushlaydi.
en: A battery charger keeps the plant batteries fully charged at all times. In normal operation it charges the battery and supplies the DC load; if power is lost, the battery itself carries the load.

q: Battery charger (batareya zaryadlagichi) normal ishda nima qiladi?
options: Batareyani zaryadlaydi va DC yukni ta'minlaydi
explain: Tok yo'qolganda batareya o'zi yukni ushlaydi, charger uni to'la saqlaydi.

uz: Rectifier (to'g'rilagich) o'zgaruvchan tokni (AC) o'zgarmas tokka (DC) aylantiradi, inverter esa aksincha — DC ni AC ga. UPS tizimida ikkalasi ishlatiladi: AC dan DC (batareyani zaryadlash), keyin DC dan AC (asboblarga).
en: A rectifier converts alternating current (AC) to direct current (DC), while an inverter does the reverse — DC to AC. A UPS uses both: AC to DC (charging the battery), then DC to AC (for instruments).

q: Rectifier va inverter farqi nima?
options: Rectifier AC dan DC ga, inverter DC dan AC ga aylantiradi
explain: UPS'da ikkalasi ishlatiladi: AC-DC (zaryad), keyin DC-AC (asboblar).

uz: Yerlashtirish (earthing) tizimi jihoz korpuslarini yerga ulaydi. Agar izolatsiya buzilib, korpusga kuchlanish o'tsa, tok yerga oqib ketadi va himoya ishlaydi — odam korpusga tegsa tok urmaydi.
en: An earthing system connects equipment casings to ground. If insulation fails and voltage reaches the casing, current flows to earth and protection operates — a person touching the casing isn't shocked.

q: Yerlashtirish (earthing) tizimi nima uchun kerak?
options: Korpusga kuchlanish o'tsa tok yerga oqadi, odam tok urmaydi
explain: Izolatsiya buzilsa tok yerga oqib himoya ishlaydi, odam himoyalanadi.

uz: Chaqmoqdan himoya (lightning protection) yuqori inshootlarga chaqmoq urib jihozni buzishdan saqlaydi. Chaqmoq o'tkazgichi (molniyaotvod) chaqmoqni o'ziga qabul qilib, tokni xavfsiz yerga o'tkazadi.
en: Lightning protection keeps a strike on tall structures from damaging equipment. A lightning conductor intercepts the strike and safely routes the current to earth.

q: Chaqmoq o'tkazgichi (molniyaotvod) nima qiladi?
options: Chaqmoqni qabul qilib tokni xavfsiz yerga o'tkazadi
explain: Chaqmoqni o'ziga qabul qilib, jihozni buzilishdan saqlaydi.

uz: Kabel nosozligi (cable fault) — yer ostidagi kabelda izolatsiya buzilishi yoki uzilish. Uni topish qiyin, chunki kabel ko'rinmaydi. Maxsus asboblar (kabel lokatori) nosozlik joyini masofadan aniqlaydi.
en: A cable fault is insulation breakdown or a break in an underground cable. It's hard to find because the cable is hidden. Special instruments (cable locators) pinpoint the fault location from a distance.

q: Yer ostidagi kabel nosozligini qanday topiladi?
explain: Kabel ko'rinmaydi, maxsus asboblar nosozlik joyini masofadan aniqlaydi.

uz: Generator ikki asosiy qismdan iborat: stator (qo'zg'almas tashqi qism, o'ramlari bor) va rotor (aylanuvchi ichki qism, magnit maydon yaratadi). Rotor aylanganda statorda tok induksiya qiladi.
en: A generator has two main parts: the stator (stationary outer part with windings) and the rotor (rotating inner part that creates the magnetic field). The spinning rotor induces current in the stator.

q: Generatorning ikki asosiy qismi qaysi?
explain: Rotor aylanib magnit maydon yaratadi, statorda tok induksiya qiladi.

uz: Rotorga tok slip ring (kontakt halqasi) va brush (cho'tka) orqali uzatiladi. Halqa rotorda aylanadi, cho'tka unga tegib turadi. Cho'tkalar vaqt o'tishi bilan yeyiladi va almashtiriladi.
en: Current reaches the rotor through slip rings and brushes. The ring rotates with the rotor while the brush stays in contact. Brushes wear over time and are replaced.

q: Rotorga tok qanday uzatiladi?
explain: Cho'tka aylanuvchi halqaga tegib tok uzatadi, cho'tkalar yeyilib almashtiriladi.

uz: Zamonaviy 'brushless' (cho'tkasiz) qo'zg'atish tizimida cho'tka umuman yo'q — tok aylanuvchi diodlar orqali rotorga o'tadi. Bu texnik xizmatni kamaytiradi, chunki yeyiladigan cho'tka yo'q.
en: A modern brushless excitation system has no brushes at all — current reaches the rotor through rotating diodes. This reduces maintenance, since there are no brushes to wear.

q: Brushless (cho'tkasiz) qo'zg'atish nima afzallik beradi?
explain: Tok aylanuvchi diodlar orqali o'tadi, yeyiladigan cho'tka yo'q.

uz: Zamonaviy J-class gaz turbinalari eng yuqori yonish haroratida ishlaydigan turkumga kiradi. Yuqori harorat ko'proq samaradorlik beradi, lekin pichoq materiallari va sovutishga katta talab qo'yadi.
en: Modern J-class gas turbines belong to the family operating at the highest firing temperatures. Higher temperature gives more efficiency but demands much of blade materials and cooling.

q: Nega J-class gaz turbinalari yuqori samaradorlik beradi?
explain: Yuqori harorat ko'proq samaradorlik, lekin material va sovutishga katta talab.

uz: Gaz turbinasi rotori bir necha disk (g'ildirak)dan iborat, har biriga pichoqlar o'rnatilgan. Disklar birga mahkamlanib, uzun bir val hosil qiladi. Pichoqlar disk chetiga maxsus 'ildiz' (root) bilan ushlanadi.
en: A gas turbine rotor consists of several discs (wheels), each holding blades. The discs are fastened together to form one long shaft. Blades attach to the disc rim by a special 'root'.

q: Turbina pichoqlari diskka qanday ushlanadi?
explain: Pichoq ildizi disk chetidagi mos o'yiqga kiritiladi, markazdan qochma kuchga bardosh beradi.

uz: Yirik gaz turbinalarida axial (o'q bo'ylab) kompressor ishlatiladi — havo val bo'ylab to'g'ri oqadi. Bu ko'p havoni samarali siqadi. Kichik dvigatellarda centrifugal (markazdan qochma) kompressor bo'lishi mumkin.
en: Large gas turbines use an axial compressor — air flows straight along the shaft. This compresses much air efficiently. Small engines may use a centrifugal compressor.

q: Yirik gaz turbinasida qaysi kompressor ishlatiladi?
explain: Axial kompressor ko'p havoni samarali siqadi, yirik turbinalar uchun mos.

uz: Yonish kameralari turli shaklda bo'ladi: 'can' (alohida silindrsimon kameralar halqa bo'ylab), 'annular' (bitta uzluksiz halqa) yoki 'can-annular' (aralash). Har birining o'z afzalligi bor.
en: Combustors come in different shapes: 'can' (separate cylindrical chambers around a ring), 'annular' (one continuous ring), or 'can-annular' (a mix). Each has its advantages.

q: Yonish kameralari qaysi shakllarda bo'ladi?
explain: Har shaklning o'z afzalligi bor, zamonaviy turbinalar turlichasini ishlatadi.

uz: Fuel nozzle (yoqilg'i forsunkasi) yoqilg'ini yonish kamerasiga mayin purkaydi. Yaxshi purkash yoqilg'ini havo bilan tez aralashtiradi va tekis yonishni ta'minlaydi. Tiqilgan forsunka notekis yonishga olib keladi.
en: A fuel nozzle sprays fuel finely into the combustor. Good atomization mixes fuel with air quickly and gives even combustion. A clogged nozzle leads to uneven burning.

q: Tiqilgan fuel nozzle (yoqilg'i forsunkasi) nimaga olib keladi?
explain: Yaxshi purkash tekis yonish beradi, tiqilishi notekis yonish va EGT spread'ni oshiradi.

uz: HRSG quvurlari 'finned' (qanotli) bo'ladi — quvur tashqarisiga metall qanotlar (fin) payvandlangan. Qanotlar issiqlik almashish yuzasini ko'paytirib, gazdan suvga ko'proq issiqlik o'tkazadi.
en: HRSG tubes are 'finned' — metal fins are welded to the tube exterior. The fins increase the heat exchange surface, transferring more heat from gas to water.

q: HRSG quvurlaridagi 'fin' (qanot) nima beradi?
explain: Ko'proq yuza gazdan suvga ko'proq issiqlik o'tkazadi, samaradorlik oshadi.

uz: Ba'zi HRSG'larda 'natural circulation' (tabiiy aylanish) bo'ladi — issiq suv yengil bo'lib yuqoriga ko'tariladi, sovuq suv pastga tushadi, nasossiz aylanish hosil bo'ladi. Bu oddiy va ishonchli.
en: Some HRSGs use natural circulation — hot water becomes lighter and rises, cold water sinks, creating flow without a pump. This is simple and reliable.

q: HRSG'da 'natural circulation' (tabiiy aylanish) qanday ishlaydi?
options: Issiq suv ko'tariladi, sovuq tushadi, nasossiz aylanish
explain: Zichlik farqi tufayli nasossiz aylanish, oddiy va ishonchli.

uz: Boiler feed pump (qozon ta'minlash nasosi) suvni juda yuqori bosimda HRSG'ga haydaydi — bosim bug' bosimidan yuqori bo'lishi kerak, aks holda suv qozonga kira olmaydi. Bu stansiyadagi eng yuqori bosimli nasoslardan.
en: A boiler feed pump forces water into the HRSG at very high pressure — it must exceed the steam pressure, or water can't enter the boiler. It's among the highest-pressure pumps in a plant.

q: Nega boiler feed pump juda yuqori bosim beradi?
options: Bosim bug' bosimidan yuqori bo'lmasa suv qozonga kirmaydi
explain: Suvni qozonga kiritish uchun bosim bug' bosimidan yuqori bo'lishi shart.

uz: Control valve (rostlash klapani) oqimni aniq boshqaradi — u qisman ochilib, kerakli miqdorda suyuqlik o'tkazadi. Boshqaruv tizimi klapanni avtomatik ochib-yopib, bosim yoki oqimni maqsad qiymatda ushlaydi.
en: A control valve precisely regulates flow — opening partly to pass the required amount. The control system automatically opens and closes it to hold pressure or flow at the target.

q: Control valve (rostlash klapani) qanday ishlaydi?
options: Qisman ochilib kerakli miqdorda suyuqlik o'tkazadi
explain: Boshqaruv tizimi klapanni avtomatik rostlab, bosim yoki oqimni maqsadda ushlaydi.

uz: Flow meter (oqim o'lchagich) quvurdan o'tayotgan suyuqlik yoki gaz miqdorini o'lchaydi. Turli usullar bor: bosim farqi, aylanuvchi g'ildirak yoki ultratovush. Oqim ma'lumoti jarayonni boshqarish uchun muhim.
en: A flow meter measures the amount of liquid or gas passing through a pipe. There are various methods: differential pressure, a spinning wheel or ultrasound. Flow data is important for process control.

q: Flow meter (oqim o'lchagich) nima o'lchaydi?
options: Quvurdan o'tayotgan suyuqlik yoki gaz miqdorini
explain: Bosim farqi, aylanuvchi g'ildirak yoki ultratovush usullarida o'lchaydi.

uz: Level meter (sath o'lchagich) bak yoki barabandagi suyuqlik sathini o'lchaydi. HRSG barabani sathini o'lchash ayniqsa muhim — noto'g'ri sath quvur kuyishi yoki turbinaga suv o'tishiga olib keladi.
en: A level meter measures liquid level in a tank or drum. Measuring the HRSG drum level is especially important — a wrong level leads to tube overheating or water carrying to the turbine.

q: HRSG barabanida sath o'lchash nega ayniqsa muhim?
options: Noto'g'ri sath quvur kuyishi yoki turbinaga suv o'tishiga olib keladi
explain: Past sath quvur kuydiradi, yuqori sath suvni turbinaga o'tkazadi.

uz: Stansiyalar turli rejimda ishlaydi: 'base load' (doimiy, to'la quvvat) yoki 'peak load' (talab yuqori paytda qo'shimcha). Combined cycle stansiyalar ikkalasiga ham moslasha oladi, chunki ular tez yukni o'zgartira oladi.
en: Plants run in different modes: 'base load' (constant, full power) or 'peak load' (extra during high demand). Combined cycle plants can do both, since they can change load quickly.

q: 'Base load' va 'peak load' farqi nima?
options: Base doimiy to'la quvvat, peak talab yuqori paytda qo'shimcha
explain: Combined cycle ikkala rejimga moslashadi, tez yuk o'zgartira oladi.

uz: Combined cycle stansiyaning samaradorligi oddiy gaz turbinasidan ancha yuqori — chunki bir yoqilg'idan ikki marta ish olinadi. Bu kam yoqilg'i, kam chiqindi va kam xarajat degani.
en: A combined cycle plant's efficiency is much higher than a simple gas turbine — because one fuel does work twice. This means less fuel, less emissions and lower cost.

q: Combined cycle yuqori samaradorligi nima beradi?
options: Kam yoqilg'i, kam chiqindi, kam xarajat
explain: Bir yoqilg'idan ikki marta ish, shu bois iqtisodiy va ekologik foydali.

uz: Power factor (quvvat koeffitsienti) — foydali quvvatning to'liq quvvatga nisbati. U 1 ga yaqin bo'lsa yaxshi (energiya samarali ishlatiladi). Past power factor tarmoqda qo'shimcha yo'qotish keltiradi.
en: Power factor is the ratio of useful power to total power. Close to 1 is good (energy is used efficiently). A low power factor causes extra losses in the grid.

q: Power factor (quvvat koeffitsienti) 1 ga yaqin bo'lsa nima yaxshi?
explain: Past power factor tarmoqda qo'shimcha yo'qotish keltiradi.

uz: Elektr uzoq masofaga uzatilganda bir qismi issiqlik bo'lib yo'qoladi (transmission loss). Shuning uchun uzatishdan oldin kuchlanish oshiriladi — yuqori kuchlanishda tok kichrayadi, yo'qotish kamayadi.
en: When electricity is transmitted far, part is lost as heat (transmission loss). So voltage is raised before transmission — at high voltage the current is smaller, reducing losses.

q: Nega elektr uzatishdan oldin kuchlanish oshiriladi?
options: Yuqori kuchlanishda tok kichrayadi, yo'qotish kamayadi
explain: Tok kichrayganda quvurdagi issiqlik yo'qotishi kamayadi.

uz: Kondensator quvurlari vaqt o'tishi bilan ichdan ifloslanadi (loyqa, chig'anoq, o'simlik). Iflos quvur issiqlikni yomon o'tkazadi, vakuum yomonlashadi. Ular davriy tozalanadi (masalan cho'tka yoki maxsus shar bilan).
en: Condenser tubes foul internally over time (silt, shells, growth). A fouled tube transfers heat poorly, worsening vacuum. They're cleaned periodically (e.g. with brushes or special balls).

q: Iflos kondensator quvuri nimaga olib keladi?
explain: Iflos quvur issiqlik almashinuvini pasaytiradi, davriy tozalanadi.

uz: Kondensatorda 'air in-leak' (havo sizishi) vakuumni yomonlashtiradi. Havo qayerdandir ichkariga kirsa, u issiqlik o'tkazishni pasaytiradi va bosimni oshiradi. Operator sizish joyini topib bekitadi.
en: An 'air in-leak' in a condenser worsens vacuum. If air enters from somewhere, it reduces heat transfer and raises pressure. The operator finds and seals the leak.

q: Kondensatorda havo sizishi (air in-leak) nima qiladi?
explain: Havo issiqlik o'tkazishni pasaytiradi, operator sizishni topib bekitadi.
